title: Stabilizer Fragmentation
summary: Stabilizer Fragmentation was first introduced as an event duo with game update 73. Since game update 139 it is a solo challenge. It is a meta-event randomly loading previous Time Capsule related instances.

sections.title: Overview
items: Stabilizer Fragmentation was first introduced as an event duo with game update 73. Since game update 139 it is a solo challenge. It is a meta-event randomly loading previous Time Capsule related instances.

sections.title: Story
items: Fragments of stabilized time can be collected from moments of proven stability in the multiverse. Relive those moments and gather Stabilizer Fragments.

sections.title: Possible Instances
items: Anti-Matter Research
Mental Manifestations
Monster Training
Suicide Squad Training
World War II Basic Training and Battle Preparation
The enemy combat rating is 34. Players are buffed/clamped to CR 34 if they are lower/higher.

references.label: World War II Basic Training and Battle Preparation

sections.title: Rewards
items: 9 Stabilizer Fragments (members)
5 Stabilizer Fragments (non-members)
1 Source Mark
1 piece of generic gear (out of 2)
2 Base Items
Possible iconic weapon style if the boss does have an associated weapon style.

Stabilizer Fragmentation has a unique loot lock system. Stabilizer Fragments are "account rewards" and can only be obtained once per account before it is loot locked for the day, and has a different reset time at 08:00 UTC. The rest are "character rewards" that work just like normal loot (can be obtained by every character, resetting at 00:00 UTC).

sections.title: Bonus Stabilizer Fragments Event
items: Since 2017, there is an Event, typically lasting a week, where Stabilizer Fragment rewards from the Stabilizer Fragmentation instance have a multiplier applied. The event usually coincides with the release of a new "regular" Time Capsule approximately three times during the calendar year. In 2026, this event applies a 3x (triple) modifier.

sections.title: Trivia
items: This instance was phased out with game update 116 and then reintroduced with game update 138. In the meantime Stabilizer Fragments were distributed through Doctor Fate's Daily Rewards.

sections.title: Overview
items: The Atlantean Outpost is a seasonal alert in the Tides of War event. It will appear in the player's On Duty Menu under Events.
While this mission and related event content is accessible to players Level 10+, Event Progression is only available for players Level 20+. Stat buffs will be applied as needed to a target CR 34.

sections.title: Background
items: Tides of War is set against the backdrop of Aquaman fighting Ocean Master for the crown of the seas. Their respective followers have amassed fleets around Metropolis, and players can assist the side of their choice via with new missions, feats, collections, and a four-person alert. There are plenty of rewards to entice super-loyalty during this event, including pets and costumes. Enter the Atlantean Outpost and face the respective factions leader.

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: In order to finish the fight all three consoles at the sides must be enabled together within the time limit. If this cannot be achieved, the fight will not end.

The consoles should also be done during the fight. Players will experience a huge knockback before the consoles activate. Just don't run in again immediately after the knockback and you should automatically be near a console to be able to activate it easily.
A healer might be useful, especially for more inexperienced random groups.

title: Hall of Doom: Recovery
summary: Hall of Doom: Recovery is the Level 30 Walk-In instance — the finale of the Classic Game — for Meta powered hero players who have Superman as their mentor. It is also available as a Tier 2 Duo from the On Duty menu.

sections.title: Overview
items: Hall of Doom: Recovery is the Level 30 Walk-In instance — the finale of the Classic Game — for Meta powered hero players who have Superman as their mentor. It is also available as a Tier 2 Duo from the On Duty menu.

sections.title: Background
items: The Hall of Doom is the secret headquarters of the Secret Society of Super-Villains and home base for the new Exobtye-enhanced villains. Designed and built by Doctor Sivana and Lex Luthor's LexCorp resources, the Hall is connected to various nightclubs around Gotham City and Metropolis via teleportation systems.

Having lured and captured Superman within the bottled Daily Planet Building, Lex Luthor brings the kryptonian hero to the Hall of Doom. Concerned on Superman's absence, Oracle sends a new hero to the Daily Planet to check up on what was happening inside. Learning of Superman's capture, the hero enters the Hall of Doom in Luthor's wake and proceeds to fight their way through the base to free Superman from Luthor's clutches.

sections.title: Overview
items: Healing over time (h0t) is a buff only supplied by healers. Nature and Celestial mainly give this buff to the group. Abilities such as Circle of Destiny in the Sorcery powerset and Electrogenesis in the Electricity powerset also heal over time. Healing over Time is when the group is automatically being healed in small amounts as compared to direct and burst healing which supply health in huge amounts. It is therefore sometimes prefered that a burst healer and a over time healer work together in the same raid. Two Nature healers may have difficulty working together in a raid, due to their overlapping heal over time buffs. The stat recommended to enhance this buff is Restoration If a player is being healed over time, a small green heart will appear under the players name and health bar. Although Celestial healers heal over time they don't provide the heart symbol.

items: Kahndaq is a Tier 1 8-player Raid instance in the base Classic Game. It is accessible via On Duty menu or via portal in the Watchtower and the Hall of Doom.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: For the story mission, see Black Desires.

The dead are rising in Kahndaq as Black Adam channels a magically-created Lazarus pit to raise his wife Isis - and an army of Kahndaq's undead - from the grave. You must defeat death itself and restore the Flame of Life before Black Adam and his captives snuff it out forever.

sections.title: Overview
items: Male - Elite Female - Elite
Nuclear is an Iconic Battle Suit for heroes and villains which is also available in an Elite version.
Consisting of eight pieces, the set is an advanced PvE ( Player versus Environment) gear set inspired by the vestments of Firestorm.

This set has Item Levels 150 and 153 and is obtained as loot drop from the tier 8 raid Darkseid's War Factory (elite) as well as the A Rip in Time (elite) alert. A minimum PvE Combat Rating of 154 or above and episodes 24 and 25 are pre-requisite of obtaining this gear.
The regular set is available as Attuned Gear from Doctor Fate's Daily Rewards gear boxes.
The costume style is also available as style items named Fusion from Vending Unit 44 in the Archive of Victory of the House of Legends.

title: The Watchtower: An Opportunity
summary: The Watchtower: An Opportunity is the Level 30 Walk-In instance — the finale of the Classic Game — for Meta powered villain players who have Lex Luthor as their mentor. It is also available as a Tier 2 Duo from the On Duty menu.

sections.title: Overview
items: The Watchtower: An Opportunity is the Level 30 Walk-In instance — the finale of the Classic Game — for Meta powered villain players who have Lex Luthor as their mentor. It is also available as a Tier 2 Duo from the On Duty menu.
It sees the Watchtower headquarters of the Justice League of America infiltrated and attacked by the villain faction.

sections.title: Background
items: The Watchtower is the satellite headquarters of the Justice League of America and home base for the new Exobtye-enhanced heroes. The Watchtower is linked with the Hall of Justice in Washington DC as well as various Police Station Safe Houses around Gotham City and Metropolis via an archway-type teleporation system. The satellite was designed by both Wonder Woman and Green Lantern (John Stewart), and paid for by Wayne Enterprises, Queen Industries, and Kord Legacy.

Having lured and captured Superman within the bottled Daily Planet Building, Lex Luthor finds himself transported to the Watchtower. Calculator sends a new villain to the Daily Planet to check up on what was happening inside. The player villain follows Luthor's trail, and somehow teleports to inside the Watchtower, and proceeds to fight their way through the base to free Lex from captivity.

sections.title: Overview
items: Bizarro Sample Coney Coin
Aberrant is a costume style set for heroes and villains which is also available in an Elite version.
Consisting of eight pieces, the set is an advanced PvE ( Player versus Environment) gear set inspired by failed clones from Brainiac: Overrun Area 51 duo.
The regular set has Item Level 385, the elite set has Item Level 387, and both can be obtained only at Booster Gold in Bottled D.C. and The Catwoman (Episode Vendor) in the House of Legends.
The regular set is also available from Penguin in Apokoliptic Gotham City.
The costume style is also available as style items from Ursa in the Archive of Victory of the House of Legends.

sections.title: Story
items: The Furies have kidnapped Poison Ivy and are forcing her to create Hellspores to use in the Gotham war. She's being kept in the Clocktower – Set out to rescue her and uncover the truth behind the Furies’ plans!

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Hellspores can be found all over the alert (looks like stony eggs on the ground). They can be picked up and thrown, capable of dealing millions of damage against the mobs when they hit a target and explode.

sections.title: First boss: Stompa
items: Stompa uses Brawling. You do not have to deplete all her health and she retreats at about half health.
Charge: Stompa charges at a player dealing heavy damage and knocking back any targets she hits.

Earthquake: A small red cone appears in front of Stompa before she sends out a shockwave dealing massive damage in the area. If she uses the Stomp Smash combo right before Earthquake, it is possible for her vulnerable to interrupt state to last long enough she can be interrupted when she is preparing Earthquake, cancelling the attack.
The following only seem to be used in Elite:
Earthquake: The attack targets a massive red circle around Stompa instead.
Rockfall: Many smaller red circles are marked around the whole room before rocks fall for heavy damage at all of them.

sections.title: Second boss: Mad Harriet and Stompa
items: Mad Harriet is fought first, and when she falls to 75% health, she is joined by Stompa at half health. Stompa does not use Earthquake in this fight, but she does use Rockfall including in Normal. Additionally, Mad Harriet has a "Haha" special attack that deals no damage but hard stuns all players (must mash button to reduce duration), potentially reducing reaction time for avoiding other attacks.
Blade Spike: Mad Harriet deals massive damage in a red cone area marked on the floor after a delay.
Seed pods are found in the boss room and when prompted, players may interact with them to summon plant allies.

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Join Red Tool in New Genesis looking for Harley Quinn, who has joined the Furies and is battling Big Barda for a powerful item. Upon finding a Mother Box and defeating the mobs around it, go through the boom tube it opens, leading to the first boss.

sections.title: First boss: Lashina
items: Lashina is fairly simple without particularly dangerous attacks even in Elite. She uses Martial Arts. Whenever she loses a portion of her health, she briefly turns invincible while fleeing and summoning several parademons. It is not required to kill them (but it is a feat to do once).
After defeating her, interact with her to take a tool for repairing the Mother Box.

Calibrating the Mother Box involves a simple puzzle. Interact with the console, which would play a sequence, involving the 4 pads on the floor lighting up in a particular order (with matching audible chimes). Imitating the sequence yourself by stepping on top the pads, which lights up when triggered (it is possible not to trigger it if you run across it too fast, especially with Ally: Professor Zoom's passive effect). Do it correctly 4 times to proceed.

If you get it wrong parademons would appear, and getting it wrong too many times would eventually allow you to bypass the puzzle. In normal difficulty, getting it wrong 4 times would succeed in 1 calibration, but for calibrations 2 to 4, only getting it wrong once each is sufficient.

sections.title: Second boss: Hammer Harleen
items: Hammer Harleen has two notable special attacks, but they both have a considerable tell so they are easy to avoid.
Homerun Strike: Harleen marks a red cone in front of her before damaging the player equal to 75% of their max health if caught within (ignores Shield Powers). Warned with Lethal attack icon.

Grand Slam: When she falls to 75%, 50%, and 25% health, Harleen Boom Tubes to the middle of the area, marks a broad red ring on the ground centred around her (the ring can be a short, medium, or long distance away from her), before blasting the marked area over a couple seconds. Each use of Grand Slam deals 4 hits, each equal to 45% of player max health, and ignores Shield Powers. She uses it twice every time before returning to normal combat.

Possible bug: If you damage her down to 75%, then damage her down to 50% while she is still in the Grand Slam phase, she will remain in it for the rest of the fight, using Grand Slam constantly regardless of health percentages.

sections.title: Overview
items: Coney Coin
Apokolips: Subjukator Construction Site is a Tier 7 Raid in the Harley Quinn vs. Apokolips episode. It also features Casual, Elite, and Elite Plus versions.

sections.title: Story
items: Granny Goodness is using the Splinter of Destiny to power an Apokoliptian weapon known as the Subjukator. Help Harley Quinn and Big Barda put a stop to her plans and prevent Darkseid from using the power of the splinter to conquer the cosmos!

sections.title: Characters
items: Iconic Allies
Harley Quinn
Big Barda
Iconic Foes
Darkseid
Granny Goodness
Kalibak
Mobs

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: You start the raid by joining Big Barda and Harley Quinn at the Subjukator Construction Site, and then proceeding through a series of hallways defeating Parademon enemies in the process. Part way through this you encounter General Kraze in a more open area, before loading ammo to two cannons. Harley's fire at a giant Darkseid statue (Subjukator) in the distance ineffectually, while Big Barda's blast opens the door to the next area. After a few more hallways defeating Parademon enemies the group encounters Granny Goodness.

sections.title: First boss: Granny Goodness
items: Can be tricky with lower damage output from the group, and/or if the group don’t focus on mechanics, more so in the Elite versions.
Required roles for Normal/Elite: 5 DPS, 1 Controller, 1 Heal, 1 Tank
Recommended roles for Elite Plus: 4-5 DPS, 1 Controller, 1 Heal, 1-2 Tank
Mechanics:

Battle Charge: Granny Goodness will target a random player (the affected player will receive an icon above their head). If Granny Goodness hits the player they will be knocked back ( Knockback Attack) and will take significant damage, more so in the Elite versions.
Parademon Soldier adds will spawn from the 4 Boom Tubes that appear early in the boss encounter to assist Granny Goodness in battle.

A Shield Drone and an Attack Drone will also appear to assist Granny Goodness in battle. The Shield Drone will shield Granny Goodness, mitigating damage towards her. It is worth considering that if players deal damage towards the drones directly that they will target players (ie. not the tank) instead with their Primary Attack - most individual KOs from group members in the Elite versions of this boss encounter are usually due to this reason.

Shockwave Stomp (1): Granny Goodness will face in a particular direction (often following Battle Charge) with a red cone AOE tell on the floor, before producing a shockwave in front of her. Deals heavy damage.

Energy Blast: Granny Goodness will face a particular direction while having a red skull icon above her head. She will then fire several projectiles in that direction. Deals very heavy damage and may knock back affected players. Prolonged exposure to this will likely KO affected players, especially in the Elite versions.

sections.title: Pain Amplifier
items: This is the primary mechanic for this boss encounter.
Every 45 seconds the Pain Amplifier will Discharge raid wide AOE damage to the group. This may get stronger depending on how much the Pain Amplifier gets charged.

4 Boom Tubes will spawn around the room early in the boss encounter (as previously mentioned). Parademon Transporter adds will spawn, carrying Power Core containers that have a yellow lightning icon on them.
Players must stop these Power Core containers from reaching the Pain Amplifier machine in the middle of the room (and ideally destroy them) or they will fill the Pain Amplifier Charge.
If the Pain Amplifier Charge reaches 100 and it discharges it will deal extremely heavy damage to the group and will likely cause a group wipe.
When a Power Core container is destroyed it will leave an electric AOE, dealing considerable damage over time to affected players.
Differences/considerations for Elite Plus:
All attacks/adds/mechanics are scaled up, so there is a high expectation on the group. Some groups may prefer to run 2 tanks.
DPS should prioritise defeating the Shield Drone and Attack Drone as these may cause issues focusing on specific players and KOing them potentially.

After defeating Granny Goodness, the group proceed through more hallways defeating more Parademon enemies. Eventually the group enter the Subjukator Overlook where they need to detonate explosives on Apokoliptian equipment to provide a distraction for Big Barda. This causes a couple waves of Parademon enemies to spawn in via Boom Tubes. Eventually Kalibak joins the battle, but when the group deal approximately 5% of his health a cutscene occurs, Darkseid appears and banishes Kalibak before confronting the group.

sections.title: Last boss: Darkseid
items: Fairly straightforward boss encounter in both Normal and Elite versions. In the Elite Plus version somewhat trickier.
Recommended roles for Normal/Elite/Elite Plus versions: 5 DPS, 1 Controller, 1 Heal, 1 Tank
Mechanics:
Parademon Soldier, Parademon Fixer, Parademon Grenadier, Parademon Maniac and Parademon Brute adds will spawn to assist Darkseid in combat.

Mass Omega Strike: Darkseid will fire Omega Beams in the sky. All players will have a red AOE tell (with Omega Symbol) on the floor beneath them and the players will need to move quickly. Approximately 1.5 seconds after the tells appear Omega Strikes appear, dealing very heavy damage over time to affected players. While doing this mechanic periodically throughout the boss encounter, Darkseid always does this mechanic first shortly after the boss encounter starts.
Shockwave Stomp (2): Darkseid will stomp on the ground, dealing moderate damage to nearby players or allied NPCs.

Apokoliptian Torment: Small red AOE tells will appear around the room. Fire will fall onto the targeted areas, leaving a small fiery AOE on the ground. If a player is affected by this they will take damage over time for a short while - this will continue even if the player is no longer stood on the AOE directly.

Omega Eruption (1): Darkseid will create a large red donut AOE around him. After 3 seconds red Omega projectiles come down from the ceiling and hit the affected areas. Deals very heavy damage to affected players. There will be onscreen text when this occurs, stating “Move Close to Darkseid!”
Omega Eruption (2): Darkseid will have a small red AOE around him. Avoid the AOE. There will be onscreen text when this occurs, stating “Get Away from Darkseid!” (More info needed)

Blitz: Darkseid will randomly charge a player, dealing very heavy damage. Even if not a direct hit players nearby may also take very heavy damage. If the player is directly hit by Darkseid’s charge they may be KO’d (as well as knocked back), especially in the Elite versions, and especially if a non-tank role.

sections.title: Omega Execute
items: Darkseid will give a random player a green stack marker icon as well as an Omega symbol.
There will be onscreen text stating: “Move to Marked Teammate to Reduce Damage - the More the Better!”
After approximately 7 seconds the affected player will be impacted by Omega Execute.

If not enough players stack with the affected player or the player is by themselves they will take full damage and will likely be KO’d. Even with two players in the Elite version if only the affected player and another player stack both players will be KO’d.

sections.title: Subjukator Blast
items: At approximately 95%/60%/30% of Darkseid’s health, Darkseid will shield and become invulnerable, and will blink to the the middle of the room. The entire room will have a red AOE tell.
There will be onscreen text stating: “Subjukator Blast Incoming, take cover!”
There will be terminals around the room, one will have a interact icon which a player can use to activate a barrier to get out of line of sight of Darkseid and create a safe area from the attack.
There is approximately 10 seconds between the start of the phase and the impact.
If players are affected by Subjukator Blast they will take large damage in the Normal version, however this will most likely KO affected players in the Elite versions. It may also knock players back.
It is possible to hide behind at least the terminal (with the icon) in the room to stay out of line of sight of Darkseid and evade or at least mitigate incoming damage. (More info needed)
If Darkseid commences Omega Execute and then starts this phase shortly after, Omega Execute does not occur despite the affected player having the icons on them.
Any Parademon adds that are in line of sight of Darkseid during this phase will likely be defeated if affected by Subjukator Blast.
Differences/considerations for Elite Plus:

Fallen Parademon enemies may drop an Explosive Device with a short timer icon. When the timer runs out it will explode, dealing heavy damage to affected players. Be especially vigilant following a Subjukator Blast phase as there may be several fallen Parademons and subsequently several Explosive Device AOEs to watch out for.
Once you defeat Darkseid you have completed the raid.
Note: This is an early version of the walkthrough and is subject to mostly minor changes in the coming weeks, depending on hotfixes/server updates. A few mechanics need a little more information.

title: Area 51 (Briefing)
summary: Briefing: Area 51 is a collection of Briefings that can be found scattered across the Area 51 Alert Zone, accessible from a player's On Duty Menu upon achieving level 9.

sections.title: Overview
items: Briefing: Area 51 is a collection of Briefings that can be found scattered across the Area 51 Alert Zone, accessible from a player's On Duty Menu upon achieving level 9.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: " Brainiac has invaded Cadmus's base at Area 51!"

A Cadmus-run military base at Area 51, in the Nevada desert, has come under attack by Brainiac's forces. Contracted under both the U.S. government and Lexcorp to conduct kryptonite-based research at this location, Cadmus is exploring the mineral's effects on native earth life, as well as developing a process of producing it artificially. Cadmus' stockpile of the rare mineral would represent a significant threat if it were to fall into Brainiac's hands.

sections.title: Part 1: Lois Lane
items: Zone: Area 51
Location: Beside the runway directly south of the Fuel Depot.

Briefing: Lois Lane: " This is Lois Lane with Daily Planet Live. A large Brainiac assault force is launching an attack on a military base inside the infamous Area 51. His target? A large store of green kryptonite, confiscated by the military for research. The base is run by Cadmus, a private government contractor, best known for their willingness to provide results without asking questions. More updates to come on Daily Planet Live."

sections.title: Part 2: Amanda Waller
items: Zone: Area 51
Location: On the southern side of the broken bridge between the Fuel Depot and the Ammo Dump, on top of the ridge.

Briefing: Amanda Waller: " This is Amanda Waller to the Area 51 Cadmus project. I will remind you that the U.S. government contracted you to complete our green kryptonite research. It must not fall into Brainiac's hands. Requests for Suicide Squad backup are being taken into consideration. Until then, we authorize you to defend yourself. Waller Out."

sections.title: Part 3: Amanda Waller
items: Zone: Area 51
Location: In a crater on the northern side of the broken bridge between the Fuel Depot and the Ammo Dump.

Briefing: Amanda Waller: " This is a U.S. government classified safety briefing on green kryptonite, sometimes called green K. Area 51 is the United States' primary storehouse for this alien mineral. Its effects on kryptonians, such as Superman, are well known, and include draining strength, even to death. However, effects on Earth lifeforms are still unknown."

sections.title: Part 4: Jack Ryder
items: Zone: Area 51
Location: Found near the southern corner of Command and Control, next to a pile of ammunition crates outside the wall.

Briefing: Jack Ryder: " I'm Jack Ryder, and you are wrong! Why? Because your trust the government. I'm telling you, they've teamed up with private genetic powerhouse Cadmus, up in Area 51, and they're researching everything from green kryptonite to DNAliens. You think different? Then you are wrong!"

sections.title: Part 5: Lex Luthor
items: Zone: Area 51
Location: In the dish of a destroyed communications array, northeast of the Brainiac Invasion Site.

Briefing: Lex Luthor: " Luthor to Cadmus. I've spent too long on our artificial kryptonite research to have Brainiac steal our raw materials. I trust our other projects have been secured at your other locations? If not, luckily I have allies on my payroll capable of remedying your incompetence. I'll deduct this from your payments as per our contract. Luthor out."

sections.title: Part 6: Superman
items: Zone: Area 51
Location: Underneath a fallen light pole, lying across runway south of the Brainiac Invasion Site.

Briefing: Lois Lane: " Superman, Lois Lane from the Daily Planet. We hear that Brainiac is attacking Cadmus. As you know, they've been openly collecting kryptonite, the one element that can weaken you. Do you have any comment on ..." Superman: " Ms Lane, I'm not sure where you get your information. Surely the U.S. government ensures that any Cadmus base is working within legal limits. As for the kryptonite threat, it seems that our new generation of heroes has inherited our strengths, but not our weaknesses. The JLA and I will be working closely with them to contain any threat from Brainiac, or anyone else."

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: The trickiest part is the Construct Maze - which is in the form of a square grid and you need to get from the southwest corner to the northeast corner. There are four consoles before the beginning of the maze, each with a layout map above them - activating the console changes the maze to the associated layout. The four walls of each cell would disappear and reappear to obey the layout chosen. By changing the layout, other players would be able to advance northeast room by room. However, a major issue is there are hazards inside the maze - on top of regular mobs, some rooms have a yellow energy blast trap (simply labelled Something in combat messages) that can deal massive damage and wipe the group in that room, and this is not visible on the layout maps at the consoles.

At least 1 player needs to operate the consoles while others navigate thee maze, likely 2 or 3 players as mobs will appear and interfere (although the console operating period is short and Shield Powers work).

Most players should enter the maze, then move to the next cell towards your goal whenever a wall disappears and you'd eventually get there. Try to stick together as when the maze changes players can get cut off - Construct mobs that appear inside the maze can quickly KO stragglers.

For the Four Corners feat, a trick is to allow 1 player to be KO'ed at each corner, reviving them but they must not rally until players are in position in all 4 corners, then rally to complete the feat.

sections.title: Story

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Warning: This section might contain spoilers!
Mera, wielding the Trident of Poseidon, leads Orm and the team through an undersea cave, hoping to be able to enter the Palace under the Crown of Thorns.
You are stopped by King Shark in the first chamber after the entrance, who intends to take the Trident and topple Corum Rath for himself and his people.

Note: Throughout this raid instance all group members will be swimming (a variation of flight/skimming). As such some movement mode abilities won't be able to be used unless you have special consumables ready.

sections.title: First boss: King Shark
items: Mechanics:

King Shark will have a red skull icon while looking at a random player in the group. King Shark will then swim/charge towards that player. If that player gets out of the way in time, King Shark may knockback all players in range and do moderate damage ( Thermochemical Detonation). If the player doesn't get out of the way in time, King Shark will charge and stun the player and do his Feeding Frenzy attack, dealing heavy damage over time and stunning the player, and will likely lead to a KO. It may also affect other players in close range. Be careful when trying to revive a player who has been KO'd by Feeding Frenzy, as King Shark's melee abilities may heavily damage or KO that player also.

Maelstrom: King Shark will spin around and around, dealing mild damage and some crowd control to affected players or pets. This will also spawn an underwater Whirlwind AOE which will travel around the map, and will do damage over time to any affected players it comes into contact with.

Sea-Touched Atlantean adds may spawn to assist King Shark in battle. These should be KO'd by the DPS as soon as possible, or in the elite version you can have two tanks and have one tank keep the adds together while the rest of the group focuses on King Shark.
Turbulent Roar: King Shark may sometimes do a roar cone attack in front of it. Does moderate damage.
Spinning Cyclone: King Shark may sometimes jump up and spin in the air. Does heavy damage at melee or mid range, especially in the elite version.
After defeating him, he will join your cause.

You discover the Crown of Thorns block the path even beneath the seafloor. However, Mera has the crystal retrieved by Aqualad and the players, obtained by defeating the Crown of Thorns Golem in Atlantis: The Silent School.

sections.title: Second boss: Construct and protect Thorn Golems
items: This isn't a boss encounter as such, but it will reward loot on each of the successfully constructed Thorn Golems (mostly the third and last one).

You must dig in the debris around the second chamber, and infuse the crystal with the roots (driftwood) of the Crown of Thorns, creating your own golem that can tunnel through the Crown, all the while fending off Drift soldiers. This process must be done for the third and fourth chambers as well. There is an orange restoration barrel in the northeast corner of the fourth chamber, hidden behind some red coral.

It is recommended especially in the elite version not to KO any Drift Soldier adds until after the Thorn Golem has reached the gate for the next corridor/chamber. This is because more Drift Soldier adds will spawn and aim to attack the Thorn Golem straight away (the tank/s will need to be focused and pull any newly spawned Drift Soldiers away from the Thorn Golem. If the Thorn Golem is knocked out you will have to start the process over again.

Note: There will be several areas in each chamber where you can interact with debris to find driftwood of the Crown of Thorns. It is completely random whether you will dig up nothing or one of the driftwood required to construct the Thorn Golem. The feat Four in a Row is completely RNG as a result.

Periodically during this process there will be onscreen text stating: "The Current Begins Rushing Through the Caverns". Blue water currents will push all players back, and force some Drift Soldier adds to block. The wall near where you entered the chamber will have Impaling Spikes, and if group members get pushed back too far those players will take damage from the spikes. In elite this will deal heavy damage and may KO. There is a low chance that a Jellyfish may be blown in on the current, and if this comes into direct contact with a player that player may be stunned and take moderate damage, followed by a mild damage over time.
In the final chamber, Mera confronts Murk, furious at his treachery against Arthur. Murk counters he is loyal to his king, Corum Rath, and orders guards to attack you.

sections.title: Last boss: Murk
items: Can be a tricky boss fight in both regular and elite versions, and may require two tanks for best success (especially elite).
Mechanics:
Drift Soldier adds may join the fight to assist Murk in battle. If they are KO'd more will spawn in their place.
There are certain adds that act as sub bosses: ' War Magus: Mechanics:
Dismay: Red sorcery AOE. Deals damage over time to affected players who are stood in it.
Bolt Barrage: (More info needed)
Coralmancer: Many of the Coralmancer's damage abilities are similar to Earth power themed bosses. It is best practice to block if you see a red skull icon above Coralmancer's head. Mechanics:
Grasping Hand: Coralmancer may grab a targeted player with a pink coral hand animation, stunning the affected player and dealing damage.

Upheaval: Coralmancer may have a red skull icon above its head, before firing quick coral shards in various areas of the map. Can do mild to moderate damage, but it is best practice if the group (especially non-tanks) block.
Tectonic Break: Coralmancer will have a red skull icon above their head before they lift into the air, spawning rocks around them. This may do considerable damage to players in range.
(More info needed)
Aquamancer:
Constrictor Pull: (More info needed)
Snake Bite: (More info needed)
(More info needed)

Mechanics: After some time and some of the sub bosses are defeated or at low health, Murk will join the fight. There will be onscreen text when this occurs, stating: "Murk Enters the Battle!". Murk: Mechanics:

Gut Hook: Similar to a Tankbuster. Murk will have a red skull icon above his head while looking at the player who has the most hate (usually the tank), and doing a 'Come on' emote. He will then deal significant damage to that player, followed by a milder damage over time. This attack will go through any shields the target has, so have this in consideration (especially in elite).

Battle Charge: Murk will punch the ground, grounding all players. He will then charge up to four times towards up to four random players in the group. If players are hit directly by this they will be knocked back and take significant damage (in elite for non-tank players it will likely KO).
Considerations for the elite version:

Two tanks are recommended, with one tank keeping the Aquamancer and other Drift Soldier adds well to the east side of the room, while the other tank takes War Magus and Coralmancer to the northwest of the room, and most of the group staying to the west side of the room.
Normally the group will KO both War Magus and Coralmancer before focusing on Murk, and minding mechanics in the process.
Voice chat may be recommended.
It may be best practice for the main group to block if adds spawn on the northwest/southwest of the room, until the tanks have the adds aggro'd.

After defeating him, he tells Mera to finish him, but she doesn't when Murk reveals he did not kill Aquaman; the latter is being kept, alive albeit injured and weak, in a back room, a sight even Orm reacts to in hopeful surprise. Mera places the trident over him to aid in his recovery, telling him he needs to rest before the upcoming battle.

title: Atlantis: Silent School
summary: Atlantis: Silent School is a Tier 5 Alert in Atlantis released in November 2018.

sections.title: Overview
items: Atlantis: Silent School is a Tier 5 Alert in Atlantis released in November 2018.
Access to Atlantis: The Silent School Normal mode requires a Combat Rating of 210; Casual version requires Level 15+. It rewards Source Marks.

sections.title: Story
items: Enter the mysterious Silent School with Aqualad and King Shark and find the Trident of Poseidon!

sections.title: Characters
items: Aqualad
King Shark
The Faceless One
Aquamancer
Coralmancer
War Magus
Zodiac Magus
Crown of Thorns Golem
Living Statue
Barnacle Golem
Coral Golem
Water Golem
Barnunculous
Crustacean Guardian
Crown of Thorns Vine
High Adept Banisher
High Adept Binder
Silent School Acolyte
Silent School Shade
Thorn Acolyte
Seahorse Display (Vendor)
The Combat Rating of the enemies is 258 for the episode and 243 for the event.

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Talk to Aqualad and take out the first room of Silent School Acolytes. Aqualad and King Shark will go off on their own route, leaving you to traverse the Silent School on your own.

For the first part of the instance, you have to go through several rooms, and they are random. There are also rooms consisting only of mobs for you to take out like in the first room; it is possible to get themed room but not having to do the themed challenge but only have to take out the mobs. You seem to get 2 random challenge rooms and 2 rooms with only mobs in a run.

sections.title: Gemini
items: Four coloured portals spawn Eyes of the Gemini that attack you (along with 2 untargetable Zodiac mages). You must interact with each portal to close them. It seems that you will get burned if your role doesn't match the portal color.
Blue: controller, green: healer, yellow: tank, red: damage
The red portal in the center can only be closed after the yellow, green, and blues ones are close.

sections.title: Cancer
items: You face the Crustacean Guardian. All players are turned into Brine Hatchlings with 3 abilities:
A biting basic attack
Taunt: Causes the Crustacean Guardian to follow you.
Cleansing Spray: Heals yourself.
In the first phase of the fight you must first interact with the mage (makes you snap at his ankles, distracting him), then the artifact in the center of the room.

You must push the right moonstone in the right shark statue's mouth by moving against it. There will be 3 moonstones, two are fakes but there doesn't seem anyway to tell other than trial and error (once an incorrect moonstone is used it turns into a stone ball so it is easy to tell apart).

The Crustacean Guardian only has one attack in this phase - a stomp Lethal attack that deals 25000 damage with massive knockback. Your Cleansing Spray can heal some 30000 health but it is a pretty long cooldown. However, the Crustacean Guardian moves slowly so as long as you keep moving he would have a hard time hitting you (a player should use Taunt to lure it away from other players attempting to put the moonstone in the right place). Gongs near the walls can also stun the Guardian temporarily.
After you succeed in placing the moonstone, you are turned back to normal and fight the Crustacean Guardian as normal.

sections.title: Pisces
items: The pillar in the center of the room is surrounded by 8 statues: 4 eel statues and 4 shark statues interspersed with each other.
Eel statues zaps you with lightning that can bounce to other players if you stand in front of them too long ( Lethal attack warned).
Each of the 4 shark statues will always be in one of 4 different states, in clockwise order:
Inactive (and therefore safe to stand in front of)
Spewing red Acidic Chum that deals damage over time (but also weakens the Living Statues that attack you, if you lure them into it)
Emitting a white Water Spray that pushes you away
Emitting a white Wind Vortex that pulls you in and then biting you

The 4 statues will rotate in states clockwise. The Wind Vortex statue will start using Water Spray, the one using Water Spray will start using Acidic Chum, the one using Acidic Chum will go inactive, and the inactive one will start using Wind Vortex. There is a timer in the center of the pillar indicating this (timer starts when the statues pause in creating hazards, and ends before they restart with a new hazard).
If you want to avoid those hazards, basically follow the red Acidic Chum clockwise around the room because whenever you see it from a statue, the next rotation that statue will be inactive.

sections.title: Aries
items: Barnunculous is the boss of this room. It is invulnerable at the beginning. You must defeat Barnacle Golems spawns in the room, pick up the crystals they drop, then smash it into the central crystal in the room, with the boss taking more damage with each crystal until you deal full damage. Barnunculous does a lot of damage with his ranged and melee attacks, and has a Lethal attack in which it rolls up into a ball and charges, dealing massive damage that could one-hit KO players.

sections.title: Crown of Thorns Golem
items: Mechanics:

Seismic Emission: The boss may look around and prepare to change phase (usually before the vine/shield phase). Players in close range of the boss will take moderate/considerable damage and may be knocked back.

The Crown of Thorns Golem will occasionally shield itself from all attacks and summon 2-4 Crown of Thorns Vine adds, which must be KO'ed to make the Golem targetable again. These vines may Swipe (or Primary Attack) nearby players, dealing damage and some knockback. If damage is high enough in the group it is possible to skip these phases altogether. When transitioning into this phase there will be onscreen text stating: "The Thorn Golem is calling forth vines from the Crown of Thorns!".
The boss may summon Thorn Acolyte adds to assist it in battle.

Timber: It has a Lethal attack in which its whole body flops to the ground, dealing heavy damage to all targets in front of it. The boss will initially face in the direction of its target and there will be a red arrow tell on the ground for a short time before it falls to the ground.
Gripping Vines: The boss may grab the target with his aggro with a vine, dealing moderate damage, stunning and grounding the affected player.
Once defeated, it sinks into the ground, forming a portal into the inner sanctum, as well as leaving behind a crystal. Aqualad would collect the crystal and deliver it to Mera as it may be useful.

sections.title: The Faceless One
items: Note: If there is a Controller in the group debuffing The Faceless One, along with decent damage, the artifact mechanics are optional and the group can focus on damaging and defeating the boss. If there isn't a controller, the group MUST do the artifact mechanics in order to progress through the boss encounter.

sections.title: Artifact mechanics:
items: There are three artifacts around the room:

sections.title: Dead King's Sword (south) -
items: While active, summons multiple images of Dead King's Sword that are mobile and attack you.
It must be sated by interacting with it, which will hit you for very close to your max health so you must be at full or you will be instantly KO'ed.
The damage is unaffected by Shield Powers, but using those are still very helpful as it prevents you from falling below your maximum from NPC attacks during the channel.
When this is active there will be onscreen text stating: "The Faceless One has activated the Dead King's Sword!", followed by: "The Sword demands one life in full to slake its thirst!".
Additionally there will be onscreen text stating: "The Dead King's Sword is spawning astral projections of itself!", and "The astral projection swords take more damage from other weapons!".

sections.title: Skull of Triton (west) -
items: While active, may mind-control players to attack other players (duration reduced by mashing left mouse button, or equivalent).
It can be destroyed as a normal attackable object.
When this is active there will be onscreen text stating: "The Faceless One has activated the Skull of Triton!", followed by: "The Skull commands allies to turn on one another!".
Additionally there will be onscreen text stating: "The Skull's effects can be broken by those with enough skill or by crossing over the Sigil of Protection!".

sections.title: Shield of Life (east) -
items: While active, summons invisible Veiled Threat adds.
Disabled by sacrificing health over time to it, not as dangerous as Dead King's Sword. Must be deactivated four times to permanently disable it. Self-damage unaffected by Shield Powers.
When this is active there will be onscreen text stating: "The Faceless One has activated the Shield of Life!" - followed by "The Shield requires life essence from willing supplicants!".

You must disable artifacts to prevent them from healing The Faceless One. There will be onscreen text for this at the start of the boss encounter: "Any artifact not currently used by the Faceless One will heal him!".

sections.title: Other mechanics:
items: The Sigil of Sight (large eye on floor, northwest) turns Veiled Threats into visible Silent School Shades (although they can be damaged normally while invisible).
Onscreen text pop-ups for this:
"Veiled Shades are being compelled by the Shield to attack!"
"Invisibile enemies can be revealed by using a Sigil of Sight!"
There is an orange restoration barrel just north of it.

The Sigil of Summoning in southwest binds some enemy golems to you, fighting for your team instead. There will be an onscreen tip stating: "Use the Sigil of Summoning to bind guardians to your will!".
The Faceless One himself fights with Hand Blast, summons Silent School mages, and has a number of special attacks:
Bolt Barrage: A rapid-fire barrage of projectiles, targeted at one player.
Call of the Deep: Rarely used, but deals extreme damage to all players.

Cosmic Energy: The Faceless One will periodically teleport from one part of the map to another player. On both occasions he will leave a cosmic AOE on the floor when he is about to teleport, and when he spawns at his destination he will spawn another cosmic AOE. These AOEs will be temporary but may deal damage over time.
The boss has various other projectile attacks, such as Soul Barrage and Soul Bolt. These do moderate damage to the affected player.

Guilty Verdict: One player will receive a curse with a blue water proximity marker. They will take damage over time and deal damage over time to other players close by. This can be cleansed by going to a sigil. There will be onscreen text when this occurs stating: "Those afflicted by the Curse can banish it with a sigil!".

Later in the boss fight, The Faceless One may summon Silent School Acolyte adds to assist him in battle. There will be onscreen text when this occurs, stating: "The Faceless One calls upon his students to redeem themselves!". Other adds may also join, such as Zodiac Magus, Crustacean Guardian, or Lesser Eye of Gemini.
Gripping Vines: The boss may grab the target with his aggro with a vine, dealing moderate damage, stunning and grounding the affected player.
Once you have defeated The Faceless One you have completed the alert.

items: " This is it, the final battle with the deadly usurper himself – Corum Rath! Everyone’s help will be needed in this fight to end his reign and restore Atlantis to its former glory, but be wary, for the mad king may have a big surprise up his sleeve!"
Corum Rath's descent into madness has made him a greater threat than ever. The time has come to confront him and restore Atlantis!

sections.title: Map
items: Note: Atlantis Throne Room and Ritual Feeding Chamber are 2 separated regions in the Atlantean Royal Palace map in Atlantis: Royal Palace. The name in the top right corner of the map interface depends on which part you are in.

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Fight through mobs until you reach the throne room where Corum Rath resides. Black Manta appears, infuriated that he has been robbed of his "destiny" of killing Aquaman; however, Aquaman, leading the players into the room, announces that the reports of his death has been exaggerated and challenges Corum Rath to battle. However, the latter dismisses him as unworthy and drops him and the team into the dungeon below. Black Manta follows and proclaims he would be able to kill Aquaman after all, but Corum Rath informs him that it is actually a feeding chamber - the Sea Beast appears and devours Black Manta.

sections.title: First boss: Sea Beast
items: The Sea Beast stays in the water near the edge of the platform, and can only be attacked when it is not submerged, which it does for several times throughout the battle, during which you must defeat other mobs. Corum Rath cannot be attacked at this point but he will cast spells to disrupt and damage you.
Mechanics:
Fish Breath: exhales a sickly green cone that stuns all players caught within.
Ground Slam: Slams the ground in front of it, and causes a tsunami to wash through the whole arena, both dealing heavy damage.

It can also drag players right in front of him from a large area, and trap those who don't breakout quick enough in green spheres. It would then devour one of those player and you must free them with one of the Ballistas in the area (interact with them, turn your camera so the target at the center of the screen is on the Sea Beast, then hit ability 1, the only available move in the Ballista ability tray). This will stun the Sea Beast for a few seconds, do 7219 damage (seems to be the same no matter what), then cause it to spit out the player. There are four Ballistas in the four corners, but depending on which side of the area the Sea Beast emerges, only the two further away from him are usable at each time.

When the Sea Beast is defeated, to Aquaman's great shock, Corum Rath raises Atlantis to the surface! Aquaman throws the Trident of Poseidon at Corum Rath, who catches it with his magic and shatters it.

sections.title: Last boss: Corum Rath
items: You must then fight Corum Rath directly in an epic battle in which he can summon several different bosses, including a resurrected Sea Beast, Morgwar, and many different mobs. The Sea Beast cannot be attacked, retains only his Fish Breath attack, and gains a charge attack in which it slides across the whole arena (briefly marked by a line of red arrows, but the area it hits is a lot larger than it indicates), dealing heavy damage to players it hits and knocking them back. There is an orange restoration barrel on the east edge of the arena, respawning about every 70 seconds.

Corum Rath would call upon the artifacts in the arena one by one with different effects, but all of them increase his defence until eventually all attacks only deal 1 damage against him (represented by swirling Zodiac signs around him). You must channel the Zodiac magic yourself to disable the artifacts one by one make him vulnerable again.

He always calls upon the artifacts in a certain order that begins with Sagittarius and ends with Aries, you can see him doing so when there is a brief beam of energy between him and the artifact. The Zodiac ones have a glowing Zodiac symbol above them when active.
Sagittarius's Chalice of Fire: Summons Flames of Sagittarius mobs that buff his attack if they get close to him.
Relic of the Abyssal Dark: Resurrects the Sea Beast.
Scorpio's Chalice of Water: Summons Morgwar, and again after some time if he is defeated.
Taurus's Shield of Life: Summons Risen mobs.
Virgo's Chalice of Earth: Does not seem to do anything in the event version.
Cancer's statue with moonstone: Corum Rath targets a player, and summons Brine Swarmers which will pile the target.
Aries's Skull of Triton: Completely unlike its behaviour in Atlantis: The Silent School, it cannot be directly attacked, and summons Barnunculous instead.

When Aries is invoked, you must kill the Barnuculous and use the crystals to deactivate Taurus, then defeat Risen Mobs until you can disable Scorpio, which allows you to put out Sagittarius, which allows you to scorch Virgo, which allows you to halt Cancer, which allows you to stop Aries, and finally the Abyssal Dark artifact must be interacted from 3 sides to render Corum Rath vulnerable.
All of those actions must be done in order, but despite what Mera says, it does not need to be done with the same players, once step 1 is done any player can do step 2.

When Corum Rath's health is fully depleted, he attempts to evoke the Deep Gods in a last stand; with a final battle cry, Aquaman conjures a trident out of seawater, leaps and smites Corum Rath in a mighty blow that ultimately annihilated the usurper, and the pieces of the Trident of Poseidon come together and reforms anew in his hand.

sections.title: Story
items: Lex Luthor’s plans have finally come to fruition and they're not good for anyone. Battle Luthor in the heart of his volcano and discover the world-killing threat he’s been working towards this entire time!

sections.title: Locations
items: LexCorp Volcano Base

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: The raid starts with your group rendezvousing with the Birds of Prey, Superman, Supergirl and Oracle inside the volcano, ready to take on Lex Luthor.

Once inside and after a cutscene the fight commences with the raid group fighting a few waves of robot adds. Some of them may spawn lava AOEs that players must avoid or they will take considerable damage over time.
After a short cutscene, Lex Luthor joins the fight.
First boss: Lex Luthor
Note: This is a brief boss encounter and does not drop loot.
Mechanics:
Rocket Launcher: Lex Luthor will fire several rockets in front of him. These do significant damage to affected players if they are hit directly, but can be easy to avoid.
Adds will spawn to assist Lex Luthor in battle. ( Pulverizer)
Lava AOEs may spawn. These should be avoided or affected players will take considerable damage over time.

After Lex Luthor is down to 90% of his health, he will stop the fight and there will be a cutscene where he will spawn Brimstone (the real first boss), who will attack the group. Lex Luthor will seemingly team up with the group to defeat Brimstone.

sections.title: First boss: Brimstone
items: A relatively straightforward boss encounter in both regular and elite versions.
Recommended roles for elite: 5 DPS, 1 Controller, 1 Heal, 1 Tank

A tank is highly recommended for the regular version as well, as many of Brimstone's attacks hit hard but focus towards the player who is nearest (proximity aggro). This will make things more convenient for the group when doing mechanics. It is preferred for the tank to be positioned near the entrance of the room and nearer to Brimstone than other group members, so that there is no risk of Brimstone firing his most powerful attacks towards other group members doing the turret/shield mechanics.
Mechanics:

Pool of Lava: There will initially be one Pool of Lava AOE in the middle of the room to start off with, however they will spawn more widely around the room as the fight continues. If a player is stood in this they will take considerable damage over time, especially in the elite version. Later in the fight these will spawn via a small volcano animation tell. Superman will use his Freezing Breath ability to cool down areas of the room to create safe zones in between the lava AOEs.

Fireball Spread: Brimstone will lift his hands in the air and throw several fireballs around the room. Affected players will take moderate damage if they are hit directly, but they are quite easy to avoid.

Spike Wave: Brimstone will have a red skull icon above his head, before punching the ground and spawning a series of lava spikes in a cone in front of it. Affected players will take considerable damage (massive damage in the elite version) and will be knocked back.

Flames of Apokolips: Brimstone will have a red skull icon above his head, before motioning his hands in front of him and producing powerful flames in a cone in front of it. Affected players will take very heavy damage, and may be stunned and knocked back. In elite this will KO non-tank players, and even a tank will take heavy damage from this.
Meteor Strike: Brimstone may spawn several meteors from the floor that will rise up and then land as a meteor shower. Affected players will take major damage.

Fire Boulder: Brimstone may roll fire boulders around the map at various enemy targets. Affected players will take damage and be knocked back. (This may also appear in the combat log as Boulder Hurl). (This may also be addressed in the combat log as Firestorm)
Upheaval: Brimstone will lift his hands in the air, creating a small rock storm and potentially stunning and lifting nearby players in the air also, dealing damage.
Primary Attack: Brimstone may punch down on the ground towards its target (initially with its left hand), dealing damage. He may do another similar ability called Ground Slap.

Lava Ebb: Brimstone may spawn a lava tidal wave towards targets in front of it, dealing moderate to considerable damage. The initial impact may knock back affected players, and the second impact is more likely to deal damage. There is a similar ability with a smaller tidal wave of lava called Lava Flow which may also occur.
Grasping Hand: Brimstone may grab his target with lava rock hand formations. This will deal considerable damage over time to the affected player. Preferably the tank should take this damage.

sections.title: Apokoliptian Shield mechanic
items: For much of the boss encounter, Brimstone will be considerably defence buffed. There will be multiple phases where some players will need to activate turrets in order to get rid of the Apokoliptian Shield that is causing this defence buff.
On the first phase, the group will need to repair the turret control systems while minding other mechanics.

On each phase, Brimstone's Apokoliptian Shielding will be at 100%. Up to 3 players (preferably 3) will need to get inside the turret control systems and shoot at Brimstone until the Apokoliptian Shielding is gone. With successful impacts from the turrets, the Apokoliptian Shielding should go down 10% at a time.

When the Apokoliptian Shielding is gone, any players in a turret will be automatically removed from their turret form and return to normal, allowing them to fight Brimstone directly while he is vulnerable.

On the second and last phases, the Birds of Prey will need to get the power back online so that the turrets can be used again. Once the power is back online, there will be a communicator pop-up from Huntress confirming this (in the second phase) and you will be able to use the turrets again. Up to 3 players can then use the turrets to get rid of the Apokoliptian Shielding.

After Brimstone is defeated, Lex Luthor absorbs his power to become Alpha Lex Luthor and turns on your group, which most predicted would happen. Jimmy Olsen turns up in one of Lex Luthor's war suits to assist the team, however Lex Luthor has control of the war suits and uses Jimmy Olsen to his advantage.

sections.title: Last boss: Alpha Lex Luthor
items: A fairly straightforward boss encounter in the regular version. Should be straightforward in the elite version, although easy deaths are possible from various mechanics which may cause issues for some groups.
Recommended roles for elite: 5 DPS, 1 Controller, 1 Heal, 1 Tank

A tank is highly recommended for the regular version as well, as many of Alpha Lex Luthor's attacks (even Jimmy Olsen's attacks) hit hard but focus more towards the player with the most hate. This will make things more convenient for the group when doing mechanics.
Mechanics:
Overarching mechanics for the boss encounter:

Rocket Launcher: Alpha Lex Luthor will fire several rockets in front of him. These do significant damage to affected players if they are hit directly, but can be easy to avoid. There is a low chance these may affect players directly while they are in the turret form. (This may also be addressed as Rocket Barrage in the combat log)

Mining Robot adds may spawn to assist Alpha Lex Luthor in battle. They may spawn lava AOEs ( Pool of Lava) via a Laser Beam, which players should avoid or they will take considerable damage over time.
As the boss encounter continues, more adds may spawn to assist Alpha Lex Luthor in battle ( Arachnobot, Security Robot, Pulverizer)
Source Beam: Alpha Lex Luthor may look down on his target and fire a beam at it, dealing damage over time to the affected player.

sections.title: Controlled Jimmy Olsen
items: While Controlled Jimmy Olsen is active in the boss encounter, Alpha Lex Luthor will be shielded in the air and invulnerable to damage from the group.

Surface Strike: Jimmy Olsen may root a targeted player and then spawn an orbital strike on that player. The affected player should break out of the root effect as soon as possible and evade damage from the orbital strike or they will take damage. In the elite version this does massive damage and may cause a KO.

The turrets from the last boss encounter will be able to be used again here, but they will now be regarded as LexCorp Sonic Turret. Once again preferably 3 players should go into them and once in the turret form, shoot the first 2 abilities towards Jimmy Olsen. It may be preferred for the tank to keep Controlled Jimmy Olsen nearer the middle so he can be hit by the Sonic Turrets, as he won't be affected if he is too far away.

Jimmy Olsen's Control Override will start at 0%. Upon successful impact by the Sonic Turrets, the Control Override will go up by 20%. Once the Control Override is at 100% Jimmy will be freed from Lex's Control.

There are two phases with Jimmy Olsen being controlled. There will be onscreen text when the second phase starts (when Alpha Lex Luthor is at approximately 70% health), stating: "Lex Luthor takes Control of Jimmy's Warsuit!". This onscreen text pop-up also occurs before starting this boss encounter, or directly after the cutscene following Brimstone's defeat.

During the second phase, the group will need to help the Birds of Prey hack the turret controls in order to progress through the boss encounter. There will be consoles around the edge of the room, and in a certain order some of these will have an intractable icon with a timer that players will need to interact with. If one of these is missed the group will have to start this particular phase again until either they wipe or they successfully interact with each console again and hack the turret controls. Once the turret controls have been successfully hacked, 3 players will need to go into the turrets to free Jimmy Olsen from Lex's control.
There will be onscreen text pop-ups for various Birds of Prey members when they hack their consoles respectively: "Poison Ivy Hacked her Console!", "Oracle Hacked her Console!"
Towards the very end of the boss encounter, Alpha Lex Luthor will retake control of Jimmy's Warsuit, however Alpha Lex Luthor will still be active in the boss encounter.

Once Jimmy Olsen is freed from Lex's Control, there will be onscreen text stating: "Jimmy freed from Lex's Control! Lex is attacking!". Any players in a turret will automatically be returned to their normal form and can resume the fight against Alpha Lex Luthor.

sections.title: Alpha Lex Luthor
items: Source Ring: Alpha Lex Luthor will have a red skull icon above his head, while a white ring tell appears in front of him. Alpha Lex Luthor will then attempt to pull all players in range towards the centre of the ring tell. Affected players will take moderate damage. In the elite version it is best practice to block this, especially with other mechanics ongoing.
Power Suit Blast: Alpha Lex Luthor may charge at his target, impacting them and spinning around. This deals significant damage and may knock back affected players.

Alpha Lex Luthor will have a red skull icon above his head, before spawning a Source orbital AOE on his target. Should be fairly easy to avoid, but does considerable damage if the player is hit directly. (More info needed)
Excessive Blast: Orbital Strike AOE, very similar to Jimmy Olsen's Surface Strike. Avoid or it will deal massive damage.
Later in the boss encounter, Alpha Lex Luthor will enhance the adds assisting him in battle with Source Energy, increasing their size and damage towards the group.
When Alpha Lex Luthor is at low health, he will spawn an optional sub boss ( Source Powered Arachnobot Mk 2) to assist him in battle.
Once Alpha Lex Luthor is defeated you have completed the raid.

sections.title: Trivia
items: Lex Luthor is revealed to have harnessed Apokoliptian technology to gain the power of Source energy. He was an ally on Apokolips in Darkseid's War Factory, where Darkseid is also mentioned to be attempting to gain access to the Source, and Darkseid, Terror of the Universe (Investigations) includes an excerpt of Luthor's own ambitions on the Source. The Source Wall was cracked at the end of Metal Pt. II: Into the Dark Multiverse, releasing the Source energy into the universe.

Lex Luthor uses Source energy to become Alpha Lex Luthor, a nod to his half-Martian form, Apex Lex, in DC's Year of the Villain event. In the comic book event, Lex blew himself up in his tower to prove his devotion to Perpetua so be could help her ascend to power. This is similar to how, in the game, the Birds of Prey episode indirectly leads to Perpetua's rise in Legion of Doom (Episode).

During the Brimstone boss encounter, if a player uses a turret and focuses damage towards your NPC "ally" Lex Luthor, they will deal damage to him and give that player considerable extra damage on the scoreboard. This will stop once Lex Luthor is depleted of his health. This does not have any impact on the rest of the raid as you still have to fight his Alpha form later with full health.
