sections.title: Story
items: You’ve received a distress call from Oracle! Lex Luthor has initiated a direct attack on her safe house, the Gotham City Clock Tower, and has taken control of Oracle's security measures, turning them against her. Get to the Clock Tower and protect Oracle from her own technology and from a new danger even she never saw coming!

sections.title: Characters
items: Black Canary
The Huntress
Harley Quinn
Poison Ivy
Catwoman
Reprogrammed Oracle-Bot
The enemy combat rating is 304.

sections.title: Locations
items: Gotham Clock Tower

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: The raid begins with the group navigating through the Clock Tower, defeating ORCL bot add mobs along the way. One notable nuisance in the mobs is the Trap Drones, which can target a player and prevent them from using abilities for a significant period of time. They do not otherwise attack or move. These can be evaded if the player stays far enough away and doesn't activate them (there is a feat for this in the elite version), but this is tricky for the entire group to pull off for the entire raid.

Eventually you will encounter Black Canary, The Huntress, Poison Ivy and Catwoman having a disagreement in a bigger room. Depending on your faction you will either fight Poison Ivy and Catwoman as heroes, or Black Canary and The Huntress as villains.

sections.title: First boss: Poison Ivy and Catwoman
items: A fairly straightforward boss encounter in the regular version. In the elite version, Catwoman's attacks can hit tanks quite hard, and if the group isn't positioned well easy KOs are possible.
Some groups may prefer two tanks for this boss encounter in the elite version, as if the two bosses are close together they will buff each other.
Recommended roles for regular: 4-5 DPS, 1 Controller, 1 Healer, 1-2 Tank. Recommended roles for elite: 4 DPS, 1 Controller, 1 Healer, 2 Tanks.
Mechanics:
On PS, Hold R1 to Block

Both Poison Ivy and Catwoman (or the Huntress/Black Canary for villains) must be defeated at a similar time or they will rally one another. There will be onscreen text after one of them is defeated, stating: "They'll stand back up if you don't defeat both of them within a few seconds of one another!".

It is also recommended to keep them separate, which is why for some groups two tanks are preferred. There may be an onscreen text pop-up stating: "They're more defensive when close together. Separate them!".

There may be times where the bosses need to be moved together to mitigate attacks toward the group. There will be onscreen text when this occurs, stating: "They're in a fighting frenzy! Bring them close together to end it!". Both Poison Ivy and Catwoman will receive a red aura which will boost their damage, especially in the elite version. This buff ends when they are brought close together.
Poison Ivy
In the elite version, focus on lowering Poison Ivy first.
Entangling Vines: Poison Ivy will have a red skull icon above her head, before unleashing vines on players in range. Affected players will take major damage.
Strangle Root: Poison Ivy will plant a plant root on her target, dealing mild damage over time to the affected player.
Catwoman

It is best practice especially in the elite version for non-tank players to block when Catwoman has a red skull icon above her head. She may do her Whip Flurry attack towards other players in the group. This will do massive damage or even KO in the elite version if non-tank players affected were not blocking.

Whip Flurry: Catwoman will have a red skull icon above her head while doing a 'Come on' emote. She will then do a scratching animation in front of her. Players affected will take multiple ticks of considerable damage.
Caltrops Storm: Catwoman will occasionally drop spikes/shurikens on the ground, creating an AOE. Affected players will take considerable damage over time, so avoid these where possible.
Whip Pull: Catwoman may use her whip to pull her target, dealing moderate damage to the affected player.
Other mechanics:

Trap Drone adds may spawn in the fight and stun/ground players, potentially in some cases causing affected players to lose their abilities for a time. Try to stay away from these where possible. (These can be turned off if players in the group have their Birds of Prey Adaptive Augments levelled)

sections.title: ORCL Discharge Drone add mechanic (Elite only)
items: ORCL Discharge Drone adds will spawn to assist the bosses in battle. These should be KO'd by the DPS in the group as soon as possible.

Each ORCL Discharge Drone add will target a random player with a green arrow, then after a while that player will drop an electric AOE on the ground. This AOE does major damage over time to affected players ( Electrobeam).

Ensure that if you are targeted with a green arrow that you place the electric AOE around the edges of the room, and not in the middle of the room. This mechanic is a damage/positioning check on the group.

sections.title: Allied NPCs: The Huntress, Black Canary and Harley Quinn
items: You will also have to avoid your allied NPCs' attacks.
There may be an onscreen text pop-up stating: "Your allies are a bit overzealous. Watch out for their big attacks!".
The Huntress

Arrow Storm: The Huntress will have a red skull icon above her head, before firing arrows in front of her. Does considerable damage to affected players in front of her, so watch your positioning. (In the combat log in the hero version, it implies that the player is attacking themselves with Arrow Storm, but it is The Huntress hitting the affected player)
The Huntress may have a Huntress Turret that will assist her in battle. While The Huntress is overzealous, her turret may hit group members with an Electric Arrow, dealing mostly mild damage.
Black Canary
Sonic Shriek: Black Canary unleashes a sonic blast that damages and knocks back all nearby targets.
Sonic Stun: Warned by lethal attack icon. Black Canary points at a direction before screaming in a cone that constantly stuns, pushes back, and deals heavy continuous damage to all caught within.
Harley Quinn
Harley Quinn may do a doom spin attack, which may knockback nearby players (more info needed)

Once Catwoman and Poison Ivy have been defeated at a similar time, the Birds of Prey will re-focus on the mission and the group will proceed up an elevator. Once up the elevator, the group will fight through more ORCL drones before getting to a lab room, where a Security Sequence is required to proceed.
Security Sequence

There will be various monitors with symbols that can be interacted with in a limited time. On the main monitor to the west of the room, this will show a sequence of symbols. The group must correctly get the correct matching symbol from the various monitors around the room to match the symbol displayed on the west monitor. If the group interact with the wrong symbol, or don't activate any symbols in time, the sequence will be incorrect and the group will have to start again.

Meanwhile, ORCL add waves will swarm into the room, so the tank will need to keep aggro of these, with maybe a DPS helping defeat them, while the rest of the group focus on getting the sequence right to proceed further into the Clock Tower.

Once six symbols have been matched correctly with the main monitor, the group will be able to proceed through the next room, up the stairs and to a Reprogrammed Oracle-Bot. (the group may defeat the ORCL adds spawned during the security sequence but this is optional)

sections.title: Last boss: Reprogrammed Oracle-Bot
items: A fairly challenging boss encounter for a regular raid by DC Universe Online standards. The elite version of this boss encounter is even more difficult and likely one of the most complex boss encounters in the game. That being said, experienced players or players familiar with the mechanics may have little issues with this boss once they know the mechanics and positioning. The DPS will be expected to be competent and not reliant on channel abilities for best success, especially in the elite version.
In the elite version voice chat may be recommended for best success, especially if group members aren't familiar with the mechanics or positioning required.
Recommended roles for regular/elite: 5 DPS, 1 Controller, 1 Healer, 1 Tank
On PS, Hold R1 to Block
On PS, Hold Square to Lunge
Mechanics:

sections.title: Exostatic mechanic:
items: Exostatic: A short while after you enter the room, you will be turned blue or red. If a blue player and a red player are near each other, constant shockwaves will deal massive unblockable damage to the whole room. There will be onscreen text for this stating: "Stay away from anyone with the opposite charge!". (In the combat log, this will display as the player's name of the player who is an opposite color to you and too close, and their Exostatic is dealing damage to you)

To prevent this, you must arrange for players of each colour to be in separate areas, e.g. before going in, agree that "red players go south/left, blue players go north/right". She will also randomly change some of your colours when she falls below 75% and 50% (possibly more times) health. In elite, colors change much more often, therefore instead of clustering in two groups, all players must maintain sufficient distance from every other player. When a player changes colour, they will be stunned.

If a player with blue/red is KO'd, they can still arc damage to the rest of the group if a player with the opposite colour moves close to them. As such, ensure that if you are reviving players that you are the same colour as the fallen player.

Exobyte Overcharge: (Elite only) Starting when she reaches 66% health, the boss will arc a white beam to all players, and then shortly after pools of the opposite color will be generated beneath every single player. If you are blue, a red pool appears beneath you and vice versa. If you are in an opposite color pool, this causes constant massive raidwide damage, so dodge right away. (More info on this below)
Magnetic Distortion: Warned by Lethal attack icon. She pulls in all targets in a large area. Block when you see the skull to avoid being pulled to the other side and triggering Exostatic.
While she is under 50% health, she may randomly teleport a single player right on top of her. Run away quickly once teleported to avoid triggering Exostatic or Exobyte Overcharge.

sections.title: Other mechanics:
items: Electric Discharge: She spins around shooting a barrage of electric sparks, which could deal heavy damage if you are next to her.
Exoblast: A shockwave that hits the whole room, but only once and not constantly. There is a similar ability to this called Shockwave.
Electrosurge: The boss will target a player with a shock, dealing considerable damage, and stunning and grounding the affected player.
Shock: The boss may have a red skull icon above her head while facing her target, before giving them an electrical shock. This deals damage over time to the affected player (usually the tank).
Energy Beam: The boss may target the player with the most hate with a beam, dealing damage. This beam may arc to other nearby players or pets.

sections.title: ORCL Pulse-Bot
items: Later in the boss encounter, an ORCL Pulse-Bot will spawn to assist the Reprogrammed Oracle-Bot in battle.

This robot will try to raise its hand in the air. When it does this, players should carefully lunge or stun the ORCL Pulse-Bot to interrupt it, without triggering Exostatic to other nearby players of the opposite colour. If the ORCL Pulse-Bot isn't lunged, stunned or CC'd, they will use their Electric Boom ability, dealing considerable raidwide damage (especially in the elite version).
Defeat this add as soon as possible, especially if you are positioned nearer to the add.

In the elite version two ORCL Pulse-Bots will spawn in different parts of the room, and one of the ORCL Pulse-Bots will spawn with a shield generated by two ORCL Shield Drone adds. This is a considerable damage check, as the ORCL Shield Drones will need to be defeated as soon as possible so the tank can pull the ORCL Pulse-Bot to the middle, and stop it from using its Electric Boom ability. Make sure Orbital Strikes/big supercharges/allies are saved for these ORCL Shield Drones as this part of the boss encounter can be make or break for the group even if the group is comfortable with the other mechanics.

sections.title: Exobyte Overcharge - How to position (Elite only)
items: Positions:
Tank: You will be positioned in the middle of the room, with the boss.
Controller: You will be positioned at the bottom (east) of the room, either near the entrance or either side of the entrance to the room. Make sure you are close to the wall/barrier.

Heal: You can be positioned wherever, as long as you have sufficient distance from other players. Make sure that you are positioned close to the wall in the room. It is unlikely besides the beginning of the boss encounter that you will be able to spam Castor's Watch via an equipped Eye of Gemini artifact to provide nearby players with additional supercharge regeneration due to the mechanics of the fight, so focus on pure healing and make sure the group stays alive, as there will be a lot of damage being dealt to the group at various points during the boss encounter.

DPS: Position in any remaining available spots where there is sufficient space between you and other players. Preferably there should be enough DPS on either side of the room (left or right) depending on where the ORCL Pulse Bots spawns later, especially the one with the shield drones. All DPS should be positioned close to the wall. Make sure you can target the boss and that your damage is competent but specifically max range damage, preferably not relying on channel abilities. You may have to stop damage in order to focus on placing your pool in the correct location, however some confident players may still be able to place pools while damaging the boss by target locking the boss (On PS, Hold L1 to target lock)
When the boss gives all players a white beam, prepare to place an opposite colour pool. It may be best practice to block around this time as the boss may use her Magnetic Distortion ability.
Once an opposite colour pool is placed, all players should then move to the right of where they were standing previously.

The second time players place an opposite colour pool, they will need to stand in front of the pool for a short time, and the first pool they placed will disappear, allowing a safe spot for the player to return to their original position once that first pool disappears. Ensure that there is sufficient space between you and other players so that you can place pools perfectly in this cycle over the boss encounter. If players are too close or you and place pools too close to you or another player, note that this may cause issues later.

This process will then start again and continue for the remainder of the boss encounter. Note that after the player has returned to their original position and then places their third opposite colour pool, they will need to stand slightly in front of it, wait for the second pool they placed to disappear, and then return to that position near the wall. There is a chance your colour may get changed so have this in mind also.

Remember, you can stand in a colour pool the same colour as your character, but you can't stand in an opposite colour pool to your character. Remember also if any players are KO'd, that they can only be revived by a player with the same colour. This needs to be taken even more into consideration with the Exobyte Overcharge mechanic in the elite version.
Some groups may prefer to go into the boss encounter with less players on purpose, so the Exobyte Overcharge mechanic is less of an issue despite the boss fight likely taking longer.
Once you have defeated Reprogrammed Oracle-Bot, Oracle will regain control of the robot and you have completed the raid.
*This walkthrough is not yet complete, and is subject to future updates.

sections.title: Trivia
items: Upon defeating the Reprogrammed Oracle-Bot, the song " Make Me", sung by Black Canary, plays. It is the second song with lyrics in the game, after "Sea Shanty" in Metal Pt. II: Damage Control.

The Leaderboard in this raid sometimes display a player to have healed tens of millions of damage, even if they are not healer and has used no healing abilities. This is likely due to smashing health barrels.
In a cutscene, Black Canary refers to Reprogrammed Oracle-Bot as Kill Bot 3000. This may be an easter egg to the Kill Bot 3000 boss encountered during the Earth 3: The Escape raid.
The Exobyte Overcharge mechanic in the last boss encounter was originally in the normal (and at the time event) versions of this raid, however it was later taken out.

The feats Network Hackery and Network Restoration are only available depending on what faction version of the raid you are in. This is one of the only pieces of content in DC Universe Online that if players want both of these feats they will need to access both their own and the other faction version of the raid. For example heroes accessing the villain version of the raid, or villains accessing the hero version of the raid, as well as their own respective faction versions.

title: Brainiac: Hall of Justice
summary: Brainiac: Hall of Justice is a Tier 6 Raid in the Brainiac Returns episode. It also features Casual, Elite, and Elite Plus versions.

sections.title: Overview
items: Bizarro Sample
Brainiac: Hall of Justice is a Tier 6 Raid in the Brainiac Returns episode. It also features Casual, Elite, and Elite Plus versions.

sections.title: Story
items: Brainiac knows that his previous failure is tied to the Justice League and has invaded the Hall of Justice. Meet with Superman and help restore order!

sections.title: Characters
items: Superman
Oracle
Booster Gold
Red Tornado
Supergirl
Reprogrammed Oracle-Bot
Martian Manhunter
The Flash
Green Lantern (John Stewart)
Hawkgirl
Green Arrow
Brainiac

sections.title: Locations
items: Hall of Justice

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: You begin the raid by meeting Superman in the Hall of Justice, before navigating through a few corridors and take out several Brainiac enemies. Eventually you meet a Controlled Justice League Member in a bigger room.

sections.title: First boss: Controlled Justice League Member
items: This boss encounter is highly variable depending on which Justice League member you get, and you will only get one per raid run. It also depends on whether you allow Brainiac Constructor adds to spawn a Brainiac Avatar in battle as a second boss. As such there will be multiple variations of this boss encounter that will differ each time.
You will get one of the following Controlled Justice League members as the boss encounter: Booster Gold, Red Tornado, Supergirl. More information below.
Recommended roles for Normal/Elite: 5 DPS, 1 Controller, 1 Healer, 1 Tank
On PS, Hold R1 to Block

sections.title: Overarching mechanics (regardless of which Justice League member is the boss)
items: Exploder Bot adds will spawn to assist the Controlled Justice League member in battle. They may jump a few times while having a small red AOE tell underneath them. If players are too close when this happens the Exploder Bot will explode ( Shatter), dealing large damage and possibly KOing affected players, especially in the Elite version.

sections.title: Sub-Avatar mechanic (optional)
items: Brainiac Constructor adds will spawn with a yellow electric icon above their heads, and will try to build a Brainiac Sub-Avatar. These should be defeated or at least pulled away from the Brainiac Avatar (in progress) to stop a Brainiac Avatar from being constructed.

Oracle will communicate several times depending on the progress of the Sub-Avatar construction. First, she will say "They're building something! Stop them!". Later she will say "Don't let them finish building that sub-avatar!". Finally she will say "They've almost built a sub-avatar - stop them!".

Finally, a Sub-Avatar will spawn to assist the Controlled Justice League member in battle if the group allows it to do so. Note that if this occurs, the Sub-Avatar MUST be defeated as well as the Controlled Justice League member in order to progress past the boss encounter, receive loot etc.

At the current time, only one Sub-Avatar will be spawned during the boss encounter. They will be tied to specific Controlled Justice League members. I will outline the three possible Sub-Avatar sub bosses below, and note that in the raid they will just be referred to as Sub-Avatar. Additionally the Sub-Avatars may vary in difficulty.

sections.title: Sub-Avatar: Avatar of Tech
items: Arguably the more difficult Sub-Avatar to defeat in all versions. In Elite this may be a very tricky boss encounter, where having a group with good situational awareness and high damage output will be key to success. Note also that there are no tells currently for its mechanics, but it is best practice where possible to stay behind the Sub-Avatar and use the equipment around the room to keep out of line of sight of Sub-Avatar if appropriate. In Elite Plus it is even more difficult due to the Brainiac Constructor adds that spawn in each corner of the room and their Erratic Energy Field pool AOEs.
This Sub-Avatar will spawn if Booster Gold is the first boss encounter.

It is best practice to ensure Booster Gold has very little health when the Sub-Avatar joins the fight, and ensure that Booster Gold is defeated as soon as possible, as mechanic overlap will occur during this time (between all of Sub-Avatar's mechanics as well as Booster Gold's Stasis Field and Energy Blast mechanics) and may lead to chaotic mechanics for a while the longer Booster Gold is active while Sub-Avatar has spawned.

Flamethrower: Sub-Avatar will wave its arms and produce a flamethrower in front of it directly. This deals extremely heavy damage over time to affected players and may KO either from more than one tick of damage or directly to affected players. Standing behind the Sub-Avatar will provide the best chance of survival from this ability.

Missile Barrage: Sub-Avatar will ready its artillery and start firing rockets in front of it, rotating clockwise for approximately 200 degrees from its starting point. This deals extremely heavy damage. In Elite this will likely KO affected non-tank players unless players stay behind the Sub-Avatar while he is rotating and firing rockets, or players hide behind world projectors around the room and remain out of line of sight from the Sub-Avatar for the duration of this attack (or until it is safe to get near enough to the Sub-Avatar while it is looking the opposite direction).
Sweeper: Sub-Avatar will fly higher and aim down at its target, firing missiles that create a dust devil around the feet of the affected player. This deals heavy damage over time.

Charged Shot: Sub-Avatar will ready its artillery and focus on a particular player or ally NPC (yes this can include pets, henchmen, Grimorum Verum, Quislet, combat Allies etc.) The affected player will get a massive red marker above their head as well as a white ring on the floor around them. After approximately two seconds, they will take massive damage from this ability, and in Elite in many cases this will result in a KO for the affected player as well as nearby player/s, especially if not a Tank role. It is possible to evade this mechanic by using Phase Dodge at the right time to shield the impact, but even then this could be activated slightly too early, or Phase Dodge could be in cooldown and the player may get affected by this ability twice in succession. Note that after the initial impact, there will be a few seconds of missiles (this attack is also called Missile Barrage, not to be confused with the mechanic mentioned previously) on the target that was affected by Charged Shot, dealing very heavy damage over time. It is possible if timed right to use Phase Dodge on Charged Shot and then roll out of the missiles in time, surviving the mechanic.

sections.title: Sub-Avatar: Avatar of Meta
items: This Sub-Avatar will spawn if Supergirl is the first boss encounter. Players should stay max range of the boss.
Tentacle Slam: Sub-Avatar will slam its tentacles on the ground up to three times, dealing heavy damage to affected players.
Plasma Burst: Sub-Avatar will spawn an AOE with its tentacles, dealing heavy damage over time to affected players.

Meta Mega-Blast: Sub-Avatar will have a red skull icon above its head before firing a purple projectile towards a target player. This is easy to avoid, but if a player is hit directly it will deal massive damage (possibly KO non-tank players) and knock the player back.
Claw Strike: Sub-Avatar will stand on its back feet and use its front two feet to repeatedly stab the ground in front of it. This will deal heavy damage to affected players or allied NPCs.

Pull: Sub-Avatar will fire a white beam at a random player, pulling the player towards the boss. Does heavy damage in the Normal version and will KO in Elite and Elite Plus, especially if the player is a non-tank and/or isn't blocking. No tell for this mechanic currently. This happens irregularly during the fight, approximately once every 15 to 60 seconds, depending on how often Sub-Avatar is using its Tentacle Slam ability. In Elite Plus it is best practice for all group members to have the Super-Speed movement mode, have Phase Dodge specced and in their loadout, and use it just before Sub-Avatar turns around to use its Pull ability.

sections.title: Sub-Avatar: Avatar of Magic
items: Arguably the easier Sub-Avatar to defeat, at least in the Normal/Elite versions. Provided a tank has aggro of this boss when it spawns this shouldn't pose too many issues for most groups in Normal/Elite versions, and its attacks do very trivial damage to the group, namely but not exclusively in close range.
This Sub-Avatar will spawn if Red Tornado is the first boss encounter.

Pull: Sub-Avatar may produce purple/gold magic around it, attempting to CC and draw nearby players/allied NPCs in. Does moderate damage. Can be tricky in the Elite Plus version if Brainiac Constructor adds and their accompanying Erratic Energy Field AOEs are near the Sub-Avatar.
Fireball: Sub-Avatar may fire projectiles in front of it. Deals mild to moderate damage.
Luminous Burst: Sub-Avatar will unleash a magical shockwave to players/allied NPCs in melee/midrange, dealing moderate damage.

sections.title: Scenario 1: Booster Gold
items: Arguably the trickier boss encounter of the three in the Elite version due to his Energy Blast attack. Significantly more difficult if the group allow a Sub-Avatar to be spawned.
Mechanics:
Shatter: Booster Gold knocks back a targeted player/s, dealing heavy damage.

Energy Blast: Booster Gold prepares himself. There will be onscreen text stating: “Block Booster Gold’s Blast!”. Booster Gold will then unleash a gold shockwave. This will do large damage to players who aren’t blocking in the Normal version, however in the Elite version this will likely KO.

Skeets will assist Booster Gold in battle, but won't be able to be attacked by players. It may use Energy Blast in a direction, dealing large damage and knocking back affected players. Typically Skeets will spawn near the entrance, then move anti-clockwise around the room for the duration of the time Booster Gold is active during the boss encounter.
Graviton Blast: Booster Gold will fire a blue grenade at a target, which will explode into a blue cosmic AOE. Affected players or allied NPCs will take moderate damage over time.

Stasis Field: Booster Gold will stun several players, perhaps the entire group, with a dust animation. This will deal damage over time and the affected players will need to spam a button to breakout faster.

If the player allows the Brainiac Constructor adds to construct a Sub-Avatar, a Sub-Avatar (Avatar of Tech) will spawn to assist Booster Gold in battle. The fight will only finish when both Booster Gold and the Sub-Avatar are defeated in this case.

sections.title: Scenario 2: Red Tornado
items: Mechanics:

Tornado Pull: Red Tornado may spawn red tornado AOEs around the fight, which will deal considerable damage over time and may CC nearby affected players. This is more likely in the Casual and Normal versions of the raid.
Electric Field: Electric AOEs may spawn around the room. Affected players will take significant damage over time.

Flying Charge: Red Tornado may have a red skull icon above his head while standing in one spot, then will fly in the air while looking at a target player. Red Tornado will then charge into that player, dealing large damage and knocking back to the affected player if the player in question isn't blocking.
Shatter: Red Tornado knocks back a targeted player/s, dealing heavy damage.
Ranged Projectile: Red Tornado may fire electric projectiles in a cone in front of him, dealing mild to moderate damage to affected players.

If the player allows the Brainiac Constructor adds to construct a Sub-Avatar, a Sub-Avatar (Avatar of Magic) will spawn to assist Red Tornado in battle. The fight will only finish when both Red Tornado and the Sub-Avatar are defeated in this case.

sections.title: Scenario 3: Supergirl
items: Overheat: Supergirl will give a random group member a red proximity marker, which will produce orange shockwaves from the affected player. Other players who are in close range nearby to the affected player will take damage over time.
Ocular Burst: [More info needed]
Heat Vision: Supergirl will fire a red laser at a targeted player, dealing considerable damage.
Shatter: Supergirl knocks back a targeted player/s, dealing heavy damage.

Permafrost Breath: Supergirl may encase certain players in ice, and another player may need to break them out. Eventually the affected player/s will break out of the ice, but while affected the player may take moderate damage over time. If a player is encased in ice for a short while, they may be flung around the room while encased.

Leaping Smash: Supergirl may have a red skull icon above her head before blinking to a target player and dealing quick strikes, dealing considerable damage to the affected player if not blocked or evaded. This may occur several times in succession.

If the player allows the Brainiac Constructor adds to construct a Sub-Avatar, a Sub-Avatar (Avatar of Meta) will spawn to assist Supergirl in battle. The fight will only finish when both Supergirl and the Sub-Avatar are defeated in this case.

sections.title: Differences/considerations for Elite Plus:
items: For best results, if the group allow a Sub-Avatar (Avatar of Meta) to be constructed during the fight with Supergirl, all group members should have the Super-Speed movement mode, have Phase Dodge in their loadout, and use it just before the Sub-Avatar uses its Pull ability. Picking up a knocked out player who has been affected by Pull is very difficult in the Elite Plus version, and survivability is a must if the group is to defeat this particular Sub-Avatar.

Skeets is much more troublesome in the Elite Plus version if Booster Gold is the boss encounter, as its Energy Blast will KO affected players and it doesn't have much of a tell. It is best practice for players to be at the opposite side of the room to Skeets at all times, and ideally players should be in voice chat - especially if the players are going to allow a Sub-Avatar to be constructed.
If Red Tornado is the boss encounter, his Electric Field AOEs hit much harder than in other versions of the raid, and can KO players quickly if they stand in the AOE for slightly too long.

sections.title: Brainiac Constructor adds
items: Brainiac Constructor adds will have a purple pool AOE around them ( Erratic Energy Field). If a player gets affected directly by this they will take very heavy damage over time. Erratic Energy Field will also heal allied NPCs, such as Sub-Avatar or the Controlled Justice League member.
It is best practice to avoid standing in corners of the room where these are likely to spawn, and these should be defeated ASAP - especially while the group is fighting a Sub-Avatar.

These also add difficulty if the group allows a Sub-Avatar to be constructed. For example, the Sub-Avatar (Avatar of Magic) that spawns with Red Tornado may use its Pull ability to draw players to it - and if there are one or several Brainiac Constructor adds present nearby the affected group members will additionally take damage from Erratic Energy Field. These adds will also add further difficulty with the Sub-Avatar (Avatar of Tech) that spawns with Booster Gold, as the group will need to manage staying behind the Sub-Avatar while dealing damage to both the Sub-Avatar and especially any Brainiac Constructor adds that spawn.
After freeing the Controlled Justice League member, the group continue further into the Hall of Justice and take out more Brainiac enemies. Eventually the group encounters Reprogrammed Oracle-Bot.

sections.title: Second boss: Reprogrammed Oracle-Bot
items: A similar but significantly easier fight to the boss encounter in BOP: The Clock Tower raid, but with a few differences. Should be doable for most groups in both Normal and Elite provided mechanics are adhered to.
Recommended roles for Normal/Elite: 5 DPS, 1 Controller, 1 Healer, 1 Tank

sections.title: Exostatic mechanic
items: Exostatic: A short while after you enter the room, you will be turned blue or red. A blue player will also have a blue plus icon above their head, while a red player will have a red minus icon above their head. If a blue player and a red player are near each other, constant shockwaves will deal massive unblockable damage to the whole room. There will be onscreen text for this stating: "Stay away from anyone with the opposite charge!". (In the combat log, this will display as the player's name of the player who is an opposite color to you and too close, and their Exostatic is dealing damage to you)

To prevent this, players should maintain distance from other players who have a different colour to them. If a player with blue/red is KO'd, they can still arc damage to the rest of the group if a player with the opposite colour moves close to them. As such, ensure that if you are reviving players that you are the same colour as the fallen player.

Magnetic Distortion: Warned by red skull icon. She pulls in all targets in a large area. Block when you see the skull to avoid being pulled to the other side and triggering Exostatic. [This mechanic is used rarely especially if damage in the group is competent]

sections.title: Exostatic blast mechanic
items: After a time, Oracle Bot will have brief red skull icon and knock all players back, before becoming invulnerable for a time while having a shield. Oracle Bot will then prepare a powerful attack and have a red skull icon above her head.

There will be two batteries, one with a red pool and one with a blue pool. Players should go to their respective colour pools to remove the Exostatic from them. When this happens there will be onscreen text stating: “Discharge Exostatic at Batteries!” While Oracle will say in VoiceOver: “Get rid of your exostatic charge!”

If players do not get rid of the Exostatic in approximately 8 seconds Oracle Bot will unleash a powerful shockwave ( Exostatic Blast), which will do large damage to Exostatic affected players in the Normal version, and KO any Exostatic affected players in the Elite version.
After this phase is over Oracle Bot will remove her shield, but for approximately 7 seconds she will have buffed defence and will take mitigated damage from the group during this time.

sections.title: Reaver add mechanic [Elite only]
items: When Oracle Bot gets to approximately 20% health, a Positively Charged Reaver (with a blue pool) and a Negatively Charged Reaver (with a red pool) will spawn to assist the boss in battle.
These will spawn instead of the batteries, and should be defeated as soon as possible.

If the Reaver with a colour isn't defeated in approximately 8 seconds after the phase starts, all players with the corresponding colour will be KO'd by Exostatic Blast. For example if the Negatively Charged Reaver isn't defeated within the time frame, all players who have red Exostatic will be KO'd.
This mechanic acts as a heavy damage check, and is the most likely mechanic in the Elite version of the raid to cause KO's.

sections.title: Exostatic Projectile mechanic
items: Periodically while players are affected by Exostatic Oracle Bot will blink to the middle of the room and have a red skull icon. She will turn half of the room red and half of the room blue. Blue players should go to the blue side, and red players the red side.

Approximately 5 seconds after Oracle Bot will produce blue projectiles on the blue side and red projectiles on the red side. If a player is on the opposite side of the room (if they are red and in the blue AOE for example) they will take large damage and may be KO’d ( Exostatic Projectile), especially in the Elite version.

sections.title: Other mechanics
items: Typically after the Exostatic Blast/Battery phase, Oracle Bot will spawn several red AOE tells with electricity on the floor. If players are directly affected by this they will take major damage over time ( Environment’s Debris Field).
Differences/considerations for Elite Plus:
Periodically, an ORCL Pulse-Bot will spawn to assist the boss in battle. If it is not defeated or stunned it may use its Electric Boom ability, dealing considerable damage over time to the group.

After the Oracle Bot is defeated the group traverse through several more corridors and take out more Brainiac Robots, before encountering The Flash, Green Arrow, Martian Manhunter, John Stewart and Hawkgirl, who have all been controlled by Brainiac.

sections.title: Last boss: Controlled Justice League
items: Arguably the trickiest boss encounter in the episode due to various mechanics. With good adherence to mechanics, a competent healer (in Elite) and competent DPS this shouldn’t pose too many issues for experienced endgame players. Generally easier with 2 tanks in the Elite version, however it can be done with solo tank if the group is focused on mechanics.

Recommended roles for Normal: 5 DPS, 1 Controller, 1 Healer, 1 Tank. Recommended roles for Elite: 4-5 DPS, 1 Controller, 1 Healer, 1-2 Tanks. Recommended roles for Elite Plus: 4 DPS, 1 Controller, 1 Healer, 2 Tanks
On PS, Hold R1 to block
Overarching mechanics:

After a Justice League member has been KO’d, Healer Drone adds will spawn to assist the Justice League in battle. These should be defeated as soon as possible, otherwise they may revive a fallen Justice League member to approximately 60% health.

Exploder Bot adds will spawn to assist the Controlled Justice League members in battle. They may jump a few times while having a small red AOE tell underneath them. If players are too close when this happens the Exploder Bot will explode ( Shatter), dealing large damage and possibly KOing affected players, especially in the Elite version.

After one Controlled Justice League member has been defeated, red AOE tells may spawn on random players. These should be evaded or Green Arrow will use his Arrow Barrage, dealing some damage to affected players. This mechanic may occur on occasion during the remainder of the fight.

After two Controlled Justice League members have been defeated, The Flash may spawn tornado AOEs in the room. If a player directly interacts with this they will take significant damage over time and may lose access to their abilities. This does not have a mechanic name and implies The Flash is attacking the player directly in the combat log.

sections.title: Martian Manhunter:
items: For best results it is preferred that Martian Manhunter is defeated first, especially in the Elite versions. If there is a solo tank in the Elite versions then John Stewart will need to be defeated first, and therefore the below mechanics need to be adhered to perfectly by the group for best results.

Mind Control: Martian Manhunter will have a red skull icon above his head, and give several players a purple icon above their heads. There will be onscreen text stating: “Block if Marked by Martian Manhunter’s Mind Control!” If players with the purple icon do not block they will be mind controlled and will be unable to control their character for a time. Affected players will have their screen turned purple with Mind-Controlled near the bottom of the screen, while other players will be able to attack affected players.
Cold Breath: Martian Manhunter may do a cone AOE attack in front of him, dealing considerable damage over time to affected players.
Whirlwind Attack: Martian Manhunter will do a spinning attack. Does heavy damage to affected players/allied NPCs in melee range.

sections.title: Telepathic Assault mechanic
items: Oracle will state in VoiceOver: “Use that flamethrower to interrupt his psychic attack!”

Two Brainiac Pyro adds will spawn to assist the bosses in battle. These should be defeated as soon as possible, then interacted with by a player and the player should then use the flamethrower ability to interrupt Martian Manhunter.

While this is happening the group will be affected by Telepathic Assault, which deals significant damage over time, perhaps even large damage over time at certain points. The longer this DOT is active the greater challenge this will be for group survivability on top of other mechanics so it is imperative this mechanic is adhered to quickly. Once Martian Manhunter has been interrupted by the flamethrower ability the damage over time will stop.

sections.title: Hawkgirl:
items: Whirlwind Attack: Hawkgirl will have a red skull icon above her head, before preparing herself and then flying around in circles. This may CC players and draw them in (even from max range), and deal considerable damage over time.

Spike Wave: Hawkgirl will have a red skull icon above her head while having a red cone AOE tell in front of her. Players should avoid this area as shortly after Hawkgirl will produce spikes on the ground in front of her, dealing large damage and knockback to affected players.

Spinning Bash: Hawkgirl will have a red skull icon above her head before spinning towards a targeted player. This should be evaded by all players or it will do considerable damage if the player is too close to Hawkgirl for too long.

Flying Charge: Hawkgirl may have a red skull icon above her head while waiting briefly, before flying up in the air and looking at a target player (again having a red skull icon above her head). She will then swoop down and charge towards the targeted player/s. The targeted player/s should either block or evade this, or they will take very heavy damage, and most likely be KO'd in the Elite versions.

sections.title: John Stewart:
items: In the Elite version if there is a solo tank then John Stewart will need to be defeated first due to his shield mechanic.
Light Construct: John Stewart will raise his fist in the air and spawn spinning green hammers on all players. These do significant damage over time if players stand in them for too long.

John Stewart will shield anything in close proximity to him. This will mitigate damage from the group towards Hawkgirl and Martian Manhunter (where applicable), more so in the Elite version. In Elite if the group is running with solo tank for this fight, you will need to defeat John Stewart first. Otherwise, you will need 2 tanks to separate Martian Manhunter/Hawkgirl from John Stewart.
John Stewart will give a random player a red proximity marker with a green gas. If this player goes near other players the affected players will lose power. (more info needed)
Differences/considerations for Elite Plus:
Same as Elite, but with higher health/defence and weapon attacks from bosses.
Once you have defeated the Controlled Justice League and freed them from Brainiac's control you have completed the raid.

*Note: This walkthrough is not yet complete, and is subject to further updates. The Sub-Avatars in the Elite and Elite Plus versions have some balancing issues, and so there may be hot fixes to this later.

sections.title: Story
items: Brainiac has enough research now to know what went wrong and is in the process of learning from his mistakes. He wants to reset the timeline and create a new future where he is supreme. Meet Superman and Lex Luthor on Brainiac's Command Ship and bring the fight to Brainiac!

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: This raid takes place in a very similar instance to Brainiac’s Bottleship. You begin the raid by traversing through a couple of corridors alongside Superman and Lex Luthor and take out some Brainiac enemies. Eventually you enter a windowed area where you find Brainiac.

In general the raid is on the easier side for Normal and Elite versions currently, with high DPS burn and players blocking attacks and moving out of the way of AOEs as necessary this raid shouldn’t bring too many issues. Recommended group setup for Normal & Elite: 5 DPS, 1 Controller, 1 Heal, 1 Tank.

sections.title: 1st Boss: Brainiac
items: Fairly straightforward boss encounter in Normal & Elite versions, especially if group members have Rank 28 Bio-Genetic Booster augments equipped. In Elite the group should be cautious of Brainiac's Blink Smack mechanic as this may cause issues if the group isn't paying attention.
Mechanics:
Brainiac may spawn Red Sun Drone and Brainiac Replicant adds to assist him in battle. A Red Sun Drone add may stun a targeted player, leaving them unable to move or use their abilities.

When a Brainiac Replicant add is defeated they will leave a purple pool AOE on the floor that stays for the remainder of the boss encounter. If a player stands in this pool they will take damage over time [Brainiac Replicant Core’s Erratic Energy Field]

Periodically, Brainiac may spawn a Sentinel Shieldbot to assist him in battle. This add will shield Brainiac, mitigating all damage towards him considerably. Players will need to KO this add as soon as possible to remove the shield.

Blade Storm: Brainiac will have a red skull icon above his head briefly before firing three blade projectiles in a cone towards the group. These are easy to miss but if a player is hit directly and doesn’t block it may do large damage, possibly even KO in the Elite version.

Data Spikes: Periodically Brainiac will say “Witness my power!” In VoiceOver while having a red skull icon above his head, and he will brace himself. There will be onscreen text stating: “Block Brainiac’s Data Spikes!”. Shortly after he will raise his hand in the air and spikes will appear on the ground underneath all players in the raid. This will do large damage to affected players if they don’t block and will KO in the Elite version regardless of role. (Note that this shouldn't KO affected players who aren't blocking in Normal/Elite versions with near full health *if* they have both Bio-Genetic Booster augments equipped, with at least one but ideally both at Rank 28)

Logic Construct Cage: Brainiac may target a particular player and encase them in a cage. This does moderate damage and will stun the affected player. The player can use the R1 button to breakout of the cage.
Energy Hand Clap: Brainiac may target a particular player and interrupt the player with a clap animation. This does mild to moderate damage.

Blink Smack: Brainiac will have a red skull icon above his head while pointing at a particular player in the group. After a brief pause, Brainiac will blink to that player and punch the ground. The affected player should block or they will be knocked back and take large damage, possibly be KO’d in the Elite version.
Differences/considerations for Elite plus:

All players in the group MUST block Data Spikes regardless of augments. If even one player does not block this mechanic, all players will take massive damage and this will most likely cause a group wipe.

After Brainiac is defeated, he will flee to a different part of the ship. The group, Superman and Lex Luthor will then traverse through several more corridors and defeat several Brainiac robots along the way. Eventually you reach another windowed room with a security terminal that you will need to activate, which them prompts Brainiac to appear again and take control of Superman and Lex Luthor.

sections.title: 2nd Boss: Lex Luthor & Superman
items: Can be tricky for some groups if certain mechanics aren't adhered to, such as evading Superman's Heat Vision Blitz mechanic or avoiding AOEs.
Controlled Lex Luthor is fought first, with Controlled Superman doing mechanics in the background.
Overarching mechanics:

Red Sun Drone adds will spawn in the fight. These can be defeated and then activated to stun Controlled Superman, stopping him from using abilities on the group for a short time. They may also stun a particular player, leaving them unable to use abilities or move, including moving out of AOE mechanics.
Controlled Lex Luthor

Cosmic Explosion: Lex Luthor will have a red skull icon above his head before firing a series of cosmic projectiles around the map. If these impact a group member or any friendly NPC they will explode into an AOE, dealing damage over time to affected players. These should be easily avoidable.

Paradoxical Static: Lex Luthor will have a red skull icon above his head before unleashing a shockwave to those in close range. Affected players will then receive a green gas aura and will take considerable damage over time.

LexCorp Surface Barrage: Lex Luthor will have a red skull icon above his head before spawning several green tells with L logos on several players. Players should evade these or missiles will land on the affected areas, dealing significant damage over time to affected players.

LexCorp Healing Salve: Lex Luthor will have a red skull icon above his head before spawning a gas AOE on a target player/s. If these players are affected directly it will deal considerable damage over time and will likely KO if players have prolonged exposure to this.

LexCorp Toxic Resin: Lex Luthor will have a red skull icon above his head, before channeling a green beam towards a targeted player. Anyone caught in this beam will take damage over time, and may be slowed or stunned with green bubbles around their feet - these bubbles may also explode, dealing additional damage.
Power Suit Blast: Lex Luthor may charge towards a random player and spin around. This will deal large damage if a player is hit directly, especially if they aren't blocking.

Gravity Well: Lex Luthor will have a red skull icon above his head, before bestowing an astral aura on a targeted player, stunning them and dealing damage over time to the affected player. This astral aura will stay for a while, so the affected player should break out of it and evade it as quickly as possible to stop the damage over time.
Rocket Barrage: Lex Luthor will have a red skull icon above his head before firing rockets towards a target player or NPC, dealing large damage to the affected target.
Controlled Superman

These mechanics also apply while Controlled Lex Luthor is active in the fight:; Permafrost Breath: Controlled Superman will have a red skull icon above his head, before doing a 360 cone attack and using freezing breath on the group doing moderate damage. This can be blocked to mitigate damage and reduce the chance of getting encased in ice. In the Normal version if the player is encased in ice they can breakout themselves, (they will have a proximity marker while affected), however if other players are nearby they may be encased in ice following the breakout. In Elite another player will need to break the player out of the ice, either with melee weapon attacks or by picking up the encased player and smashing them on the floor. In Elite typically 3 players will get encased in ice during this mechanic.; Heat Vision Blitz: Superman will prepare an attack on a particular player and give them an orange proximity marker with a fire AOE. The player will need to move away from other players and the AOE, while the AOE tracks and follows the affected player for a time. If players stand too long in the AOE they will take large damage over time and may be prone to being knocked out in the Elite version in particular. (Note also that if a player is knocked out from this mechanic the AOE will linger over the fallen player for a short time, so players trying to revive the fallen player will need to have this in consideration so they don't get a heavy damage over time and potentially also get KO'd); Charge: Superman will have a red skull icon above his head and will point at a specific player in the group. After a brief pause Superman will charge that player. If the player isn’t blocking they will be knocked back and take large damage, and may be KO’d in the Elite version (especially if a non-tank role).

These mechanics only apply when Controlled Superman is the only boss left:; Super Flare: Superman will blink to the middle of the room and have a red skull icon above his head while charging up power. The first time this occurs in all versions there will be onscreen text stating: “Block to survive Superman’s Solar Flare!”, however in Elite this will only occur on the initial occasion. Superman will then unleash a blue/gold wave of energy. Any players not blocking will take large damage in the Normal version, and will likely be KO’d in the Elite version.; Whirling Arms: Superman will blink to another part of the room and raise his fist for a time, before creating a tornado with his arms. Players should lunge this and counter it before Superman does the attack, otherwise it will deal large damage to affected players and pull them towards Superman.; Super Slam: Superman may have a red skull icon above his head, then after a short pause he will punch the ground, dealing heavy damage to affected players/allied NPCs in melee/midrange.; Focused Blast: Superman may fire a gold laser at a random player or ally NPC (including pets/henchmen etc.). Deals heavy damage.
Differences/considerations for Elite Plus:
All players in the group MUST block Controlled Superman's Super Flare mechanic. If even one player does not block this attack, this will cause a group wipe.

Once Superman and Lex Luthor are free of Brainiac’s control they will assist you once again. You will then move through a few small corridors and defeat more Brainiac Robots, before facing Brainiac one last time in a larger room.

sections.title: Final Boss: Brainiac
items: A mostly straightforward boss encounter in Normal/Elite. In Elite the Cyberadication mechanic must be adhered to or it will cause a group wipe.
Various adds will spawn to assist Brainiac in battle, including Brainiac Replicant LX, Brainiac Skirmisher, Brainiac Replicant.

When a Brainiac Replicant add is defeated they will leave a purple pool AOE on the floor that stays for the remainder of the boss encounter. If a player stands in this pool they will take damage over time [Brainiac Replicant Core’s Erratic Energy Field]

Blade Storm: Brainiac will have a red skull icon above his head briefly before firing three blade projectiles in a cone towards the group. These are easy to miss but if a player is hit directly and doesn’t block it may do large damage, possibly even KO in the Elite version.

Data Spikes: Periodically Brainiac will say “Witness my power!” In VoiceOver while having a red skull icon above his head, and he will brace himself. There will be onscreen text stating: “Block Brainiac’s Data Spikes!”. Shortly after he will raise his hand in the air and spikes will appear on the ground underneath all players in the raid. This will do large damage to affected players if they don’t block and will KO in the Elite version regardless of role. (Note that this shouldn't KO affected players who aren't blocking with near full health in Normal/Elite versions *if* they have both Bio-Genetic Booster augments equipped, with at least one but ideally both at Rank 28)

Logic Construct Cage: Brainiac may target a particular player and encase them in a cage. This does moderate damage and will stun the affected player. The player can use the R1 button to breakout of the cage.
Energy Hand Clap: Brainiac may target a particular player and interrupt the player with a clap animation. This does mild to moderate damage.

Blink Smack: Brainiac will have a red skull icon above his head while pointing at a particular player in the group. After a brief pause, Brainiac will blink to that player and punch the ground. The affected player should block or they will be knocked back and take large damage, possibly be KO’d in the Elite version.

Cyberadication Mechanic:; Periodically Brainiac will teleport to the middle of the room at approximately 25/50/75% health and generate a shield, while preparing a powerful attack and having a orange icon above his head.; There will be three terminals in the room that players will need to activate quickly to remove the shield, and then a player will need to lunge Brainiac to counter him.; If Brainiac isn’t interrupted in time (approximately 10 seconds from when his shield goes up) he will unleash a powerful shockwave ( Cyberadication) to the group. In the Normal version this will deal large damage, however in the Elite version this will likely cause a group wipe.
Differences/considerations for Elite Plus:

All players in the group MUST block Data Spikes regardless of augments. If even one player does not block this mechanic, all players will take massive damage and this will most likely cause a group wipe.
Once you have beat Brainiac you have completed the raid.

sections.title: Trivia
items: This mission's both versions for villains and heroes apparently negate each other in the end. As the Heroes must solve the paradox created by the villains, the heroes themselves create a paradox in the end the villains must solve, and again in an endless cycle.; The heroes end up in a Metropolis where Superman is controlled by Luthor using a red kryptonite, making it easy for Luthor to rule Metropolis. The heroes go back to the point in time when Jor-El launched Kal-El's ship and remove the red kryptonite. Future Batman then decides to program an additional goal for Kal-El, to guide Luthor into a path of goodness in his future.; The villains come to a Metropolis where Luthor is a generous, loyal businessman who works with Superman to make Metropolis a safe place. The villains end up travelling to the point in time when Jor-El launched Kal-El's ship, removing the goal Future Batman programmed to make Luthor a heroe, and putting a piece of red kryptonite in Kal-El's ship.

title: Circe’s Stronghold
summary: Circe’s Stronghold is a Tier 2 solo Challenge. It is triggered by the mission: Lair of the Witch.

sections.title: Overview
items: Circe’s Stronghold is a Tier 2 solo Challenge. It is triggered by the mission: Lair of the Witch.

sections.title: Heroes
items: Join Wonder Woman to regain a store of stolen Magic Exobytes - and face off against the devious Circe and her Bestiamorphs.

sections.title: Villains
items: Join Circe to defend a store of Magic Exobytes against the Amazons - and their warrior Princess.

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Fight your way through Circe’s Stronghold; it is possible to recruit allies on the way, but it is not necessary.

In the final chamber, Wonder Woman battles Circe over the Exobytes; there are eight Exobyte containers. One type of Beastiamorph (heroes) or Amazon (villains) would attempt to move them to the portal on the side of the chamber. The boss (Circe for heroes, Wonder Woman for villains) is not targetable initially. Circe transforms you into a Beastiamorph (heroes would additionally have Wonder Woman lasso them to allow them to keep their mind). You must defeat eight Exobyte-moving mobs. If they manage to transport all eight containers, the boss will start attacking you dealing immense damage with each hit while still being untargetable, resulting in a loss. Therefore, focus on those carrying the containers. As a Beastiamorph you gain a new set of abilities (you can still use your trinkets), abilities 1, 2, and 3 all deal massive damage at a low cooldown, while ability 4 heals you.

One possible trick is to approach the containers carefully, which allows you to reach one of them without triggering the cutscene before the boss fight. Then, you can pick it up and throw it back out of the boss room. It takes a very long time to respawn, so this essentially prevents the mobs from transporting all eight containers (after transporting seven they would all line up at the locked door trying to get the final one, making them sitting ducks). Either way, with how powerful the Beastiamorph abilities are, this should be very easy - and after defeating them, simply spam ability 1 to 3 against the boss to quickly defeat them.

sections.title: In-Game History
items: Coast City is located in California, USA. Known as the home city of Green Lantern (Hal Jordan), the city is also the location of Ferris Aircraft; a successful aerospace engineering corporation.

sections.title: Story
items: As the battle between the Green Lantern Corps and the Sinestro Corps comes to a head, both factions begin deputizing New Heroes and New Villains to bolster their ranks. Meanwhile, the Red Lantern Corps arrives to feed off the hatred caused by the chaos on Earth.

In an attempt to cease the fighting, S.T.A.R. Labs attempts to create emotional power dampners to control the raging emotional spectrum only to have the reverse effect occur and cause destruction as the corps' infighting spreads to Coast City.

sections.title: Alert Description
items: The emotional spectrum is out of balance and the Lantern Corps are losing control. Get to Coast City and help S.T.A.R. Labs complete their work on an Emotional Dampener device.

items: Grail has allied with you to oppose Darkseid on New Apokolips, as the suffering of evil worlds powers Perpetua. However, upon encountering Stompa, the later reveals Perpetua has installed Darkfather as the ruler of New Apokolips and the Furies are now loyal to him.

The first boss is Stompa, with Lashina and Mad Harriet joining in two different points (order is random). During this fight, Grail's Father Box would periodically generate "lockdown zones" that looks like a green pool on the ground - if one of the Furies step into the pool, they may become stunned until the lockdown zone expires.
Stompa uses Brawling attacks and has the expected stomp and charge attacks. Has a Lethal attack where she points at a target, then jumps and stomps repeatedly at their location.
Mad Harriet uses Martial Arts. Has a Lethal attack where she leaps behind a target and slashes them.

Lashina has the most unusual fighting style, including spinning around with her whip damaging a moderate area around her, and an electrified whip attack that applies an unbreakable stun and continuous heavy damage on one target (easily able to KO from full health in elite), until she is hit by an interrupt attack. She can also spin her whip into a shield shape in front of her while standing in place, avoid attacking her during this time as she would reflect damage.
Do not fall off the platform in the lava chamber in Elite, as it does not have the forcefields preventing that which exists in Normal.

Arriving in the final chamber, you find Death Metal Superman bound with kryptonite; Darkfather explains he intends to turn Superman into a servant of Perpetua, and summons a resurrected Brimstone. Brimstone has several attacks:

Vicious Outburst: Warned by a pop-up message (Brimstone does not attack normally during this delay), you must block before Brimstone explodes, dealing massive damage to everyone in the room and stuns them. In Elite, this ignores Shield Powers and can deal significant damage even when blocked. After the explosion, Brimstone falls on one knee and is stunned for a time, making it the best chance to attack. This seems to be based on his % health, so in normal especially with high DPS it is possible for him to fall to his next threshold before he recovers, making him unable to hit you at all.
Brimstone may mark a cone in front of him in red before damaging anyone caught within.

Periodically many red circles appear and after a couple seconds volcanos erupt from them, dealing massive continuous damage. In Elite, 2-3 sets of several red circles may appear within a second or so before every one of them erupt into volcanos.
After Brimstone is defeated, you must battle Darkfather himself.
Orbital Strike: Darkfather shoots an omega beam into the sky which then comes down as a red orbital strike with an omega symbol, which can one-shot players. (Elite only)
Blitz: A standard charge attack.
He can mark a single target with an omega beam (saying so as he does it), which can be interrupted.
He can summon multiple Parademon minions.
Upon his defeat, Grail leaves you in peace, saying she needs to find Darkseid to settle their issues.

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Superwoman and Ultraman now serve Perpetua. Lex Luthor and Batman (Death Metal) lead the team in an attempt to disrupt Perpetua's energy connection to her throne to weaken her while Perpetua is elsewhere destroying worlds. When Johnny Quick protests about allying with Perpetua, she petrifies him. However, Owlman also opposes Perpetua and offers help over comms. It is revealed that Perpetua is holding Legion of Doom members captive and siphoning power from them.

sections.title: First boss: Superwoman
items: A fairly straightforward boss encounter in the regular version. Somewhat trickier in the elite version, and rather tricky in the elite plus version if players don't adhere to mechanics perfectly.
On PS, Hold R1 to Block

Lasso of Submission: A targeted player will get a timer icon above their head, while there will be onscreen text stating: "Get Away from Superwoman's Lasso Target!". Players must keep their distance from her target before she ensnares them in her lasso. Anyone ensnared will have a red proximity marker once the timer runs out, and must mash the correct button (Square button on PS) to free themselves more quickly, or immediately with breakout. If you are too close to her target, the lasso will drag you towards them and deal considerable damage (this will continue to be active for the full duration even if they have already used breakout). This lasso can drag players around the map, stun and deal damage, and be quite annoying for the group if this is triggered.

Lasso Vortex: Superwoman ensnares all targets in her lasso for a hard stun for several seconds, dealing damage over time. After briefly being an unbreakable stun, players will need to spam a button (Square on PS) to break out, and do so quickly. Afterwards, Superwoman may deal a heavy attack on a random player, which will need to be blocked (especially in the elite and elite plus versions). Players should break out of the Lasso Vortex stun as soon as possible and block. In elite plus this heavy attack may KO a non-tank role player. (More info needed on heavy attack mechanic name)

Flame Field: Red circles appear on the ground and after a brief delay fire field AOEs appear dealing constant damage over time to anyone in it. This can hit quite hard in the elite and especially elite plus versions, so try to avoid these where possible.
Owlman hacks the turrets in the room, allowing you to interact with them and turn them against Superwoman (they can also draw attention from enemy mobs).

Lasso Pull: Superwoman may have a red skull icon above her head before blinking to a corner of the room (usually the southeast of the room) and trying to pull players with her lasso. If the player is out of range and blocks they shouldn't get pulled, however if they do get pulled they will take considerable damage and be hard stunned. The affected player may need to spam a button (Square on PS) to break out.
Superwoman may spawn Apex Predator or Security Bot adds to assist her in battle. There will be onscreen text when this occurs, stating: "Reinforcements Arrived!"
In the final chamber, you find Perpetua's throne. Sinestro, Gorilla Grodd, Black Manta, and Cheetah are bound to it.

sections.title: Second boss: Ultraman
items: Overall, Ultraman uses his many lethal attacks so often he has a skull icon half the time, although his damage is mostly not too deadly and fairly telegraphed.

Periodically, a large ring of many kryptonite containers would appear in the room. Some of them are fakes sent from Owlman (the ones with the Owl mask symbol). After a delay, Ultraman would Charge to the closest kryptonite container (damaging anyone in the way), so lure him close to a fake one first, which stuns him briefly. If he hits a real one, he may use the room-wide Lethal attack: Ultraman can rush to the center of the room, use his Freeze Breath while spinning around and freezing all targets (including mobs) into unbreakable ice, preventing you from acting for some time, although this does not directly deal damage.; Ultraman would then break the ice of individual players with Charge that can deal heavy damage, or Spin-a-Roo where he grabs the frozen target and spins them around dealing damage around him.; When Ultraman goes to charge to the closest Kryptonite, there will be onscreen text stating: "Ultraman Rushes to Nearest Kryptonite!"
Ultraman has a lethal attack that must be stopped by repeatedly using lunge attacks against him.

Ultra Beam: Ultraman spins on the spot, sweeping across the room twice with his heat vision. He rarely uses this attack, but it will do massive damage to all players that it hits and is his deadliest attack.
Ultra Vision: Ultraman blasts a single target with heat vision, pushing them back.
Ground Beam: Grounds a single target with heat vision for moderate damage.
He also summons security bots and mechs as reinforcements, which disappear when he is defeated. There will be onscreen text when this occurs, stating: "Reinforcements Arrived!"
Ground Pound: Ultraman may periodically have a red skull icon above his head, before punching the ground. This deals considerable damage and knockback to players in range.

sections.title: Last boss: Devastator
items: A fairly straightforward boss encounter in the regular version. In the elite and elite plus versions it can become quite a lengthy and potentially tricky boss encounter if the group isn't agile and on top of mechanics. In addition a controller is recommended for this boss encounter in the elite and especially elite plus versions due to Devastator's buffs from the Spore Field AOEs.
Mechanics (seen in both phases):

Breath Attack: Devastator will have a red skull icon above his head while looking towards a particular player. Devastator will then breath a green breath attack cone AOE for a few seconds, this time ignoring Shield Powers. This deals damage over time to affected players.
Fist Slam: Similar to Jackhammer, Devastator repeatedly punches the ground, continuously damaging and knocking down nearby targets.
Ground Fracture: Devastator will have a red skull icon above his head before stomping the ground with his left foot. Players in range will receive a considerable damage over time.
Spike Wave: Devastator will punch the ground towards its target, dealing heavy damage and knocking back affected players (especially if the players aren't blocking).
Bulldozer Charge: Devastator will launch into action, enhancing his melee abilities. Players caught in the crossfire will receive damage over time and perhaps be knocked back.

Devastating Stomp: Devastator will jump high into the air and land near a random player in the group. After a short delay they will stomp the ground, dealing heavy damage and perhaps knockback affected players in range.
He has two distinct phases (changing phases at about 66% health):

sections.title: In phase 1:
items: Spore Clouds: Greenish-brown spore fields spawn wherever he goes, and they do heavy continuous damage to any player on them. The more there are, the more powerful the Devastator gets. When a player gets the Doom Form, they lose their abilities but they can absorb the spores by using their ability 1 in Doom Form if they are close enough to the fields. When a player gets the Doom Form, there will be onscreen text for the whole group, stating: "Someone Has the Doom Form!". If too many spore fields spawn, there will be onscreen text stating: "Too Many Spores! Devastator's Power Increased!", and Devastator will receive damage and defence buffs as indicated on his HUD. After a time the spores will disappear and there will be onscreen text stating: " Devastator's Power Retuned to Normal".

Environment: Devastator can cause spikes to erupt in random spots from red circles with a brief delay before disappearing. If players are hit directly by these they will take considerable damage and be knocked back.

sections.title: In phase 2:
items: Impaling Spikes: Devastator summon spikes frequently and they do not disappear immediately - there will be a timer icon above the spike indicating how long it will last for. When he uses a charge attack, lure him into those spikes to stop him. Spikes expire on their own after a while, exploding and damaging nearby targets. If players are hit directly by these when they spawn (there will be a red AOE tell briefly before on where they will spawn) they will take considerable damage and be knocked back.

Charge: Warned by lethal attack icon. Devastator crouches briefly before charging, damaging players hit; by positioning existing Impaling Spikes between you (if targeted) and Devastator, he will be halted and knocked down when he hits with the spikes. An onscreen text may pop-up when this starts to occur, stating "Devastator is Charging!".
Devastation Stomp: Devastator stomps, dealing moderate damage in a moderate area and knocking targets back.
Upon defeat, Luthor's Legion of Doom is freed, and Batman is ready to take the fight to Perpetua.
*Parts of this walkthrough (especially concerning elite/elite plus) are not yet complete, and are subject to further updates

sections.title: Trivia
items: Earth 3 has been previously visited in the Earth 3 episode and the Attack of the Anti-Monitor anniversary event.

Lex Luthor returns after Perpetua siphoned off his Source energy in Doom: Umbrax the Ultraviolet and he turned against her. Sinestro also briefly returns after being disgraced in Doom: Umbrax the Ultraviolet, and is now stripped of his ultraviolet power.

Originally, when Johnny Quick was shown petrified, he kept his colour palette; this has been changed to a stony color/texture, making him look more dead. It is also available as the Johnny Quick's Demise base item.

This is the first alert released in DC Universe Online to feature an elite plus version. This trend was continued in the Sins of Black Adam episode, with the SoBA: Godseye Pyramid alert also having an elite plus version.
