It was also available as a Tier 7 Flashback Alert SoA Flashback: The Royal War in Shadows Over Argo during chapter events.

sections.title: Story
items: Flashpoint Batman has a strategy for dealing with the Royal War: break the impasse by taking away the super-weapon of Atlantis and the super-shield of New Themyscira. If he's right, that will be enough to convince his true target to reveal himself. You and the Flash are going to help.

The exobyte heroes/villains meet with Flash and Flashpoint Batman in the coordinates the latter gave them in Queen's Row Penitentiary. The Flash states that he's having difficulties keeping both the original and the Flashpoint timelines in his head, as he has memories of living two lives, and suspects that the Royal War is Professor Zoom's work. Flashpoint Batman lays out his plan to end the stand-still between the Amazons and the Atlanteans. When the Flash share his concerns about flaring up the conflict, Batman simply replies "I don't care," as Zoom is his one and only priority. Flash shares his preference for his Batman, the group start moving towards the location of the Atlantean super-weapon.

After passing through imperial soldiers as well as members of the Silent School, the group gets to the Atlantean super-weapon - the Geo-Pulse - which is being guarded by Emperor Aquaman himself. Batman orders Flash to use his powers to offset the Geo-Pulse's vibrations while the rest of the team deals with Aquaman. Upon being defeated, Aquaman regrets that Flashpoint Mera infiltrated New Themyscira and died for nothing. Batman vows to finish Mera's job if he explains how to bypass the Amazons' super-shield, and Aquaman explains that she used magic points the way to the beach in New Themyscira above. The exobyte heroes/villains proceed while Batman and Flash stay behind to deactivate the Geo-Pulse to prevent it from sinking the surface. Aquaman wishes them group the same fate as Mera's if they fail.

The exobyte heroes/villains arrive at the New Themyscira beach, where Amazons and Atlanteans fight each other. Go through the battlefield and into a structure built underneath the modern city above with Amazons inside. Flash and Batman catch up to them, and they defeat the guards and enter the temple. There, they find Flashpoint Circe, who's being forced by Queen Diana to power the shield that protects Amazonian territory. Flash questions Queen Diana's ethics, which she takes it as an offense and attacks them. The team subdues Queen Diana, setting Circe free. As the witch flees, Flash wonders about Professor Zoom's whereabouts, but Batman guarantees that he will show.

Zoom arrives on cue, bringing Emperor Aquaman with him and make the two royals face each other. Flash expected Zoom's presence to clear his memory of what lead to Flashpoint, but he's still confused. With disdain, Zoom reveals that Flash himself was to blame for everything. And that's when Flash remembers that he changed time to save his mother, which caused the Flashpoint Paradox. Zoom declare he's going to finally end Flash's life, and the group face him. After defeating the villain, Flash finds he was in possession of some sort of gizmo that seemed connected to the Speed Force. Batman tells the others to give it to Flashpoint Cyborg to be analysed while he questions Zoom.

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: You can skip all the mobs in the first map, Atlantis Frontline. With Movement Modes and Shield Powers, you can rush right to the end where Emperor Aquaman is and start the boss fight. The arena will be locked behind you, preventing the mobs from entering.

sections.title: First boss: Emperor Aquaman
items: On PS, Hold Square to Lunge
Mechanics:

Periodically, Geo-Pulse Cracks will spawn on the ground. There will be on-screen text when this occurs, stating the following: "Move away from the Geo-Pulse Cracks leaking from the Ground!". After approximately 6 seconds blue columns of water energy ( Geo-Pulse Emitter) will spawn in the affected areas. Players hit will take considerable damage in the normal version, and heavy damage or KO'd in the elite version.

The Flash will be close to the Geo-Pulse Emitter throughout the boss encounter, and adds that spawn may try to attack The Flash. It is important that these adds either get KO'd as soon as possible, and/or get pulled and aggro'd by the tank so that they aren't attacking The Flash. If The Flash is KO'd in the fight it is likely that the Geo-Pulse Emitter will gain full strength, spawning Geo-Pulse Cracks across the entire boss room and likely leading to a group wipe unless Emperor Aquaman is defeated in time (enrage mechanic).
Water Spray: Emperor Aquaman jumps and fires a cone of water at a targeted player. Does damage over time. Can be lunged/countered.
Violent Water: During the fight, bubbles will float around the map. If a player gets near one of these they will take heavy hits of damage and will lose power while affected.

Gunship Strike: Periodically, Emperor Aquaman will state the following in VA: "All Atlantis gunships, fire!" Several orbital strike AOEs will spawn on all players, and players will need to evade and move away from these straight away. If affected, players will take significant damage and may be KO'd in the elite version.

Emperor Aquaman may summon Trench Creature, Brine Hulk or Adolescent Trench Creature adds to assist him in battle. There will be on-screen text when this occurs, stating: "Aquaman summons Sea Creatures to fight at his side!". Aquaman will also say in VA: "Come, creatures of the sea! Destroy these assassins!"
Jellyfish adds will be present through the boss encounter. They can be KO'd. If players get too close to them they will take damage over time and may be stunned.

(Elite only) Emperor Aquaman may rise in the water a little while having a red skull icon above his head. He will then summon a large wave forward and then backward in the direction he is facing. This should be evaded by being out of range or affected players should block, otherwise this will deal heavy damage and may KO.
After beating Emperor Aquaman, you could avoid fighting the mobs by rushing to the portal to the next map.

The Flash is convinced Professor Zoom caused the Flashpoint timeline. Batman states that the war is in a stalemate as the Atlanteans have a superweapon and the Amazons have a super shield; he proposes to disable both to draw out Zoom in the ensuing escalation.

You must clear the mobs in New Themyscira Temple to proceed however. Queen Diana is revealed to have Circe captive to power the super shield. The group will then confront Queen Diana (the Flashpoint Wonder Woman).

sections.title: Second boss: Queen Diana
items: Mechanics:
Occasionally, Queen Diana may jump over to a random player and do a Jump Punch, doing some damage to players in nearby range and knocking affected players back.

Bracer Deflection: Queen Diana may have a red skull icon above her head, and state the following in voice over: "Your lack of combat discipline will be your undoing!" She will then do a reflect ability, blocking while having a shield icon above her head. If players attack Queen Diana directly those players will take heavy damage, or likely KO'd in the elite version. While this occurs, Flashpoint Batman will say the following in voice over: "Don't attack if Queen Diana blocks!"

(Elite only) Queen Diana will have a red skull icon above her head while looking at and targeting a random player with a yellow/purple AOE ability, which will spawn multiple times on that player and follow that player for a time. This will do considerable damage over time and the player affected will need to move away until the AOEs stop tracking that player. Standing still (or not moving fast enough) with this ability will in all probability cause a KO. It is also best practice to avoid other players - or for other players to avoid the affected player while this mechanic is active. (It is also worth noting that if a player is KO'd from this that the AOEs will stay on top of that player for a time, so players trying to revive should have this in mind and only attempt to revive that player when it is safe to do so)

sections.title: Matching Symbol mechanic
items: Periodically, all group members will receive an Ancient Curse, which will deal damage over time to the other three group members. When this first occurs, you will receive heavy damage over time due to having 3 Ancient Curse mechanics from the other 3 group members.
There will be on-screen text stating the following: "Stand on Tile with matching Symbol to Remove Curse". Flashpoint Batman will also say in VA: "Find the matching symbol and stand on it".

All players will receive a different Greek Symbol icon above their heads. On the floor will be different tiles with Greek Symbols on them. In the regular version there will be 4, and in elite there will be 8 (half of which won't be symbols any group members have at the time).

Players should move over and stand on the Greek symbol tile which matches the icon above their head. Then, the symbol will be removed and will no longer deal damage over time to the other group members via Ancient Curse. When all 4 players have matched their symbols the Ancient Curse damage over time will stop. Although you cannot avoid receiving the symbol, dodge can negate damage from Ancient Curse, so using dodge rolls to reach the tile can reduce damage taken.
If a player stands on a Greek symbol tile that doesn't match the icon above their head they will trigger a Greek Rune damage over time on themselves, taking heavy damage or will most likely be KO'd.
Note that the following phases below may not all occur in the same boss attempt.

sections.title: Hera phase:
items: Queen Diana will say the following in VA: "Beloved Hera! Grant me your favour!" A cloud portal at the north of the map will spawn and Hera will appear.
Shortly after, there will be on-screen text stating the following: "Repeatedly Trample a Field of Lilies to Get Rid of It"

There will be small areas of flowers around the map which players can walk over to get rid of them. While they are active there will be Field of Lilies AOEs across the map, dealing damage over time and grounding affected players.

sections.title: Zeus phase:
items: Queen Diana will say the following in VA: "Zeus, king of the storm! Raise death upon them!" A cloud portal at the north of the map will spawn and Zeus will appear.
Shortly after, there will be on-screen text stating the following: "Move Away from others if Marked by Zeus!"
Some/all players will receive a white lightning icon (proximity marker) above their heads, and will need to stay away from other players.
Shortly after, affected players will be hit by Empyreal Lightning. This will deal greater damage if players are close together.

sections.title: Ares phase:
items: Queen Diana will say the following in VA: "Fearsome Ares! Crush all who oppose me!" A cloud portal at the north of the map will spawn and Ares will appear.
Shortly after, there will be on-screen text stating the following: "Avoid Ares' Charge or Block to Reduce Damage!"

Battle Charge: Ares will charge three times while active. Players will need to avoid his charges or block to mitigate incoming damage. If players are hit directly they will take heavy damage and will be knocked back.
In between charges, Ares may punch the ground (more info needed)

sections.title: Hades phase:
items: A cloud portal at the north of the map will spawn and Hades will appear.
Volatile Shade adds will spawn. These should either be KO'd by the group as soon as possible or at least stunned.

After a time the Volatile Shade may have a red skull icon above their head. If they aren't defeated or stunned in time they will explode ( Blissful Lamentation), disappearing from the fight but causing massive group wide damage in the process.

sections.title: Aphrodite phase (Elite only):
items: A cloud portal at the north of the map will spawn and Aphrodite will appear.

One player may receive a pink heart icon above their head, and another player may receive a broken pink heart icon above their head. The player the broken heart won't be able to use their powers. (More info needed)
If a player with a pink heart icon moves close to a player with a broken heart icon, the other player will return to normal and they will be able to use their powers again.

After defeating her, Circe is freed and she teleports away. Professor Zoom appears with Aquaman in tow, tossing the nemeses off to the side to fight on their own, while you confront Zoom. The Flash realises he caused the Flashpoint timeline himself by going back in time and attempting to save his mother.

sections.title: Last boss: Professor Zoom
items: Reasonable difficulty in the regular version, however can be tricky in the elite version.
On PS, Hold R1 to Block
On PS, Hold Square to Lunge
Mechanics:

Vortex Trap: Professor Zoom may sometimes spin around very fast while moving across the room. This may draw players in and deal damage over time to affected players. Players may need to roll away and maintain distance while this is occurring.

Professor Zoom may hard stun all players, and spawn a red vortex animation over himself. There will be on-screen text the first time this occurs, stating the following: "Break Free and Interrupt Zoom before it's Too Late!", and The Flash will say a similar warning in voice over. You will need to spam a button to break out (the Square button on PS), and lunge Professor Zoom to counter/interrupt his attack. If Professor Zoom isn't interrupted in time he will use his Detonating Momentum attack, dealing massive group wide damage and causing affected players to be grounded.

Velocitug: Professor Zoom may briefly have a red skull icon above his head. There will be on-screen text stating the following: "Block to avoid being Pulled to Zoom!" Professor Zoom will do a spinning attack, trying to draw players in. Affected players will take heavy damage and may be KO'd with enough exposure to this mechanic, regular or elite version.

Whirling Arms: Professor Zoom may teleport to a random player and do a cone attack, which may pull players in and do large damage. In the elite version this can KO players. This can be stopped by a player lunging him to interrupt this ability. (On PS, Hold Square to lunge)

As the fight continues, Speed Force Tempests may spawn. There will be on-screen text stating: "Stay away from Speed Force Tempests". If players are affected by these they will deal considerable damage over time.

sections.title: Speed Force Energy Phase (Elite only):
items: Later in the fight, there will be onscreen text stating the following: "Disperse Speed Force Energy before it can Heal Zoom!"

4 Speed Force Energy portals will spawn on each side of the room, with a timer icon. Players will need to activate all of these within approximately 5 seconds of them appearing or they will heal Professor Zoom. The more portals that are missed the more Professor Zoom will heal.
If Professor Zoom heals there will be on-screen text stating: "Speed Force Energy Heals Zoom!"

You will need group members to be positioned close to where these portals are going to spawn, as the reaction time is very short. You will also ideally need the entire group to stay alive for most or all of this boss encounter in the elite version. If you have especially agile players they may need to activate 2 of these portals.

Due to various other mechanics, such as Whirling Arms and Velocitug, you will require a tank for best results in this boss encounter in elite. Furthermore the tank may need to run a group breakout/immunity ability in their loadout, and pop it during this phase so that players can securely activate the portals in time without being pulled away by other mechanics.
When Zoom is defeated, Flash finds a strange gizmo with Speed Force energy and takes the team onward while Batman stays to interrogate Zoom.

sections.title: Flashback
items: Relieve a past memory from under the sea.Flashpoint Batman has a strategy for dealing with the Royal War: break the impasse by taking away the super-weapon of Atlantis and the super-shield of New Themyscira. If he's right, that will be enough to convince his true target to reveal himself. You and the Flash are going to help.

This alert was featured as a Flashback instance only during the release of Children of Krypton, Chapter 1: Shadows Over Argo, listed under the name SoA Flashback: The Royal War. The original version remained available for all players.

The difficulty of the instance was increased to match the other Tier 7 instances in the chapter, rewarding chapter-related items and currency. The Collectibles obtainable in the original raid can also be found in this one.
The Royal War was chosen as a Flashback alert for Shadows Over Argo due to the presence of Emperor Aquaman and Atlanteans in both contents, and it is located underwater like Sunken Argo City.

sections.title: Trivia
items: Queen Diana and Emperor Aquaman can be seen fighting in the background during the boss fight against Zoom. They can be reached if you exit the boss area prior to the Zoom fight. However, while they have red names (considered enemies), they cannot be fought.

There is a bug where The Flash and Flashpoint Batman can lock onto and attack a player's pets after Zoom is defeated. No damage is dealt. Even after they stop attacking they models continue to face and track where the specific pet is.

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Picking up at the end of Olympus, Typhon has cast out all the Olympian gods from their abode and occupied Olympus. Wonder Woman said they need a mighty weapon to be able to take him down - and leads the team to Hephaestus' forge to obtain Zeus' lightning bolt, the most powerful Olympian artifact other than the crown itself.

Defeat the two Cyclops blacksmiths in the forge, Brontes and Arges. One or more of the quadrants (north, west, east, south) would periodically flood with lava, do not stand in them to avoid rapid damage. When one of the cyclops is defeated the other is healed to full health.
In the Elite version, you additionally fight a third cyclops, Steropes. The floor and walls are lined with vents that periodically spew fire and deal rapid damage to any players hit.

Once you arrive in Typhon's Colosseum, he unleashes waves of monsters against you, culminating in a quartet of bosses: Harpy Striker, Gorgon Trickster, Minotaur Defender, and Phoenix Lifewarden. It is vital to lure and separate them, as the Phoenix would rapidly heal and Minotaur reduces damage taken by other bosses that are close by. Once you separate Phoenix from the others, KO it then focus on Minotaur (who always takes normal damage) before moving onto the other bosses. The Gorgon can turn you into stone, which cannot be broke out of, but other players can pick you up and smash/throw to break the spell.

The Olympians arrive to aid you in the final confrontation against Typhon. Hades says everyone has their own place, and his is with the dead; while originally on Typhon's side, Hades convinces Cerberus to join him. The gods and Cerberus would fight off mobs on either side of the arena (separated by invisible barriers so it is practically scenery).

Typhon can be directly attacked but takes minimal damage. Instead, KO any Snake Tentacles that appear from the ground, and when they are all KO'ed, Wonder Woman would use the lightning bolt; you must stand in a continuous line from Wonder Woman to Typhon to channel that lightning to strike him. You only get a few seconds to do this, so get into position when the last tentacle is getting low. Typhon will breath fire and pummel you with his fists if you come close, so don't unless you need to take out tentacles next to him or for the final person to channel the lightning. Eggs lining the sides of the arena would hatch into monsters if you come too close, but it is not required to defeat them.

After several lightning strikes, Typhon declares that if heavy is the head who wears the crown, no god, monster or mortal shall. With that, he takes off the crown and destroys it with his fire breath before presumably fleeing, to Hera's dismay, as Olympus will descend into chaos and infighting without it. Wonder Woman suggests maybe they could learn to stop their eternal squabbling, but Circe derisively replies that it doesn't take the Goddess of Wisdom to know the gods are set in their ways, ironically echoing how Hera was able to manipulate her into taking the crown in the first place.

title: Gotham University
summary: Gotham University is a Gotham location, a level 25 mission instance, and a Tier 1 Duo.

sections.title: Overview
items: Gotham University is a Gotham location, a level 25 mission instance, and a Tier 1 Duo.
Gotham State University, also known as GSU and Gotham University, is the university of Gotham City.

One of Gotham's oldest and most prestigious universities, Gotham University has given rise to many of the nation's brilliant minds and thinkers. Founded in 1898, the university became a highlight in academic education, resulting in it possessing its own bank and a museum with a priceless art collection.
Though its primary sport is American Football, the college also hosts high end Gymnastics and Golf teams.
The Tier 1 Duo requires Level 30 for access and rewards 2 Source Marks.

sections.title: Background
items: Felix Faust has invaded the university's Kahndaq Egyptian exhibit and begun sucking the souls of the university faculty and students all in the aid of helping Black Adam resurrect his wife Isis.

sections.title: Story
items: Face the dangers and treasures of the Gotham University warehouse!
Wonder Woman sends a new hero into the besieged facility to disrupt Faust's magic and stop the resurrection before Faust unleashes a zombie apocalypse.

During the events of Amazon Fury Part III, the Seeing Shades Again mission takes the players back to the Kahndaqian part of the map in order to fight Felix Faust. The game describes the location as Gotham University Museum.

sections.title: Trivia
items: Booster Gold attended Gotham University on a Football Scholarship in the year 2462.
Harleen Quinzel studied psychology at Gotham University via a Gymnastics Scholarship.
Doctor Jonathan Crane once taught psychology at Gotham University.
Barbara Gordon graduated summa cum laude (" with very great honor") with a Ph.D and doctorate in library science at Gotham State University.
During his retirement from the force, James Gordon taught criminology at Gotham University.
Jean-Paul Valley used to be a graduate student in computer science from Gotham University before succeeding his father as an assassin and protector for the Order of St Dumas known as Azrael.
Before she became a superhero, Jesse Chambers (aka Jesse Quick) studied meta-humans at Gotham University, writing a dissertation on “Mystery-Men and Their Effects on Culture.”
Kirk Langstrom met his future scientific partner and wife, Francine Evelyn Lee, at Gotham University.
The campus has an archeology building, which is where the instance is held.
As indicated by the Gotham University collection, and the listing of the "Gotham Wolves Jersey" and the "Wolf Den Student Union Pass," in the world of the game, Gotham University's mascot is a wolf.
According to the University of Gotham Briefing, Gotham U is now offering introductory Magical Theory classes, as well as offering a Masters in Magical Theory.
According to the same briefing, Dr. Will Magnus is teaching a post grad certificate in artificial intelligence.

title: Happiness Home
summary: Happiness Home is a Tier 3 raid in the Halls of Power Part II episode. It also features an elite version.

sections.title: Overview
items: Happiness Home is a Tier 3 raid in the Halls of Power Part II episode. It also features an elite version.
Granny Goodness has abducted and brainwashed one of Earth’s most powerful beings. It’s up to you to remove this dangerous weapon from her control.
Open your On Duty Menu and look for the new Raid under Expert Tier 3 of the 8 Player Tab.
Minimum Combat Rating: 100

sections.title: Inhabitants
items: Granny Goodness
Brainwashed Superman (heroes only)
Brainwashed Black Adam (villains only)
Lashina
Stompa
Brainwashed Aquaman (random)
Brainwashed Professor Zoom (random)
Colonel Hervok

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: After defeating a few parademons you would be able to enter the final chamber. Except for the end of the fight, Brainwashed Superman is trapped in a bubble on top of it and would only shoot attacks down to the ground.
Focused Blast: Single-target beam that damages and pushes back.
Heat Vision: Continuous laser that traces across the room, damaging and knocking back any target that comes into contact.

At the beginning, more and more parademons will swarm into the room as you fight Colonel Hervok - a portal will open up, allowing you to go into a control room. Interact with the 4 consoles in indicated order to stop them. There is a battle drone in the middle of the room with a slowly rotating beam that stuns and damages you if caught. Colonel Hervok is most notable of having a reflection stance which can reflect massive damage to his attacker.
Then, you fight Brainwashed Aquaman or Brainwashed Professor Zoom. Note that this is random and not based on your morality.

Brainwashed Professor Zoom is more dangerous to the group due to his Vortex Trap and Whirling Arm (which is unusually not vulnerable to interrupt) attacks hitting multiple targets very hard. Brainwashed Aquaman usually only has Trident Toss used on non-tanks, which pins a single target for some time but does not do a ton of damage.

Stompa and Lashina is next. Generally focus on Stompa first, as her lethal attack, Pulverize, in which she pounces to a location and jumps on the spot, can deal massive area damage. Her slow and easily recognisable Brawling combos are also easy to counter. Lashina also has a dangerous effect when she spins her whip into a silver shield in front of her, dealing heavy reflection damage to anyone who hits her.

When their health starts getting low, Brainwashed Superman is unleashed on your team. It is vitally important that you destroy the 4 solar projectors on the walls as soon as they are targetable. Granny would soon arrive at the battlefield (and is untargetable), and if all projectors are on, Brainwashed Superman will turn invincible, take no damage and 1-shot anyone. After destroying them, you must also prevent Granny from fixing them by destroying the Shield Drone that follows her. Even when not invincible, Brainwashed Superman hits quite hard with his attacks.

sections.title: Trivia
items: Unusually, Happiness Home lacks cutscenes entirely and all dialogue is delivered in normal gameplay mode.

There is a rare bug with the Brainwashed Aquaman boss (potentially possible with other bosses) in that if your team was wiped in the fight and re-enter, and you have a persistent pet that gets stuck in the back room (where the boss is supposed to come from), the boss may get stuck fighting the pet. They do not seem to be able to deal damage to the pet there and the door will be locked, so the boss cannot be fought at all and you will only receive endless waves of parademons without being able to progress the raid. You may have to dismiss the pet or wipe again to proceed.

title: Homecoming
summary: Homecoming is an in-game Seasonal Event first introduced on September 8, 2022. It is built around Starfire's fate to be annually exiled from her home planet Tamaran and features open-world content as well as an Alert.

sections.title: Overview
items: Prize Ticket

Homecoming is an in-game Seasonal Event first introduced on September 8, 2022. It is built around Starfire's fate to be annually exiled from her home planet Tamaran and features open-world content as well as an Alert.
Players complete missions to earn event currency tokens Prize Tickets to spend on rewards at the seasonal event vendors.

sections.title: Story
items: " Dear friend, there is a Teen Titans homecoming and you are invited! It is a cheering-up for me, because my horrible sister Blackfire has sentenced me to another year of exile from our planet, Tamaran. It is certainly working because I hardly feel the homesickness at all! Please, you must join in on the festivities!" — Starfire

" Listen. Starfire got exiled from Tamaran for another year by her sister, Queen Blackfire, and the Titans are throwing a stupid homecoming party to try and cheer her up. That means they'll be distracted. For obvious reasons, I can't show my face around Titans Tower anymore, so I got you an invitation. Show up, play along, keep their attention elsewhere, profit. Got it? Good." — Terra

When Starfire's sister Blackfire inherited the throne of the planet Tamaran, she exiled her younger sister to secure her own place as Empress. Every year, Starfire travels to Tamaran to petition to end her exile, and every year Blackfire personally turns her down and banishes her off-planet.
This year, Starfire’s been banished right into a Teen Titans “Cheer Up, Starfire!” party and you’re invited! Get ready for carnival games, dancing, and… sibling rivalry?

That’s right – Blackfire’s on the attack and her goal is to totally ruin the Teen Titans’ shindig. Talk about a party foul! It’s up to you to battle the interstellar party crashers and make sure the party goes off without a hitch.

sections.title: Overview
items: The Incendiary Mine I is a supply consumable which is randomly available from supply boxes. It always comes in a stack of 3 and is not stackable further.
The item is a possible reward from defeating Doctor Psycho or from completing the Watchtower Containment Facility (Alert).

It takes several seconds to deploy. Once deployed, the mine would hover and spin on the spot until an enemy comes into contact. If they are not triggered, they would spontaneously detonate after a few minutes.
It deals an initial damage and then burns for 13 further small hits.

title: Intergang Crime Wave
summary: Intergang Crime Wave is a 4-player Operation included in the Halls of Power Part I Episode.

sections.title: Overview
items: Intergang Crime Wave is a 4-player Operation included in the Halls of Power Part I Episode.

Intergang has received new technology from the planet Apokolips. They are using it to create havoc in Metropolis and steal a fortune from the financial district. Heroes and Villains alike find themselves clashing with Intergang – either to thwart their plans or stab them in the back & steal the gold for themselves. Players will start the operation in the original open-world Metropolis and then travel to Oolong Island for a final showdown with Bruno Mannheim and Chang Tzu.
The Operation is located under Tier 2 of the 4 Player Tab.

title: JLDC: Cursed Themyscira
summary: JLDC: Cursed Themyscira is a Tier 6 8-player Operation in the Justice League Dark Cursed episode. It also features Casual, Elite, and Elite Plus versions.

sections.title: Overview
items: Tarot Card
JLDC: Cursed Themyscira is a Tier 6 8-player Operation in the Justice League Dark Cursed episode. It also features Casual, Elite, and Elite Plus versions.

sections.title: Story
items: Rendezvous with Wonder Woman and Circe in Themyscira to confront Hecate and put a stop to her magical meddling.

Wonder Woman and Circe unite in Themyscira to execute the JLD's plan to stop Hecate, aided by 8 heroes and/or villains. After defeating a number of Hecate's servants, the group is intercepted by the Goddess of Magic herself. Wonder Woman's attempts at diplomacy fail when Hecate curses her, to Circe's delight as she hoped to be the exception to her matron's plans — but her dreams of world domination are cut short when the Olypian reveals that even her champion must return her magic and curses her as well, leaving the two cursed magic mentors to be defeated and restored by their allies.

After defeating more Servants, the group finds Hecate in a plaza, where they find Hecate, and Circe and Wonder Woman try to reason with her once again, but the goddess dismisses their protests and curses all their eight allies instead.

The curse takes the allies to the Collective Unconscious, a place of dreams featuring the demise of all of the worlds featured in the DC Universe Online, where they must defeat the Ethereal form of Hecate that inhabits the place in order to overcome the curse. Wonder Woman and Circe use their powers to assist their allies remotely.

Once Ethereal Hecate is defeated, the team finally confronts Hecate back in Themyscira, who's surprised to see that mere mortals overcame her influence. Wonder Woman keeps the goddess herself restrained, which prevents her from fighting the allies directly, so she uses an avatar, the Aspect of Hecate (which takes the form of every iconic she cursed in the episode), as well as summoning her Servents with portals. Circe stands back, using her transmutation powers to transform allies in bestiamorphs so they can close the portals.

Once defeated, Hetace finally gives up on her plan to take magic from the world, justifying her actions as a means to stop a greater danger that will arrive in the future and, wishing her children luck, returns to Olympus.

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: You begin the raid in Themyscira: Gates of Tartarus, joining Wonder Woman and Circe. The raid group will proceed through a series of hallways, defeating various adds such as Harpies and Minotaurs along the way. Eventually the group encounter Hecate, who curses both Wonder Woman and Circe and turn them against the raid group.

sections.title: 1st Boss: Cursed Wonder Woman & Cursed Circe
items: A fairly straight forward boss encounter compared with other similar first boss encounters from recent raid content in DC Universe Online.
Recommended role setup for Normal/Elite/Elite Plus versions: 5 DPS, 1 Controller, 1 Heal, 1 Tank
On PS, Hold R1 to Block
Mechanics:

Periodically a Beastimorph Berserker will spawn to assist the boss in battle. When they spawn there will be a large red AOE on the map indicating where they will land. Players should avoid this to avoid massive damage, however players away from the AOE may also take some damage and be knocked back ( Ground Pound).
Both Cursed Wonder Woman and Cursed Circe will need to be defeated in a similar timeframe, or the other will respawn.

sections.title: Cursed Wonder Woman
items: Cursed Pulse: Periodically there will be onscreen text stating: “Jump over Wonder Woman’s cursed pulse!”. Cursed Wonder Woman will have a red skull icon above her head, before releasing a purple shockwave towards the group. Players should jump over it or it will do considerable damage.

Amazonian Deflection: Periodically there will be onscreen text stating: “Don’t Attack Wonder Woman while she’s Shielded!” Wonder Woman will have a red skull icon during this, before doing a reflect ability. Players should avoid damaging Wonder Woman or take large damage. Wonder Woman will have a gold shield and shield icon above her head while this ability is active.

Whirlwind Lasso: Periodically Wonder Woman will spin around and charge around the map towards a corner of the room near the entrance. There will be a tell for this where Wonder Woman will point her lasso in a direction towards a lever around the edge of the room, though this may be hard to see depending on other animations in the room. This does large damage and will knockback affected players. She will usually do this once towards one corner, then again in another direction.

Energy Explosion: There is a chance when Wonder Woman is at low health that she will stop and have a timed orange icon above her head. After a short time, she will deal a raidwide AOE with a big purple animation, dealing heavy damage to affected players. This is more likely to occur in Elite Plus but not exclusively so. (More info needed)

sections.title: Cursed Circe
items: Periodically there will be onscreen text stating: “Block if Marked by Circe’s Chain Lightning!”. Circe will have a red skull icon above her head, and the affected player will have a purple arrow above their head. The affected player should block or they will deal heavy damage over time to nearby players ( Chain Lightning). The affected player will take considerable damage regardless.
Differences/considerations for Elite Plus:

Curse: Circe will blink to a random player, spawning a purple AOE tell underneath her. Players should avoid this or it will do significant damage followed by a considerable damage over time for a short period. The damage over time may still affect some nearby players even if they evade the initial impact.

More of a variety of adds will spawn to assist Wonder Woman and Circe in battle, and preferably should be KO'd as soon as possible. A Bestiamorph Defender may give one or both bosses a yellow shield if it is close by, mitigating incoming damage towards Wonder Woman and/or Circe. A Bestiamorph Mender may heal Wonder Woman and/or Circe if in close proximity.

After defeating Cursed Circe and Cursed Wonder Woman, the curse will be lifted and they will both rejoin you as you take the fight to Hecate. You fight through more enemies from Greek mythology as you progress through more hallways, before eventually encountering Hecate again. Hecate will then teleport the raid group to The Collective Unconscious, where an ethereal version of herself awaits.

sections.title: 2nd Boss: Ethereal Hecate
items: Can be potentially tricky with the Magic Zone phase in all versions of the raid, as the Water Spray bubbles KO on impact in all versions. The thought add phase can be troublesome in the Elite and Elite Plus versions of the raid in particular - but with 2 tanks and enough damage dealt to any adds from agile players who can evade AOEs at short notice this shouldn't be too much of an issue.
Recommended role setup for Normal/Elite versions: 5 DPS, 1 Controller, 1 Heal, 1 Tank
Recommended role setup for Elite Plus: 4 DPS, 1 Controller, 1 Heal, 2 Tanks*

* (You can get away with 1 Tank provided that either a DPS or Controller can swap in the Lasso of Truth artifact (at rank 120) while having the Mesmerising Lasso Iconic Power ability in their loadout, and use it to pull any Thought adds that spawn during the Thought phase. This requires more setup however from the player in question)
Mechanics:

Hecate will spawn a large blue donut AOE around the map ( Rising Tide). All players should move to the middle near Hecate to avoid damage. Following this, Hecate will spawn a red AOE in the middle of the room ( Swell), and players should then quickly move away from the middle of the room to avoid damage. Sometimes this will be followed shortly once again by the blue donut AOE.
Periodically some players will get a blue circle marker around them. These players should stay away from other players as this will deal damage to nearby players and may stun them ( Maelstrom).

At a similar time period to the Maelstrom mechanic above, 3 random players (which may or may not also have the blue circle marker) will place a red AOE on the floor. All players should avoid the AOE placed or they will take damage and be knocked back and stunned ( Waterspouts). Note that the time to avoid this is quite short.

Sometimes (particularly during the thought phase but not exclusively) Ethereal Hecate will spawn a Whirlpool on a random group member. The group member should avoid this or it will deal considerable damage over time and crowd control them.

sections.title: Thought phase
items: Periodically there will be onscreen text stating: “Keep Stray Thoughts away from Ethereal Hecate!”. Portals will spawn around the map where adds will spawn, including Passive Thought and Angry Thought adds. These adds will move towards Hecate and buff her, so it is best practice to try and keep adds away from Hecate where possible, by having a Tank (or DPS/Controller with Lasso of Truth artifact/Mesmerising Lasso ability) pull the adds away from Hecate, and having the DPS defeat all adds that spawn as quickly as possible while remaining agile around AOE mechanics.

Periodically there will be onscreen text stating: “Ethereal Hecate Absorbs Unconscious Energy!” When this occurs Hecate will be buffed, and have a mild dark aura around her. This may do heavy damage over time to nearby players (this damage over time does not have a name in the combat log, and implies Hecate is attacking the player directly).
Hecate may sometimes spawn Whirlpool AOEs around the map. If a player is too close they may take damage over time from these and be crowd controlled.

sections.title: Magic Zone phase/end phase
items: Later in the fight, there may be onscreen text stating: “Magic Zones grant Super Speed!”. Ethereal Hecate will blink to the middle of the room during this. Blue pool AOEs will spawn, which if a player stands on they will be grounded, transformed into a ghost and will gain the Super Speed movement mode. (This phase may occur more than once depending on how quickly the group defeats Hecate after the initial phase)

Shortly after, Hecate will have a red skull icon above her head and will be shielded with a Bubble, before firing a series of bubbles ( Water Spray) around her clockwise towards the group. These will KO if these hit players directly (in all versions of the raid), so players will need to run around to evade these bubbles. The bubbles move through the map quickly so the super speed mode is essential for survival during this phase. This phase may happen more than once in succession, which may be something to consider if players are KO’d in the initial phase.
Shortly after, Summoned Water Golem adds may spawn to assist Ethereal Hecate in battle.

Ethereal Hecate may look in a direction while having a red skull icon above her head and with a red cone AOE in front of her, before firing bubbles ( Water Spray) in front of her (these are slower than during the Magic Zone phase). These bubbles should be avoided or they will deal heavy damage or likely KO.

Ethereal Hecate may have a red skull icon above her head as well as a red AOE in melee range, before firing bubbles ( Water Spray) in all directions. Players should avoid these or they will deal heavy damage or likely KO.
Differences/considerations for Elite Plus:
Rising Tide and Swell will both occur at a slightly higher frequency than in other versions of the raid.
Most AOE attacks will hit much harder or likely KO a non-tank player on impact if not evaded if they weren't already a KO in other versions.

The Thought phase may be troublesome for many groups in Elite Plus, so 2 tanks are highly recommended here. In addition DPS should focus primarily on defeating the Thought adds and mitigating if not stopping any Thoughts from reaching Ethereal Hecate.

Violent Water: During the Thought phase large blue AOEs will spawn across much of the map, with the time between the spawn and impact being rather short. If this hits a player directly they will take massive damage and more likely be KO'd especially if a non-tank role. Players will need to be very agile to evade these and stay focused.
It is best practice to stay max range of both Ethereal Hecate and any adds, as the adds may do abilities that can do heavy damage or KO to nearby players (mostly in melee range).
(More info needed)
Once Ethereal Hecate is defeated the group can then return to Themyscira: Command Post for the final boss encounter.

sections.title: Final Boss: Hecate
items: A fairly straightforward and arguably easy boss encounter by both Normal, Elite and Elite Plus content standards for DC Universe Online.
Recommended role setup for Normal/Elite/Elite Plus versions: 5 DPS, 1 Controller, 1 Heal, 1 Tank

sections.title: Mechanics
items: Hecate is shielded for the fight, with the fight focused on mechanics and adds. There will be an Aspect of Hecate with a purple shield that will join the fight. There are different forms for the Aspect of Hecate, inspired by Swamp Thing, Wonder Girl, Zatanna and Deadman. Only three Aspects of Hecate may be seen in any run of the raid, so runs may differ on what Aspects of Hecate may appear and in which order.

Adds will spawn to assist Hecate in battle, such as Olympian Soldier, Menacing Cockatrice or Satyr Conscript. These will spawn from cloud portals. There will be onscreen text stating: “Go to Circe for a boon to destroy Hecate’s Portals!”. Circe will have a purple icon above her head and can be interacted with, which will transform players into Beastimorphs and allow them to interact with and close the portals.

Purple orbs will spawn after each portal has been closed respectively, which can be used to destroy the Aspect of Hecate’s shield. There will be onscreen text when this occurs, stating: “Aspect’s shield is damaged!”. Once 4 orbs have been placed directly at the aspect’s shield, the Aspect of Hecate will become vulnerable, this will also have onscreen text stating: “Hecate’s Aspect is Vulnerable!”.
Bombs will spawn, which players will need to interact with to stop them from exploding. (More info needed)

Periodically, purple AOEs will spawn on players, which should be avoided as these will spawn an orbital strike on the ground ( Full Moon Blast). These do large damage over time or KO affected players. Some of these may sustain and track players for a time ( Blackout Orb’s Moon’s Fury), and with this the AOE is bigger than the animation suggests, so even if the player is slightly near this attack they may take a milder damage over time.
Unconscious Tear: This may use a Magic Burst attack which can deal heavy damage. (More info needed)
If Aspect of Hecate is in Zatanna form:

Aspect of Hecate does a short red skull icon along with a red cone AOE, before firing metal balls in front of her ( Cursed Glitter Ball). These should be evaded or will do massive damage to affected players.

Magical Orbital: Aspect of Hecate may use a light pink AOE to stun her targets in the air. It is imperative that if a player is affected they break out of this and evade the AOE as soon as possible, or Aspect of Hecate will spawn a Magical Orbital, which will do heavy damage or likely KO a non-tank player.

Irresistible Pull: Aspect of Hecate may use a light pink AOE (similar to above) to crowd control and stun her targets towards the middle of the AOE, dealing heavy damage over time to affected players. Again affected players should break out of this quickly and evade the AOE.
Magic Burst: Aspect of Hecate may spawn a pink AOE in melee range of herself, dealing heavy damage to nearby affected players. This is more likely when she is teleporting around the room.
If Aspect of Hecate is in Deadman form:
Soul Prison: (More info needed)

Trapeze Attack: Aspect of Hecate will do an emote where he will jump up in the air, swing around on a trapeze in the direction of a random target, and then charge the target. This will deal heavy damage and may knock back the affected player. It may also KO in the Elite and particularly Elite Plus versions of this boss encounter. (This may also do heavy damage to other nearby targets upon impact)
If Aspect of Hecate is in Swamp Thing form:
Spore Cloud: Aspect of Hecate will spawn green gas AOEs that deal damage over time to affected players.

Nature's Fury: Aspect of Hecate may use vines to pull most/all nearby players towards them, dealing a mild damage over time. This can be tricky as usually this will pull the group into the Spore Cloud AOE mechanic, or another AOE mechanic.
If Aspect of Hecate is in Wonder Girl form:

Aspect of Hecate does a brief red skull icon before shooting yellow orbs in all directions ( Ball Lightning). These should be avoided or affected players will take significant damage and be knocked back. This may also coincide with the aspect doing a Lightning Bolt, doing large damage to anything in close range.

Lasso Vortex: Aspect of Hecate may do a red skull icon while lifting her hand in the air, stunning all players (this may be evaded if the player is blocking) in the air before the players return to the ground while tied up. The affected players will then need to spam the Square button (on PS) to break out quickly. During this the affected players may take a mild damage over time for a short while.
Static Discharge: Aspect of Hecate may use an electric ability on her target, dealing damage and stunning the target.
Battle Charge: Aspect of Hecate may charge a target, dealing heavy damage and some knockback to the affected player (or pet).
Wonder Woman may be KO’d, she will need to stay alive to help with the encounter. There will be onscreen text when this occurs stating: “Wonder Woman is down! Revive her to distract Hecate!”.
Differences/considerations for Elite Plus:

Magic Blast: A random player will get a green stack marker, and will need to stack in close proximity with other players to minimise incoming damage. If correctly stacked affected players will take moderate damage. (More info needed)

The biggest threat to the group in the Elite Plus version of this encounter is if the Aspect of Hecate is in its Swamp Thing form, and uses Nature's Fury to pull the group into AOEs, particularly the Spore Cloud AOE. Without sufficient shields/healing (ie. the heal will need to break out of this as soon as possible and heal/shield, possibly save a shield supercharge for this) this can easily catch the group off guard and cause a group wipe.
When 3 Aspects of Hecate are defeated the fight is over and you have completed the raid.
*Note that this walkthrough is incomplete, particularly regarding last boss and any Elite Plus considerations, and will be subject to further updates

sections.title: Overview
items: Justice For All is a Tier 4 raid in Age of Justice released in May 2017. It also features an elite version.
Access to the Justice For All raid requires a combat rating of 150.
Access to Age of Justice is available to all players.

Help Rip Hunter, who's made a tenuous alliance with Vandal Savage, to stabilize the timelines being torn apart by Per Degaton's temporal interference. Meet Lady Blackhawk at the Savage Stronghold in order to launch an all out offensive against Baron Von Savage and Per Degaton. Ending their reign of terror once and for all!

sections.title: Story
items: Time is running out…literally! Storm the enemy stronghold to put a stop to Baron Von Savage and Per Degaton’s plans before their breach in the fabric of space and time becomes too unstable.

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: When fighting against Lieutenant Sauer, he will periodically shield himself and you must destroy indicated pylons by taking the top half of one pylon and putting it on the bottom half of the other, and vice versa.

Confront Baron von Savage. Upon his defeat, Vandal Savage convinces his alternate self that Per Degaton is a failure and gets him to join the rest of the heroes and villains. However, Per Degaton overrides his control of his Savage troopers.

Wearing the Temporal Paradox Capacitor style in the elite version of the raid will grant the option to spawn a Savage Temporal Commander before the fight against Baron Von Savage by using a console and thus gain more loot.

When you finally face Per Degaton, you must first defeat several of his troopers; he will attempt to revive them, interact with their backpacks to prevent that and force Per Degaton into phase so you can hit him. His signature move is turning some players out of phase; in this state, they cannot use their Powers or Movement Modes, or activate Trinkets. They can be turned back by interacting with the backpacks as well. However, out-of-phase players are also the only ones who can defuse the Quantum Energy Bombs that may spawn in the room before they go off, which deals continuous damage around them.

summary: League Hall: Lockdown is an Tier 2 8-player Raid included in the Halls of Power Part I Episode.

sections.title: Overview
items: League Hall: Lockdown is an Tier 2 8-player Raid included in the Halls of Power Part I Episode.

Defend your league hall from an enemy force bent on retrieving the Third World artifact now humming with power in your league’s hall. Wave after wave of enemies will launch an assault, with powerful bosses and an epic last battle. This is one of the more difficult pieces of content in the DLC Pack. This challenging raid is fashioned after the Prime Battleground and the Survival Mode Event.
The Raid is located under Tier 2 of the 8 Player Tab.

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: The whole raid takes place in the center hall of a league hall.
The artifact displayed in the center of the hall determines which effect will appear during the raid.
Winged Artifact = Arctic Winds (Ice)
Emits a snow white field which causes moderate damage over time and also stuns players.Not as deadly as the other two, but still move out asap if you get caught in the AOE. Bowl
Bowl Artifact = Desintegration Fields (Fire)
Emits a fire-like field which causes extreme damage over time.Avoid it, you likely will not have a chance to move out. Chalice
Chalice Artifact = Deadly Beams (Laser)
Emits a laser like beam widely rotating in a full circle. Contact with it results in extreme instant damage.Be as far away from the center of the beam as possible and block. Shields will help.

The effect stays the same for the whole raid and always spawns in one of five fixed locations in the hall. Seen from above the layout is like a five on dice. There is a small time window from when the small balls in the center of the effect appear to when the effect becomes active. In general, avoid the area of the artifact's effect from the moment those start to appear. It's a good idea to zoom out your camera, so that you can better spot the appearance of those.
If players get caged, they can be freed with the device in the far right side of the hall.
If players get the red aura, they become a threat to their teammates and have to stay away from other players until the aura wears off.

The detaining rifle to cage Kalibak / Mister Miracle or Mantis / Big Barda cannot be used by the same player twice in a row. Usually two players will alternate for this job. The rifle will appear on the floor and also drop there after being used.

Keep an eye out for the Parademon Technicians / Colony Engineers. During the final fight they will try to reach the center platform with the artifact on it in order to build a makeshift teleporter. If they succeed four times the raid has failed.

title: Legends PvE
summary: Legends PvE allows players to run specific 4 player alerts and raids using avatars of iconic characters.

sections.title: Overview
items: Legends PvE allows players to run specific 4 player alerts and raids using avatars of iconic characters.
A player may use any owned Legends PvP character in a Legends PvE event unless a character is present in the alert as a Non Player Character. Duplicate Legends characters can be used in a group.
The South Gotham Courthouse alert was introduced as the the first Legends PvE event in game update 43. Events are on a rotation similar to PvP Maps.
Legends PvE instances are accessible via the On Duty Menu under Custom Play and the Events tab.
Legends PvE content rewards Marks of Legend. There are general and event specific Legends PvE Feats.

sections.title: Trivia
items: From November 2014 to January 2016 the Legends PvE instances were on a monthly rotation and then switched to a weekly rotation after no new maps were to be introduced anymore. Rotating maps will now overlap on the weekends.

In June 2020 the Legends PvE Extravaganza bonus event took place for one week for the first time. All Legends instances and all Legends avatars became freely playable and every single run counted as 10 runs towards the general Legends PvE Feats. Starting in 2025, this event was renamed to Legends Unleashed.

There are 4 Challenges where you play as a predetermined Legends character: Iconic Anomaly: The Hunt, Iconic Anomaly: Test Subject No. 1, Iconic Vision: Aegis of Truth and Iconic Vision: Circe's Trial, however those instances do not count towards Legends PVE feats or reward Marks of Legend.

sections.title: Story
items: Mordru's ritual has begun and threatens to erase 21st century inspirations from history. Head to Mordru's lair before you're next!

items: Cosmic Boy

The enemy combat rating is 327.

sections.title: Locations
items: Mordru's Lair

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: You start the raid in a safe area, before teleporting to the 'Dark Multiverse'. Here you will encounter various random enemies (add mobs), including cloned Teen Titans/Legion members and some Shadow Demons. Be careful of skull icons above the Failed Raven Clone, Failed Donna Troy Clone, and Otherworld Demon Reflector, as they may reflect damage back and KO players attacking them - if a tank uses a Chronometric Emitter at the right time or stun them another way this should stop the reflect from occurring. Also be careful of Failed Cyborg Clones as if they shield they will restore their health and do significant damage to nearby players - this can be stopped by lunging (Hold Square to lunge on PS) them.
You then teleport to a second area where you encounter more add mobs like above. Shortly after there will be a cutscene where Shadow of Trigon will appear.

sections.title: First boss: Shadow of Trigon
items: Mechanics:

Hellfire Field: Shadow of Trigon may look at a random player and spawn a fire AOE under them. Do not stand in the AOE for too long as it does moderate damage over time, especially in the elite version.

Hell Beams: Shadow of Trigon will have a red skull icon above his head while looking at the player with the most hate (usually the tank), before firing a beam on the target, dealing multiple ticks of considerable damage.

Shadow of Trigon may look at a random player with a skull icon above his head, before shooting a small dark fireball directed at that player. In both regular and elite if this fireball hits a non-tank player this WILL KO the affected player. It is easy to avoid but the fireball is quite small and at times difficult to see due to other animations going on, so just be vigilant.

Induce Panic: Shadow of Trigon will have a red skull icon above his head while looking at the player with the most hate (usually the tank), before unleashing a roar, dealing considerable damage to the target (if in range) and stunning them. This can be interrupted/countered by lunging the boss.

Shadow of Trigon will have Shadow Tentacle adds active throughout the fight, and there will be more that spawn the longer the fight goes on. In the regular version you can defeat these and there is a feat related to this. In the elite version you won't be able to kill them. They do damage to nearby players ( Swipe) so just be mindful of your positioning along with other mechanics.

Shadow of Trigon at approximately 75%/50%/25% health will spawn add spawns (Summoned Eye of the Empress). There will be onscreen text when this occurs, stating: "Shadow of Trigon Summons Eyes of the Empress". These should be aggro'd straight away by the tank and KO'd by the DPS as soon as possible. They do significant damage to the tank if left for too long, especially in elite.

Mass Void Strike: Periodically Shadow of Trigon will have a red skull icon above his head while flexing and looking at the floor and then standing straight, before spawning shadow orbital strikes on the group. These should be avoided or they will do significant damage.

Sometimes with (5), Shadow of Trigon will pull all players towards him and give them a purple proximity marker ( Shadow Curse). All players should then spread out away from each other as soon as possible. If any players and their respective proximity markers are too close together they will do significant damage to both and may cause KOs especially in elite. This is then followed shortly after by mechanic (1) or (2). Note that if two players are too close, on the combat log it will show that you have taken moderate damage from your own Shadow Curse, and considerable/massive damage from the other player's Shadow Curse.
After Shadow of Trigon is defeated you proceed to the next area, defeat a small group of add mobs, before a cutscene introduces the second boss: Emerald Eye of Ekron.

sections.title: Second boss: Emerald Eye of Ekron
items: Mechanics:

The boss may teleport from time to time. The boss will either spin and shoot projectiles randomly which do moderate damage to players affected, or the boss will do a slam attack with a large red AOE ( Sonic Screech). It is best practice to be out of the red AOE and block as the latter attack can one-shot (both regular and elite, especially the latter) - the damage of it is quite inconsistent and buggy so just be mindful of this.

Thorn Thrust: The boss may do a 360 cone attack, indicated by a brief cone red AOE marker on the floor in front of it (4 cone attacks). Avoid these and try to stay diagonal of the boss respective to the direction it was facing in when it started the 360 mechanic. If you are hit as a non-tank it will most likely KO in regular and more so in elite. Bear in mind the cones aren't exactly 90 degrees each time (especially the third cone).

Line of Sight: The boss may teleport and have a skull icon above his head before doing a 360 degree green laser. This will probably KO a non-tank player if they aren't blocking, even in regular but more so in elite. Avoid this laser or block (hold R1 on PS to block).
There will be orbitals randomly around the room, avoid these or they do moderate/significant damage. They will leave a green pool that does damage over time as well so it is best to avoid these.
Emerald Plasma: Although the Empress is not targetable, she will hover around the battlefield and maintain several continuous green lasers that deal moderate constant damage if you touch them.

sections.title: Damage check phase (Elite only):
items: At approximately 66%/33% health, Eye of Ekron will become very briefly invulnerable (the first time there is a very short cutscene). This specifically happens in both regular and elite versions.
Shortly after this in the elite version there will be a damage check phase, indicated by a yellow bolt icon/timer above the Eye.
If you pass this the Eye will do one of his teleport attacks, or it will go straight into a 360 degree cone attack.

If the latter, it is best practice during and after the damage check for all players to not be directly in front of the eye's pupil, as the reaction time for the 360 degree cone attack is very short and may lead to KOs.
If the damage check isn't passed, the Eye will pull and mind control a random player before proceeding with other mechanics. It may mind control another player later.

Do some damage to the mind controlled player but not enough that it KO's the player - be especially careful as a Celestial Might DPS as Plague/Corrupted Divine Light glyphs do significant damage or one-shot mind controlled players - and the MC player will walk to Eye of Ekron and be in line of sight between you and the boss.

After the Eye is defeated, the Legion will create a pathway to lead you to another platform where Mordru is. There is another add spawn on this which you can either KO or throw off the platform. Be careful climbing up the platform as it is possible to fall off and respawn back on the platform with low health or be KO'd. After the add spawns are defeated one way or another Mordru appears to the group.

sections.title: Last boss: Mordru
items: It is possible to fall off the platform throughout this fight. Heavy damage will be taken ( Eldritch Devourer) and may KO if done in succession, especially in Elite. The player will be teleported to above the platform where the boss encounter is taking place after they fall, and will take the damage upon landing on the platform.
First phase:
Mordru may teleport to different parts of the platform. This will often be accompanied by a skull icon on his head.

Devouring Orbs: Mordru will do 1-3 orb attacks at once. He will throw up in the air purple orbs (usually between 3 and 6) and they will roll for a time within midrange on the floor. If a non-tank player is hit by this it will stun and then most likely KO, especially in elite.

Abyssal Impulse: Mordru will teleport 1-2 times in quick succession, placing himself at the centre back of the platform. He will then prepare another attack (indicated by red arrows on the floor around him pointing away from him, a skull icon above his head, and a sound indicator). All players should move close to him straight away as he will do a considerable knock back attack. If you react too late or are too far away you may get knocked off the platform. Tip: the ally NPCs, and any henchmen or other pets you or other players are using can be used as a cushion to fall back onto from the knock back attack - they can also block you from positioning correctly as well!

Mordru will give a player a purple pool. If this player gets too close to other players, it may turn them into a rock or tree ( Form Change), leaving them hard stunned (they may also take considerable damage over time) - they will have to spam the action button in order to break free. It may also reduce the player's size to very small, hindering movement speed. Don't make a habit of this especially when close to knock back attacks. This attack can also cause lag if players are being transformed too often.
The platform will become slightly smaller in size in parts, allowing less room for error for knock back positions.
Second phase (similar to first but with subtle differences):
Mordru will grow in size somewhat, this will be accompanied with the sound indicator for the knock back attack.
When he does the orb attack the orbs will be much bigger and travel further across the platform. Avoid these.
The knock back will hit harder, so again less room for error with where you are knocked back to.
Last phase:
After a brief cutscene Mordru will become very big and half his body will loom over the platform.
Knockback phases continue. There is a small safe zone to the right of where Mordru is facing where DPS can station and damage the boss.

There will be add spawns periodically, these can be kept aggro by the tank while the DPS do large single target damage to the boss. They can also be thrown off the platform or defeated - this takes longer however.

Mordru may punch the platform and leave a bolt of lightning there - this will do moderate damage over time if walked into and is easy to avoid. If Mordru punches the platform close to where a player is they may be knocked back.

Fire Bowl: Mordru may fire a large fireball at a random player in the group. This fireball will move across the platform in a straight direction. If it hits a player it will do significant damage or probably KO, especially in Elite. Mordru may also do this from above if the player is close enough ( Fire Strike).

Sorcerous Rebuke: Mordru's Gem will be active in this phase of the fight. Mordru may activate a gem beam on a random player. This player should move across the platform fast or it will do significant damage over time. The trail left behind by this beam following the affected player will also do damage over time to anyone who encounters it. Try not to stand in one spot or with other players - this may also be important in the Elite version for a feat.
After Mordru is down you have finished the boss fight and the raid.

sections.title: Story
items: The Legion has invited you to their Headquarters for orientation and evaluations: time travel to the 31st can cause unexpected side-effects, even without Mordru's interfering!

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: You start the alert at the Legion Headquarters, where you meet the Legion (Cosmic Boy, Saturn Girl, Lightning Lad). You then proceed into a training room to do a Fitness Test, where you can score points by KOing Training Drone adds, Sentry Turrets or running through yellow rings. At the end you will get a score depending on how many points you got, and there are feats attached depending on what score you get.

You then proceed to the Orientation Room to have the Orientation, however you are interrupted by an alarm - the HQ is under attack by ProbeTek androids! You then proceed through a series of corridors and KO several Ensorcelled ProbeTek enemies, before eventually reaching Brainiac 5's Lab. There you are greeted by a Metal Construct, who Cosmic Boy quickly underestimates.

sections.title: First boss: Metal Construct
items: Straightforward boss encounter in both regular and elite versions, especially if you follow the below tip:

Tip: The Small Synthium Crates or Synthium Barrels (barrels) around the room players can interact with, pick up and move to another location. These barrels when broken will release AOE mechanics that add additional hazards to the boss encounter, however if they aren't in the boss encounter to begin with then they aren't an issue for the group. As such, it is best practice for your group to pick up each barrel and place it around the edges of the room as far away from the boss as possible, BEFORE attacking/aggroing the Metal Construct and starting the boss fight. Doing this reduces the difficulty of the boss encounter considerably.
Mechanics:
Cosmic Energy: The boss will have a brief red skull icon above their head, before pulling all players in range towards it. This does moderate/considerable damage over time while players are affected.

The boss will jump on the ground and do a Knockback Attack to all players in range, doing mild damage and knocking back affected players. There will then be onscreen text stating: "Deadly Jump Incoming!", and there will be a red AOE tell in another part of the room indicating where the Metal Construct will jump to. If the player is hit by this jump they will be knocked back and take considerable damage, especially in the elite version.

Shrapnel Thrower: The boss will have a brief red skull icon above their head, before rotating 360 degrees anticlockwise and doing a cone AOE attack directly in front of it. This leaves a damage over time on affected players if affected. There is a chance that on impact this may deal a Shrapnel Bomb attack, dealing extra damage to the affected player and knocking them back. Metal Construct will often do this mechanic after doing his Cosmic Energy ability, but not always.

Later in the boss encounter, Metal Construct may spawn Unshaped Metal adds with a timer icon above them to assist it in battle. There will be onscreen text when this occurs, stating: "Destroy Metal Construct Spawners!". KO the adds as soon as possible.

Metal Construct may have a red skull icon above its head, along with red arrows on the floor indicating where it is going to. The boss will then jump and roll/charge towards its destination. Players affected will take considerable damage and be knocked back and possibly stunned.
Concussive Stomp: Metal Construct may jump and punch the ground, similar to a Ground Pound. Does moderate damage and knockback to affected players in range.

(If applicable) Programmed Bot's Small Synthium Crate/Programmed Bot's Synthium Barrel: If these are active in the fight, there is the possibility that these may get broken either by the boss or the players over the course of the fight. If broken they may leave fire, ice, or atomic themed AOEs that deal damage over time to affected players. In addition the ice AOE will encase the player in ice, hard stunning them. It may be required to have a breakout trinket equipped to use in case the affected player is encased in ice at a bad time in regard to other mechanics - only if the group decides to keep the barrels in the fight.

After the Metal Construct is defeated, the Legion and group head towards "Heaven", also known as the Food Court. There they are greeted by an alternate universe evil version of Cosmic Boy, who starts attacking the group.

sections.title: Last boss: Evil Cosmic Boy
items: Fairly straightforward boss encounter in the regular version. Can be potentially tricky in the elite version if players don't adhere to mechanics properly.
Mechanics:
Alcubierre Wave: The boss may do a grey cosmic shockwave in front of it. Players in range of it will take damage.

Metal Sphere: There will be onscreen text stating: "Watch out for Metal Spheres!". Several brief red donut AOEs will appear around the map, before several vortexes with four Metal Spheres spinning around on each vortex spawn and move around the map a little. If players are stood in the Metal Spheres they will take considerable damage over time, especially in the elite version.

Metallic Encase: A player may get encased in a Metal Sphere on occasion. They will be hard stunned, and may be freed after a while or by spamming the Square button (on PS), or another player can pick them up and smash them on the floor to free that player faster. If the player has been encased in the Metal Sphere for some time they may levitate into the air. Upon breakout this may do some damage, more likely in the elite version but not exclusively.
Evil Cosmic Boy may throw projectiles ( Magnetic Bomb, Isotropic Singularity, Gauss Barrage) at its target. Does mild to moderate damage if the player is affected.
Magnetic Lift: Evil Cosmic Boy may put his hands close together and stun a targeted player on the floor, dealing moderate/considerable damage.
Primary Attack: Evil Cosmic Boy may fire a metal ball towards a player. Does considerable damage in the regular version and heavy damage (possibly KO for non-tank roles) in the elite version.

(Elite only) Evil Cosmic Boy may spawn Ensorcelled ProbeTek adds to assist him in battle. This add spawn may include an Ensorcelled ProbeTek Peacemaker add, which may use a special Stolen Voice ability. When it does this to its targeted player, the affected player won't be able to use their abilities, unless the Peacemaker add is somehow stunned, interrupted or defeated.

sections.title: (Elite only) Charged mechanic
items: There will be onscreen text stating: "Charged! Opposites Attract, Likes Repulse!".
Two players in the group will get a red material and two players in the group will get a blue material.

There will be a console in the room which affected players can interact with to cleanse this material and return to normal. Mind opposite colour players however when trying to access and activate the console. Eventually this material will disappear and return later regardless.

If a player with a red material interacts with a player with a blue material (even if one of them has been knocked out and still in the room), they will arc damage towards each other and other players in range, dealing considerable damage to all affected. (More info needed on mechanic name for what causes the damage)

Have this mechanic in mind for other mechanics in the boss encounter, particularly the shield mechanic. It is best practice also for players to be spread out for most of this boss encounter where possible.

sections.title: Metal Shield mechanic:
items: There will be onscreen text stating: "Evil Cosmic Boy has a Metal Shield!".
Evil Cosmic Boy will have three metal shields rotating around him.

In the room there will be several consoles with a gold ring/lightning icon above them, which players can interact with and pick up. If players throw three of these at the boss, his shield will disappear.
There may be a communicator pop-up from Brainiac 5 when this occurs, where he says in VoiceOver: "He empowered those consoles in his attack! Use them to demagnetize his shield!".
Once you have defeated Evil Cosmic Boy you have completed the alert.

sections.title: Additional Lore
items: In the final room, there are 7 terminals which, when interacted with, play one of several short bios focusing on leadership qualities of several unique Legionnaires. Starting with the south row, east to west, then north row, east to west, the 7 terminals contain information on:
Bouncing Boy, Colossal Boy, Brainiac 5, Computo, Chameleon
Ferro Lad, Element Lad, unnamed female Legionnaire, Dream Girl, Cosmic Boy
Gold Lantern, Glorith, Invisible Kid, Lightning Lad, Karate Kid
Mon-el, Monster Boy, Lightning Lass, Matter-Eater Lad, Night Girl
Phantom Girl, Saturn Girl, Polar Boy, XS, Quislet, Sensor
Shadow Lass, Star Boy, Tellus, Sun Boy, Shrinking Violet
White Witch, Tyroc, Wildfire, Triplicate Girl, Ultra Boy, Timber Wolf
A few interesting notes:
The bios always come up in this order with the exception of terminal 5 and 7 in the above list, which issue bios randomly.

While not alphabetically ordered within groups, the groups as a whole compared to each other is. The sole exception is XS, who would fit if moved to the 7th terminal, or if she was sorted based on her comics last name (Ognats) rather than superhero name.
The entries are voiced by Computo, with the exception of Colossal Boy's entry, which only appears in subtitles.
Glorith's entry only consists of an error message.
The unnamed female Legionnaire, based on alphabetical placement and tracking abilities, is most likely Dawnstar.

items: Many of Evil Cosmic Boy's mechanics are a magnetic/grey version/variant of powers from the Quantum powerset.
