sections.title: Walkthrough
items: You begin the raid in the Flash Museum, where you speak to Flash before going through a Paradox Tunnel. In this Paradox Tunnel you encounter various Batcave themed adds such as Wing Armors, OMACs and NeurOMACs, before entering the Batcave: Inner Sanctum and encountering the first boss, Brother Eye.

sections.title: First boss: "Brother Eye"/Eye of Paradox
items: Mechanics (as Brother Eye):

Eye Beam: Brother Eye will have a skull icon above their head throughout while looking in a particular direction and focusing a red/yellow beam. This beam does considerable damage to affected players. Brother Eye will then rotate either 360 degrees clockwise/anti-clockwise while maintaining the red/yellow beam for a time.

Whirlwind Strike: Brother Eye will move around a map in a spinning motion with its sharp tentacles. Anyone directly hit by this will take considerable damage over time while affected and be knocked back.

Brother Eye may occasionally move upwards and then teleport near another player via a Boom Tube. If any players are too close to Brother Eye when it does this they will be hit by an EMP Blast, dealing moderate damage and some knockback.
After Brother Eye is reduced to approximately 85% health, there will be a short cutscene where Brother Eye will transform into Eye of Paradox.
Mechanics (as Eye of Paradox):

Dispersal Wave: Eye of Paradox will have a red skull icon above their head while looking in the air and preparing a beam. There will be onscreen text stating the following tell: "Stand in the Beam to Split the Damage!" Affected players (who the Eye of Paradox is looking at) will receive a red arrow above their head as well as a white circle marker on the floor underneath them. These affected players will take considerable damage (more info needed)

Paradox Blast (*1): Eye of Paradox will look into the air and launch itself. X red markers will appear on the floor beneath all players. Players should evade this or bombs will fire down from above on the X red markers, impacting 1-2 times and doing heavy damage. This will usually KO in the elite version.

Paradox Beam: Eye of Paradox will have a red skull icon above their head while looking at a random player. It will then fire beams at players also in that direction. On the initial impact this will cause knock back and may stun affected players, and will also deal damage over time.

Dive Bomb: Eye of Paradox will go upwards into a portal for a short time (while having a red skull icon above his head). Shortly after he will appear again, dealing knock back to all players as well as damage. The closer the affected player is to the Eye of Paradox when this occurs, the more considerable damage this will deal to them.

Eye of Paradox will have a red skull icon above their head while looking at a player (usually the player who has aggro and/or is nearby) and will move a little to the right while doing so. If the player doesn't evade and get out of the way beforehand the Eye of Paradox will then move towards the player, doing several big hits of damage via a Stunning Attack, followed by another big hit with a Bite. This is less likely to occur for players who are further away from the Eye of Paradox.

After defeating the Eye of Paradox, the group will leave the Batcave: Inner Sanctum and travel through another Paradox Tunnel. In this tunnel there will be several groups of Sunstone themed adds, which the group can defeat or skip past. The tunnel will eventually lead to the Fortress of Solitude: Power Core, where you will encounter the second boss: Avatar of Meta.

sections.title: Second boss: "Avatar of Meta"/Avatar of Paradox
items: Mechanics (as Avatar of Meta): (More info needed)
At approximately 85% health Avatar of Meta will transform into the Avatar of Paradox.
Mechanics (as Avatar of Paradox):

Paradox Energy: A player may get a light aura around them, dealing damage over time to the affected player and other players if they are close by. After a time the affected player will get a light AOE on the floor beneath them, dealing damage over time to them and other players if they happen to move into this AOE. (More info needed)

Avatar of Paradox may breathe in, attempting to pull in any players in range towards him. After a short time, Avatar of Paradox may do a Paradox Double Strike, dealing heavy damage to any players in melee/midrange. There is a chance after this that Avatar of Paradox will then fire large red/yellow projectiles (Paradox Mega-Flux) in several directions, dealing damage and some knock back to affected players.

Knockback Attack: The targeted player will receive a red arrow above their head and a white circle on the floor underneath them. Avatar of Paradox will then have a red skull icon above their head shortly after and prepare to charge towards the targeted player. Anyone affected by this charge will take large damage (most likely KO in elite) and considerable knockback. The first time this occurs there will be onscreen text stating the following: "Avoid Avatar of Paradox's Charge!"
Paradox Reaper adds may spawn to assist the Avatar of Paradox in battle.
Paradox Tendril: (More info needed)

After the Avatar of Paradox is defeated, the group will proceed through another Paradox Tunnel, encountering Beastiamorph adds along the way. Eventually the group ends up in Themyscira: Gates of Tartarus, and encounters Circe.

sections.title: Third boss: "Circe"/Emissary of Paradox
items: Shortly after commencing the boss encounter with Circe, she quickly disappears and leaves you with a wave of Bestiamorph adds. After they are defeated there will then be several waves with Paradox adds.
Adds of note:

Paradox Obliterator: This add will prepare a large red AOE attack, indicated by a large red tell on the ground. It it best practice to KO this add as soon as possible, especially in elite. This is stated in on-screen text when it appears for the first time: "Take Out Paradox Obliterator before it can Detonate!"
Paradox Ruin Herald: This add will buff other adds. This is stated in on-screen text when it appears for the first time: "Paradox Ruin Herald Buffs its Allies!"
Paradox Crazeguard: This add will protect other adds. This is stated in on-screen text when it appears for the first time: "Paradox Crazeguard Protects its Allies!"

sections.title: Paradox Statue:
items: One of the main mechanics of the boss encounter, more so in elite.
The first time this spawns there will be on-screen text stating the following: "Take Control of Statue's Home Foundation to Stop it".

Paradox Statue adds will spawn which can only be stopped if player stand in its spawn point/home foundation for a time and capture it. These home foundations are located in the northwest/northeast/southwest/southeast of the room. Capturing this point will stop the statue in its place, but consider that you won't be able to capture this point if enemy NPCs are also within the area of the home foundation.

Home foundations that are contested will have a light red ring on the platform where they are located, and home foundations that are in the process of being captured by group members will have a light blue ring on the platform where they are located. Once the home foundation has been captured by group members the ring will disappear.

In the elite version, Paradox Statues will have role icons above their head along with an aura. Paradox Statues with a DPS role icon will have a red aura, and will debuff damage dealt from nearby players. Paradox Statues with a Controller role icon will have a blue aura, and will debuff power regeneration. Paradox Statues with a Healer role icon will have a green aura, and will debuff healing in for nearby players. Paradox Statues with a Tank role icon will have a yellow aura, and will debuff defence, namely for nearby tanks. These debuff mechanics will need to be taken into consideration for the group especially if they are in melee/midrange of Paradox Statues for whatever reason.
After a while, the Emissary of Paradox spawns.
Mechanics:
Charge Attack: The boss may charge towards a random player. Does considerable damage and knockback if players are hit directly.
Paradox Burst: (More info needed)
Paradox Blast (*2): Blue AOEs may spawn, which will deal damage over time if players are affected.

After defeating the Emissary of Paradox the group will then proceed through another Paradox Tunnel, encountering Paradox adds along the way. Eventually the group enters Paradox Wave, where they encounter the final boss: Paradox Kraken.

sections.title: Last boss: Paradox Kraken
items: Mechanics:
Paradox Kraken may spawn Paradox Tentacle adds around the map. These may hit nearby players with a Swipe.

Interdimensional Ink: Paradox Kraken will have a red skull icon above their head while looking at a player, before shaking its head while looking at the sky and firing a black beam on the affected player. When this occurs there is onscreen text stating: "The Pool and Puddles of Paradox Energy can Remove Interdimensional Ink". Another alternative onscreen text tell states the following: "Kraken Spray can Remove Interdimensional Ink". (More info needed on how Interdimensional Ink affects the player)

Kraken Spray: Paradox Kraken shakes its head before firing a purple/gold attack towards the group. This does moderate/considerable damage over time to affected players, and leaves Puddles of Paradox Energy AOEs underneath players if they stand in the same location for too long. These AOEs can be used to cleanse Interdimensional Ink if a player gets affected by this mechanic.

There is a large Pool of Paradox Energy in the middle of the room which players can jump into, either to cleanse Interdimensional Ink and/or to teleport to where the boss will move to. The room is quite large and the boss will periodically look in a direction, dive into the pool and appear in another area where they were looking to move to. There is a chance that if a player jumps into a Pool of Paradox Energy that they may take significant damage.
Paradox Reaper adds may spawn to assist the Paradox Kraken in battle.
After you have defeated Paradox Kraken you have completed the raid.

*Note the walkthrough above is not yet complete and will receive later updates. More information needed on the Paradox Tendril mechanic on second boss, what mechanics Avatar of Meta has before transforming, the Paradox Burst mechanic on third boss, and how Interdimensional Ink affects the player in last boss.

items: The raid as it progresses is like a time travel through the early years of DC Universe™ Online history. Parts of the following locations appear in the Speed Force Flux: Flash Museum, Batcave, Fortress of Solitude, Themyscira and Paradox Wave.

If a bonus week for the current episode happens to coincide with the Anniversary event being live, players will receive not only the most current episode currency dropped from this raid, but the bonus marks also. summary: Starro: The Threat Below is a 8-player raid available in the Deluge episode.

sections.title: Overview
items: Starro: The Threat Below is a 8-player raid available in the Deluge episode.
Access to the instance requires a combat rating of 210 for Normal mode or Level 15+ for Casual. The instance also features an Elite difficulty mode.
The completed feat Sori Not Sori grants bonus Atlantean Crowns / Source Marks when finishing the raid.

sections.title: Story
items: The Justice League has Intel that an Atlantean Research Outpost is the source of the recent Starro Invasion. Meet up with Aquaman and investigate the Outpost.

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: In the first chamber, Aquaman would first attack you but after you take off some of his health he'd realize you're allies and stop fighting. You must unite against many Starro-controlled Atlanteans.

In the second chamber it is discovered the research station has found quicklime a potential weapon against the starros, but they were overrun. Aquaman demands to know why he wasn't informed, but a report in the first chamber indicate the Atlanteans in the station are loyal to a "true king" with a bid for the throne.
The third chamber is found to be a hatchery; Aquaman attempts to stop them but was overwhelmed by a spray of Starro spores and controlled, and you must defeat him.
In the final chamber is the Starro Conqueror:
Whirlwind Attack: Starro Conqueror spins rapidly while on the move, dealing significant damage around it.
Starro Double Beam: Targeted attack.

Starro Juveniles spawn around the arena. They do not attack and can be attacked, but if you touch one you will become mind-controlled for a long time (about 45 seconds). While mind-controlled, your character will use weapon and power attacks against your teammates and their attacks can hit you as well. However, for the duration you are put in "out of combat" mode and will regenerate any health lost rapidly.
In the final chamber is the last journal entry, whose author was the last survivor, trying to fight off the spores. It also reveals that he fights for something called " the Del...".

title: Survival Mode
summary: Survival mode is a unique, temporarily-available category of raid. A group of 8 players are placed in an arena type room. NPC's will appear in from every side in phases. Every time the NPC's are defeated, a new phase of NPC's will appear stronger than the last.

sections.title: Overview
items: Survival mode is a unique, temporarily-available category of raid. A group of 8 players are placed in an arena type room. NPC's will appear in from every side in phases. Every time the NPC's are defeated, a new phase of NPC's will appear stronger than the last.
Players must survive as long as possible until they are knocked out and cannot be revived. The longer the group survives, the greater the reward. Loot locks will reset weekly.
Survival Mode instances provide no repair kiosk or vendor. The only option to repair is by bringing in Proto Repair-Bots.
Survival Mode instances will appear under the event tab in the player's on duty menu.

sections.title: Survival Mode: Oan Sciencells (2014)
items: The first version of this mode was available as an 8-man instance at the location of the Oan Sciencells. The group will fight lantern-related enemies, enemy varieties will be depending on which side they are on. This mode lasted until Round 10 with 4 waves in each round (3 waves of adds, 1 boss wave). Survival Mode had the same rank as the highest current tier, which was Tier 6. From this version, special chest styles with different customization availibility were able to obtained. This event lasted during summer, and was released as a part of game update 38.
Granted title: 2014 Oa Survivor for completing round 10.

sections.title: Survival Mode: Trigon's Prison (2014)
items: A second version was recently released as a part of game update 41. It took place in Trigon's Prison boss room. Compared to the Oan Sciencells, the room in Trigon's Prison was smaller, causing lower maneuverability of players and greater challenge in the process. Enemies will be having relation to Trigon himself and the Sons of Trigon DLC. This time, the mode lasted up to round 20 still with 4 waves in each round (3 waves of adds, 1 boss wave). Although, after passing round 10, the enemy pattern will mimic the previous waves before round 10, for example round 11 having the same pattern as round 1, so on. Prizes of this Survival Mode were: The special Trigon's Chest with different metal types (better types acquired from higher waves), Trigon-related Base Items and the vanity Demon pets with all the variants of demons (also including the Sloth and generic Demon type).
Granted title: 2014 Trigon Battler for completing round 10.
Granted title: 2014 Trigon Survivor for completing round 20.

title: The Last Son of Krypton
summary: The Last Son of Krypton is a Tier 4 solo Challenge in The Death of Superman released in June 2018.

sections.title: Overview
items: The Last Son of Krypton is a Tier 4 solo Challenge in The Death of Superman released in June 2018.
Access to The Death of Superman content is free for all players.
Warning: This article might contain spoilers!

sections.title: Introduction
items: "Superman’s body has gone missing from the Fortress of Solitude! Supergirl has concluded that someone has used the Phantom Zone projector to take his body, which could lead to dire consequences if it is weaponized. Go to the Phantom Zone with Supergirl and find out who is behind this inter-dimensional grave robbery!"

sections.title: Heroes
items: " This communication is in extreme confidence because frankly, I need help. Superman's body has disappeared from the Fortress of Solitude. Someone accessed the Fortress via the the Phantom Zone projector and took him! Even departed, Superman's body could be weaponized so I must recover it. I'll meet you in the Phantom Zone." — Supergirl
Supergirl has asked for assistance in recovering Superman's body from the Phantom Zone.

sections.title: Villains
items: " What you did for my cousin was unexpected, but appreciated, which is why I'm trusting you to help me again. Superman's body has disappeared from the Fortress of Solitude. Someone accessed it via the Phantom Zone projector and took it! Even departed, Superman's body could be weaponized, so I must recover it. Please, meet me in the Phantom Zone." — Supergirl

" (Chuckles) I don't know about you, but my profits have skyrocketed since we took out Superman. How about we double those numbers. Goldilocks contacting you presents another "two birds, one stone" opportunity. I'll be in touch." — Calculator
Supergirl has asked for assistance in recovering Superman's body from the Phantom Zone. Calculator sees this as another golden opportunity.

sections.title: Map
items: The map for The Last Son of Krypton is the same as the one in The Phantom Zone alert, except you enter from the northeast instead of southwest, and only the first three rooms are involved.

images.label: The Last Son of Krypton map

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Aided by Supergirl, fight through several rooms filled with Kryptonian soldiers until you reach the final chamber. They are almost all found in pairs; inexperienced players can get through much easier if they are careful to only provoke a pair at a time to fight them.

Superman is found held by Xa-Du, the Phantom King, who engineered the Doomsday Plague to enact his revenge against the House of El for being sentenced to the Phantom Zone and intends to trap Supergirl as well.

Upon his defeat, hero players rescue Superman and they all escape the Phantom Zone. Villain players steal Superman's DNA before Calculator reactivates the red sun projector, trapping both Superman and Supergirl in the Phantom Zone while the player makes their escape.

sections.title: Background
items: The Midnight Masquerade, one of Gotham City's signature gothic clubs, has become host to the Witching Hour's last, and most frightful trick. Stop the haunting at its source.

items: Fight Klarion the Witch Boy

When Klarion summons Masked Apparitions, use the ecto-extraction charm to de-summon them.

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: The whole alert is structured into three phases where Klarion emulates the power of magic users. The first two of those are modular and random, the last phase always will be Tala's powers.

sections.title: Raven's Powers
items: Klarion will take damage except for a short time, when he surrounds himself with a red magical cage and spawns three of Klarion's Soul Projections. Defeat the Soul Projections and then damage him until the two crystals spawn which will be announced via voice and on-screen message.

sections.title: Dr. Fate's Powers
items: Klarion will place large yellow ankh symbols which will explode after a while and do damage. Avoid those and damage him until the crystals spawn.

sections.title: Zatanna's Powers
items: Klarion does several white light constructs with his wand, which can hard stun. Interrupt his attacks when being told so and avoid the constructs. Damage him until the crystals spawn.
This phase lasts until the first two crystals are spawned. One of the above four power phases will be chosen randomly.
1a) Place the two crystals. Klarion will be red shielded until both crystals are placed, there is no point attacking him now other than drawing his attention away from the crystal carriers.

This phase lasts until the second two crystals are spawned and is pretty much like the first phase. One of the above four power phases will be chosen randomly, but not the one previously used in phase 1). Damage Klarion until the crystals spawn.
2a) Place the two crystals. Klarion will be red shielded until both crystals are placed, there is no point attacking him now other than drawing his attention away from the crystal carriers.

sections.title: Tala's Powers
items: The last phase is a little more challenging as when Klarion reaches about 35% health, he would continously summon Masked Apparitions and a yellow shield, which reduces damage by about 30%. When there are too many Masked Apparitions attacking Klarion will become difficult since everyone and everything - including the Health Barrels - will get pushed around and at some time Klarion will become red shielded, not taking any damage.

In that case one player should pick up the charm which gets spawned to help the group. The charm will push away and dissolve the Masked Apparitions, so carry it to the fight to make way for the others to attack Klarion properly. Eventually the charm will be full and must be renewed at one of the four white crystals in the room. A large arrow above the charm will point the direction.
Damage Klarion until the last crystal spawns.
3a) Place the last crystal. The fight is won.

Themyscira: The Gates of Tartarus is a tier 1 raid accessible from the On Duty menu, as well as from a portal in the Watchtower (heroes) and the Hall of Doom (villains). It is part of the Battle for Earth episode.
The Combat Rating of enemies is 73. Players above 88 CR will have their CR scaled down to 88, while players below 60 CR will have their CR scaled up to 60.

sections.title: Story
items: For the introductory mission, see Battle for Themyscira.

Brainiac has descended into Tartarus and stolen the Flame of Change. His forces have emerged and only the combined might of your team with the aid of Circe's Bestiamorphs and Wonder Woman's Amazons can stop them.

The Gates of Tartarus are a temple on the island of Themyscira built to protect the entrance portal to the bowels of Tartarus; a Grecian hell dimension the Amazons of Themyscira have been charged to defend to the death.
Unfortunately, Brainiac has targeted the temple in his quest to assimilate the magical Flame of Change to further his conquest of Earth to access the Multiverse.

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: You must defend Circe's Colossi. After destroying the Brainiac force attacking a Colossus, it would charge at the energy field. After a few times, it will be taken down.

Defeat the Brainiac Swarm Master, which is aided by untargetable Brainiac Swarmers. They can be grounded and made targetable by interacting with the Colossal Defender status around the area, but this is not strictly necessary as the Swarmers are destroyed when the Swarm Master is.

Along with Amazons and the living statues, fight along the corridor until you reach a large area, speak to Wonder Woman to begin the boss fight. At the other end is the large Brainiac Vanquisher in a shield and 4 Brainiac Ravagers, all of which are untargetable at the beginning. Wonder Woman and Circe engages the flying Swarmers while you fight the ground forces. While Wonder Woman tells you not to let any through, it does not seem to matter even if all the other allies are KO'ed.

The Ravagers, then the Vanquisher will start to attack and become targetable. The Vanquisher will mostly fight Wonder Woman and Circe with melee in its side of the area and not move towards you, while firing barrages of purple orbs as a long ranged attack that grounds and slows you. He has two Lethal attack warned by the skull icon: a Pull that is shorter range (he might attempt to use this even if it can't hit you), as well as Astral Aura which is a slower moving version of his ranged attacks which bounces instead of being destroyed when it hits terrain. He can often target Circe and Wonder Woman instead with these attacks. His ranged attacks lead the target, so if you are moving in one direction and he uses them, you can dodge them by moving to the opposite direction instead.
Upon vanquishing the Vanquisher, Circe predictably betrays the team, briefly trapping Wonder Woman in a crystal before flying off to steal the Flame of Change for herself.
Fight through more Brainiacs - Wonder Woman may become stuck at one point but it does not matter and she reappears for the fight against Circe, which is very easy in comparison.

The next immediate chamber, the Forum of the Five, is where the final boss - Avatar of Magic - resides. There are a couple of three-headed hydra on a ledge in the back of the arena, but they appear to only be scenery and are not involved. If you hide on the ledge where the Avatar of Magic can't hit you, he will reset to full health.
He has two Lethal attacks, and you can tell them apart by his movement during the skull.
Luminous Burst: A burst of energy that knocks back all nearby targets. When he is about to use this, he swings his staff to the side.

Meteor Volley: This ability is extremely dangerous. He targets Wonder Woman, any player characters and any pets and continuously bombard each area (it does not follow you) with meteors, dealing massive damage rapidly. His staff becomes hidden and he appears to be drawing in breath before using this ability. It would generally KO Wonder Woman quickly and she won't be able to aid you.
He also summons an Astral Roc, Astral Lion, and Avatar Guardian to fight against you.

Upon losing 1/3 health, the Avatar's head turns into that of a Ravager and orders the four Possessed Statues in the arena to attack you with Crush (a stone hand that stuns you) and Fireball ( Meteors that are lobbed onto the ground and roll forward slowly, doing tons of damage if you touch it). Possessed Statues are immobile, persist into the next phase and are de-possessed when the Avatar is defeated. He also stops using the previous Lethal attacks and use new ones instead. He summons 3 Astral Lions.
Primal Maul: Jumps at a player and bites them repeatedly, pinning them to the ground and stunning them. Cannot be avoided by dodge or block.
Primal Roar: Roars and causes players in a cone to panic.

After losing 2/3 health, he turns into an eagle form which can fly and use Whirlwind Attack. He can also switch between the original and Ravager forms in this stage. If you hide on the ledge during one of his melee forms, his health resets and he retains the ability to switch between forms.
He also has a pull and ranged attacks similar to the Vanquisher across all forms.

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Your team along with Cyborg will traverse the tower to the security wing to find the other Titans. You first encounter Mammoth, the first boss of the alert. He will sometimes get angry and his attack will be buffed. Though he will cool off shortly after and go back to normal. After defeating him, you proceed through the tower.

On the way, you battle mobs of hacked titan robots and mechs. When you get to the security cameras, Cyborg looks through them and sees that most of the Titans are down. Deathstroke appears on the cameras and Cyborg says that they should track down Nightwing. You find him in the kitchen, where he is fighting Deathstroke. After Deathstroke defeats Nightwing, you fight him as he is the Second Subboss. After you reduce his heatlh, he retreats and you must go after him. Nightwing says he'll catch up with you later.

At the end of the alert, Gizmo and Psimon do a surprise attack and try to hack Cyborg, For heroes, he becomes Hacked Cyborg and can't control himself. For Villains, he finds out that their alliance was a trick all along and fights the player group.

After you defeat him, Deathstroke gasses the room and kidnaps Cyborg. His Ex-wife, Adeline Kane and her son, Jericho appears and decides to help the players recover the Titans. They have been taken to the H.I.V.E.'s Mountain base, and the players must go there for Upcoming Raid, Titans: H.I.V.E. Reborn.

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Fight through the H.I.V.E. base. The first subboss occurs after Deathstroke sights the team and Jericho, and flees cursing the Titans for turning his son against him, locking them in the room with swarms of H.I.V.E. minions.

sections.title: First boss: Defeat Incoming H.I.V.E. enemies + Guard Captain Buzzzcutt + Lieutenant Bombus
items: Mechanics:

This boss encounter consists of several waves of H.I.V.E enemies that will spawn on each door either side of the room. The group will need to defeat these and the tank/s will need to group them together.

There will also be H.I.V.E. Engineers that will spawn and walk towards one of six inactive turrets on either side of the room. If a H.I.V.E Engineer manages to activate one, the Sentry Turret will be activated and will deal damage ( Ranged Attack) towards the group. When a turret is activated there will be onscreen text stating: "H.I.V.E. Turret Activated!".
Eventually Lieutenant Bombus will spawn from the east door and Guard Captain Buzzzcutt will spawn from the west door.
Lieutenant Bombus:

Lieutenant Bombus may have a red skull icon before teleporting to the furthest player. It is best practice (especially in the elite version) to block when this occurs, as this may do heavy damage ( Honeycomb Bomb).
(More info needed)
Guard Captain Buzzzcutt

Snare: The boss will throw a grenade that will explode and spawn a brief yellow AOE field. Does considerable damage and may stun affected players in range. (This Snare is more powerful than the Snare used by the H.I.V.E. enemies.)

Buzz-Off: The boss will have a red skull icon above his head, before flipping up in the air and punching the ground while upside down (briefly). This does moderate damage and some knock back to nearby affected players.
After you have beaten both sub bosses, you will proceed through a small corridor with more H.I.V.E. enemies, and after you track down Deathstroke.

sections.title: Second boss: Deathstroke
items: A fairly interesting but doable boss fight in both regular and elite versions. Can be tricky if players do not adhere to certain mechanics. Two tanks may be preferred for some groups in the elite version due to the neutralizer mechanic.
On PS, Hold Square to Lunge
Mechanics:
Deathstroke has several red skull icon abilities that can be lunged/countered to interrupt. These include:

Flashbang Grenade: Deathstroke will have a red skull icon above his head before blinking to the middle of the room. When he does this he will drop a grenade that will explode, dealing damage and knocking back affected players in range. He may also use this again during phase transitions.

Staff Beam Sweep: Deathstroke will blink to the middle of the room and have a red skull icon above his head before doing a beam around himself 360 degrees. He will also have his own Supply Drop during this. This should be blocked/evaded by all group members to mitigate incoming damage, otherwise it does significant damage in the elite version especially. This will normally only occur once during the boss encounter, however if any players use a Supply Drop he will use it again and it will be stronger. When this mechanic occurs there will be onscreen text stating: "Deathstroke's Supply Drop has powered up his staff energy beam!" It is best practice not to use a Supply Drop during this boss encounter, especially in the elite version.

Deathstroke may activate his Ikon Suit periodically throughout the boss encounter. He will say in voiceover: "Ikon suit, activated." There will be onscreen text when this occurs the first time stating: "Deathstroke has Activated the Ikon Suit Prototype!". This is a damage check phase. If the group do not deactivate the Ikon Suit in time, Deathstroke will deal massive raidwide damage and knock back to all affected players. In the elite version this may cause KO's. (More info needed on mechanic name for damage check fail)
Some of the below phases may be skipped in the regular version with sufficient damage in the group, however they are likely to be more of an issue in the elite version.

sections.title: Disable Neutralizers to Regain Focus
items: There will be onscreen text stating: "Deathstroke has Teleported in Neutralizer Machines!". During this time several large machines will spawn in the fight.
There will also be onscreen text stating: "Only the Neutralized can disable the corresponding Power Neutralizer!"
At some stage during this phase, one of each role will get debuffed, and the affected role will need to go to the corresponding neutralizer machine and activate the icon to lift the debuff.
If DPS are debuffed, a DPS will need to go to the red neutralizer machine and activate the red DPS icon to lift the damage debuff.
If the controller is debuffed, a Controller will need to go to the blue neutralizer machine and activate the blue controller icon to lift the power debuff.
If the healers are debuffed, one of the healers will need to go to the green neutralizer machine and activate the green healer icon to lift the healing debuff.
If the tanks are debuffed, one of the tanks will need to go to the yellow neutralizer machine and activate the yellow tank icon to lift the defence debuff.
Power Suppressor Pod: If a player is in close range of a neutralizer machine they may take very mild damage over time.

There is a Power Neutralizer in the middle of the room that can be attacked by players (optional). There will be an on-screen text pop-up for this stating: "Destroying the central Neutralizer will disconnect the network!" This is one possible way to end the phase.

sections.title: Avoid Floor Traps, Dodge Tracking Beams
items: There will be onscreen text stating: "Deathstroke has Activated some sort of floor trap!". Shortly after parts of the floor will go red, and you will need to stand on the parts of the floor that are not red. These safe zones will change. If players stand on the red areas unshielded for too long they will take considerable damage over time, or heavy damage over time in the elite version. Eventually there will be no safe zones left so it is important that you pass through the phase as soon as possible, especially in the elite version.

Also during this phase, there will be another onscreen text stating: "Deathstroke has activated tracking beams!" Yellow beams from above will appear and follow certain players. These should be avoided or they will deal heavy damage (More info needed)
This phase can be passed by damaging Deathstroke. There will be a smaller on-screen text pop-up stating: "Keep attacking Deathstroke to overload the floor traps!"

After the group has defeated Deathstroke, Jericho possesses him. You will proceed through several more corridors and defeat more H.I.V.E. enemies, before eventually entering a volcano room where Terra, the final boss, awaits you.

sections.title: Last boss: Terra
items: A very interesting boss fight in both regular and elite versions. The gas phases can be tricky if the group don't adhere to mechanics quickly/efficiently enough. The elite version is one of the more difficult boss encounters for regular elite difficulty in DC Universe Online. Two tanks may be recommended in the elite version.
On PS, Hold R1 to Block
Mechanics:
Many of Terra's red skull icon abilities, it is best practice to block. This is especially the case in the elite version.

Spike Wave: Terra may look at a player while having a red skull icon above her head. She will then do her Spike Wave cone attack. This will do heavy damage/KO and knock back if any players in front of her don't block or evade this mechanic. Note that there may not always be a tell beforehand before this, and she may use this ability on random occasions as well towards the direction of the player who has her aggro.

Volcanic Eruption: If a player uses an Orbital Strike on Terra, she will have a red skull icon above her head before spawning lava underneath that player. This will do considerable damage (most likely KO in the elite version) if the affected player doesn't evade this in time. It is best practice (especially in the elite version) not to use an Orbital Strike on Terra.
Tectonic Break: Terra will have a red skull icon above her head before she lifts into the air, spawning rocks around her. This may do considerable damage to players in range.
Flow: Terra may summon a small wave of lava in front of her. This will deal considerable damage if players are affected.

Earthen Grip: Terra will have a red skull icon above her head while looking at a random player, and then will try to pull the player towards her. Does significant damage if the targeted player doesn't block.
Striking Stones: Terra may target a random player and summon two stones either side of them, colliding on the player. This does considerable damage unless the player is blocking.
Meteor Shower: Terra may spawn a meteor shower AOE on a random target, player or NPC. Does damage over time while affected.

sections.title: Lava phase (Survive Environmental Hazards):
items: This phase will occur four times during a boss attempt.

Seismic Emission: Terra will normally use this ability when she is about to transition into the Lava phase. She will have a red skull icon before dealing mild to moderate damage to players in melee range or midrange, and knocking affected players back.

Terra will blink to the top of a rock on the southwest of the room, declaring in VoiceOver: "I'll bury you all!". There will shortly after be onscreen text stating: "Terra is summong the earth itself to attack you! Avoid the lava!"

The room will be divided into three sections by rocks, with the lava section having an ember AOE over it beforehand. There is a feat for the group standing in the lava section (in the elite version every time this phase occurs). Note that the rock division will block line of sight, so if you are in a separate section to a healer don't expect to receive heals from the healer during this phase.

If group members are stood in the ember AOE before the room is divided, lava will spawn underneath them, dealing considerable damage over time. (This is displayed as Something in the combat log). In addition a Lava Creature add will spawn, which the player/s in that section will need to defeat.

If group members are stood in one of the other two areas before the room is divided, Whirlwind AOEs will spawn. These will deal damage over time to affected players, and may stun and lift affected players into the air. In addition a Rock Creature add will spawn, which the player/s in that section will need to defeat.

If group members are stood in the other area before the room is divided, there will be white circle markers on the ground which players will need to avoid. If not, Boulder Barrage from above will hit affected players and deal moderate damage and some knockback. In addition a Rock Creature add will spawn, which the player/s in that section will need to defeat.

sections.title: Gas phase (Volcanic vent phase):
items: There will be onscreen text stating: "Terra has opened volcanic vents and filled the room with sulphuric gas!" This phase will occur three times during a boss attempt.
During this phase Terra will be shielded and take significantly lower damage from the group. There will be onscreen text stating: "Terra shields herself, decreasing incoming damage!"
Once the gas AOE appears, there will be onscreen text stating: "Defeat Terra's creatures and plug the volcanic vents with their remains!"

Sulfuric Gas: This does persistent damage over time to all group members in the fight while this phase is active. You will still be able to revive players if other group members are knocked out while being hit by this damage over time.

During the first phase, Rock Creature adds* will spawn, and will need to be defeated as soon as possible by the group. When they are defeated, they will leave a rock which group members will be able to interact with and pick up. Consider that these rocks have a timer on them and will expire when that timer runs out. Should this happen another Rock Creature will spawn in its place.
*During the second phase, Magma Creature adds will spawn and will be somewhat stronger than Rock Creatures.
*During the third phase, Lava Creature adds will spawn and will be somewhat stronger than Magma Creatures.

On each corner of the room is a Hydrothermal Vent, which will be connected to one of the rocks you have picked up. You will need to place a rock over that location in order to plug the vent. While stood in close range of the vent you will take damage. When all four vents are plugged the phase will end and Terra will lose her shield.

If the phase continues for too long, there will be onscreen text stating: "The build up of sulfuric gas has hampered your ability to heal!" This will reduce healing for group members and make it increasingly tricky to pass the phase, especially in the elite version.

During each subsequent phase, there will be onscreen text stating: "Terra's rage has made her more powerful!". Terra will get stronger as the fight continues with her attack animations having more of a lava element with time. In addition the Sulfuric Gas damage over time will become slightly stronger also. As such the boss encounter will become gradually more difficult with time.

(Elite only) During this phase when picking up a rock you will be grounded, making it trickier to plug the vents in time. The group will need to time manage defeating adds and plugging the vents with this in consideration. It is possible to throw the rocks but given the awkward structure of the vents this isn't a reliable method.

sections.title: (Elite only) Rage phase:
items: This occurs when Terra is at approximately 15% health or lower.
There will be onscreen text stating: "Terra's rage is bringing down the cavern!"
Boulder Barrage will occur again for all areas of the map. Players should try to mitigate incoming damage or knockback from falling boulders and focus on KOing Terra while minding her own mechanics.
When she is defeated, she causes the chamber to collapse on her and the Jericho-possessed Deathstroke. Jericho leaves his body and escapes, but leaving the two villains' fates unknown.

sections.title: Story
items: " We have a small problem. Shimmer and Jinx had a "falling out" and Mammoth is having problems gaining entry to the vault. lt appears H.I.V.E. has improved the durability of their defenses. We're going to skip the gold and move on to the hardware. Don't worry. Psimon says "there are big bucks in weapon sales."" — Psimon
The Titans have been captured by the H.I.V.E.! Return to their mountain base to foil the HIVE Master's diabolical plan.

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: The raid starts where the last one ended, after the room where you fought Terra. You will enter the room where a machine called the Enervator is holding the Titans captive. This is where you will confront the H.I.V.E. Master. You must defeat the H.I.V.E Master and free the Titans.
Staying up in the air is unusually advantageous in this raid, as it avoids most of the dangerous attacks ( Enervator Beam, H.I.V.E. Bee-Wing, etc.) while there is a lack of grounding effects.

In the initial phase, he has a lethal attack where he shoots a continuous Enervator Beam out of his chest and sweeps 360 degrees, dealing massive damage to anyone who touches it (ignores Shield Powers).

After losing some health, he will infuse himself with all of the Titans' powers, one at a time (order is random). He changes to a new Titan's power set whenever he falls to 25% health, which also heals him to full. During the transition, he is untargetable and you must defeat mobs. When he has used all of their powers, that's the time to finish him.
In any phase, he can use Encase which traps a single target in a yellow sphere, dealing damage over time, and you must mash the required button to break out.

The most dangerous attack is not from him but flying H.I.V.E. Bee-Wing s, which periodically appear behind the Enervator (north side) and bombard the area in a broad line with Air Assault, dealing one-shot damage even in normal difficulty (ignores Shield Powers). Standing right in front of the Enervator can avoid this as they are blocked by the Enervator itself and cannot fire into that area.

Beast Boy phase:; Several of each of Enervator Hounds, Enervator Birds, and Enervator Gorillas are summoned (disappears when his phase changes again).; H.I.V.E Master is able to shapeshift into those 3 forms with different attacks.

Starfire phase:; Fireball Barrage: The 4 Enervator consoles on the corners of the room take turns firing a salvo of several projectiles that fly across the room and damaging anyone they hit. Do not stand near them as this can cause you to be hit by multiple fireballs at once which can one-shot you.; Solar Embers: H.I.V.E. Master lobs fire projectiles that explode, damaging and knocking players away.
Raven phase:; Soul Tornado: Purple funnels rove around the area, pushing anyone away and damaging them.

Donna Troy phase:; Cosmic Explosion: Black hole-like hazards, damaging and dragging anyone nearby into the center constantly. Unlike Soul Tornadoes, they cannot move, but they can appear in the air.; Lasso Slam: H.I.V.E. Master stuns a single player with a blue lasso and slams them into the ground repeatedly for heavy damage.; Bracer Deflection: Warned by Lethal attack icon. H.I.V.E. Master reflects damage back to you if you attack him during this time. Afterwards, he would use Amazonian Aegis, damaging and knocking back nearby targets.

Cyborg phase:; Sonic Grenade: Grenades drop into the room (look like Rifle Grenades), and after a brief delay, damage and stun targets hit.; Sonic Detonation: A sonic wave that can deal massive damage in a line including through the tank.; Bolt Barrage

When he reaches low health on his final stage, you get a screen message saying that he is weak and tells you to finish him. Ironically this can be most dangerous because the stage mechanics will continue to be active, while he regains use of his most deadly attack, Enervator Beam.

There is a half-time break during this boss fight (after he has used the powers from 2 Titans), during which you are placed out of combat (so you get your health regenerated and you can change your role and abilities if necessary), and you will receive the first 4 Source Marks and loot items. Finishing him off will grant you 6 Source Marks and more loot items.

When he is defeated, for heroes, the Titans will be freed, grateful for your efforts; villains will betray Nightwing and keep the Titans trapped as Calculator teleports them out of the collapsing volcano.

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: So far, I've seen Trigon's Prison drop lvl 84 armour and level 85 weapons. In the previously released T5 operations, Brothers in Arms or Family Reunion, only level 81, 82, and 83 gear and 87 trinkets dropped. So if you need a higher level trinket, try BIA or FR operations, because in Trigon I've only seen level 85 trinkets drop.

Trigon's prison usually drops between level 81 to level 84 armour for all roles and unattuned level 85 weapons in the end. Level 85 trinkets were the highest level I've seen which is weird because the level 84CR operations, BIA and Fam dropped the rare level 87 trinkets.

You're told to locate Trigon while Wonder Woman (heroes)/Circe (villains) will meet you there. Fight through the spirits and cultists. There is a distressed cultist hiding under the stairs, who will talk gibberish before running out of the Prison if talked to.
You run into a random Teen Titan (heroes)/Fearsome Five member (villains). Help them defeat spirits, talk to them then continue.
Eventually, Trigon's fiery image appears an proclaim he will soon be free. You need to defeat two Shades. They will drop a choice of several items, including two random pieces of level 84 gear.
There is a panicked cultist who, when talked to, tells you that Circe told him not to let anyone through, but he is terrified of the risen spirits and flees.

Fighting through spirits and demons, you run into another Titan/Fearsome Five. Assist them in taking down more enemies, then they would leave to hold enemies off in a different path. There is a terrified cultist who informs you the demons must be from Trigon's realm and he must be awakening before fleeing.

Go through a wall by carrying boulders out of it - and enter a more ominously reddish area and then face another image of Trigon who summons two of his sons. They also have drops of a choice of several items including 2 pieces of level 84 gear.

You will go pass a "window" from where you can see the heart of the prison where Trigon is - and there is a hysterical cultist who says it is not worth it any more and he wants out (but he does not flee like the others).
When you enter the first lava-filled room, Trigon summons the Avatar of Sin, who again has similar drops.

Enter Trigon's Chamber. You must defeat Circe (heroes) or Wonder Woman (villains). Trigon cannot be attacked, but he will still attack. Do not go near Trigon as his Hellfire Field in front of him will deal continuous damage as long as you are standing on it. After a while, Trigon will grab hold of your opponent (rendering them untargetable) while you have to defeat a wave of demons before they can be targeted again.
Right Strike: Trigon uses his right arm to pummel the south side.
Left Strike: Trigon uses his left arm to pummel the north side.
Power Strike: Trigon uses both arms to pummel the center area.
Hell Beams: Trigon's four eyes shoot at a single point, then draw a random line across the battlefield.
Fire Strike: Trigon gather orange energy in front of him, lifts it overhead, and tosses it at a player.
Fire Bowl: Trigon gather orange energy in front of him, and pushes it at a player, making it roll across the battlefield.
Upon Circe/Wonder Woman's defeat, Circe will still be able to charge the Victory Stone and plan to use it to start a war. The barrier will be raised again, keeping Trigon in a slumber.

sections.title: Mystery Maze
items: The first area of the map is the Mystery Maze, a mansion-like setting with various corridors. Some lead to dead-ends, and the right path is set randomly.

Clean the rooms of Greater Lust Demons to unlock new passages, though one of the doors will always be locked. If you get to a dead-end, go back to the previous room and take a different path. Your objective is to get to the next rally point (the player's location on the map).
You'll find the first subboss in the last room.

sections.title: First Subboss
items: This boss will either be the Fanatic of Lust or an iconic character, depending on player's faction. Heroes have a chance to find Jinx, who is looking for Cheetah, while villains have chance to find Zatanna, who is looking for Donna Troy - both will be trying to get through a magic-sealed passage.

Fanatic of Lust: uses dual wield weapons, and will draw power from the statues of Jacob around her to fuel her ranged attack Zealous Outburst. If you destroy the statues, she'll teleport and use a closed-ranged attack instead: Temper Tantrum.
Jinx: she has Hand Blast Mastery and the Ground Pound Mastery skill; her abilities are Channel, Stone, and Sand Storm - it is advisable to avoid the storm, as it will deal damage overtime.
Zatanna: uses Hand Blast weapon style; additionally conjures 2 magic clones of herself, and uses the ranged ability Magic Trick.
If you get knocked out, you'll be teleported back to the entrance.
Defeating this subboss will unlock the next area.

sections.title: Maintenance Hall
items: Defeat the Lust Demons in the area and inspect the magic-sealed passage (you'll only be able to do that after defeating the first group of Demons in the area). You have to find a way to get through. Open the room at the end of the hall and you'll find the next subboss.

sections.title: Second Subboss
items: Heroes will find Cheetah confronting Jacob, who will enchant her to attack the heroes instead and teleport away.
Cheetah: has the Martial Arts weapon style, prefers melee attacks.
Villains will find Donna Troy confronting Jacob, who will enchant her to attack the villains instead and teleport away.

Donna Troy: has the Martial Arts weapon style, but she also uses her abilities involving her Lasso of Persuasion such as Lasso Fling and Lasso Slam, as well as Amazonian Aegis. Beware her Bracer Deflection ability, as it will deflect your attacks back to you.

After defeating this boss, players will be able to interact with the stone on the altar. Take the stone to the magical barrier, and the passage will be clear. Continue through the hall and defeat the Cultists until you get to the next area.

sections.title: Tunnel of Lust
items: Now, you're in the Tunnel of Lust de facto. Here, you'll need to find 3 stones identical to the one you used to open the passage. Defeat the Cultists and Demons that guard them, then take them to the end of the tunnel and use them to break the final barrier. To make it more efficient, carry the stones with you and throw them when you have to fight, then repeat until you get to the end.

Once the barrier is destroyed, you'll be approached by a couple of demons: Devoted Succubus and Devoted Incubus, Jacob's personal guardians. Once one of them is defeated, the other will stop fighting and run, leading you to their boss.

Now, you're in Jacob's room. He is protected by a gigantic shield that's powered by the Cultists around him. Engage with all Cultists to disrupt the spell. Once the barrier is down, Jacob will attack you.

sections.title: Final Boss: Jacob
items: Jacob has a few especial abilities such as Hysteria and Desire, but his main mechanics are as follows:

From time to time, Jacob will trap himself in a shield in the middle of the circle of pedestals. He will say "You will burn with Desire, until your partner chooses me," pointing to one of the players, who will be paralyzed and suffer damage overtime. The remaining player has to pick one of the stones scattered across the room and place it on one of the pedestals to free their partner and force Jacob out of his shield. If the targeted player gets knocked out, Jacob will do the same to the remaining player, and you'll have to restart the fight.

Placing the stones empowers Jacob. Once all of five stones are placed, Jacob will reach full power and become invincible - in short, this boss has a time limit, so he must be defeated as soon as possible.
If you're playing this duo solo, Jacob will not paralyze you at first. You must place the stone quickly, before he targets you, as he will knock you out.

items: The side boss fight with James will only be accessible if the duo is played in the story arc Nightmare at the Knightsdome.

The Cupid can be found trapped in a cage in a few locations. This might explain how Jacob was able to make people fall in love with him, since he's the embodiment of lust, not love.

summary: Ultimate Soldier is a Tier 4 8 player operation in Age of Justice released in May 2017. It also features an elite version.

sections.title: Overview
items: Ultimate Soldier is a Tier 4 8 player operation in Age of Justice released in May 2017. It also features an elite version.
Access to the Ultimate Soldier operation requires a combat rating of 150.
Access to Age of Justice is available to all players.
Defend the battlefield from the Ultimate Soldier.

sections.title: Story
items: Unsurprisingly, it didn’t take much convincing to get Doctor Sivana, the infamous evil scientist and sworn enemy of the Justice Society, to join with Per Degaton and Baron Von Savage in their attempt to rewrite history. He’s already taking fallen soldiers from the battlefield and fusing them with technology from other timelines in an attempt to construct an abomination of pure evil: the Ultimate Soldier!

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Wearing the Temporal Paradox Capacitor style in the elite version of the operation will grant the option to spawn a Savage Temporal Commander before the fight against the Ultimate Soldier by using a console and thus gain more loot.
This operation allows further customization of difficulty once you defeat the mobs at the beginning:

The slow but easy way is to use the 2 portals at the Battlefield. One goes to the Alternate World War II Universe which leads to the Gentleman Ghost and the other goes to the Nanda Parbat of the Recent Past which leads to Solomon Grundy, both with mobs on the way. After defeating them, return to the Battlefield to defeat the Ultimate Soldier.

The fastest but most difficult way is to go straight to the Battlefield and defeat the Ultimate Soldier. After a while in battle a shield effect appears on him (looks like a green Light Barrier), he would rapidly recover any further lost health, and Gentleman Ghost appears. This happens again later with Solomon Grundy. Both extra bosses must be defeated before the Ultimate Soldier can be defeated. Those two would lose most of their unique mechanics if fought this way, but you are still fighting 3 bosses at once.
The Ultimate Soldier attacks with Rifle and has the following abilities:
Blazing Heat: The Ultimate Soldier fires a flamethrower that deals massive damage in a cone in front of him. Warned by lethal attack icon.
Arc Arm: He punches the sky, shooting lightning and damages all targets, blasting them back.
Bomb: A WWII-era bomb falls to the ground, marking the detonation zone in an orange circle before exploding.

sections.title: Overview
items: Not to be confused with Challenges
Open world portal to T.O. Morrow's Hideout in Gotham

A walk-in is a dungeon-like type of solo instance that can be accessed via an open-world portal. In these instances, rewards are limited, summaries are not always available, and the objectives don't refresh if the player immediately reenters them. While playing in a walk-in, it's possible to queue for any instance on the On Duty menu.

sections.title: Classic Walk-ins
items: The classic walk-ins, sometimes referred as "story mode", are located throughout Gotham City and Metropolis (except for The Daily Planet, which can only be accessed via Watchtower or Hall of Doom). Some of them are only available specifically for characters of one of the three origins ( Magic, Meta, or Tech), depending on the faction ( hero or villain), but some of them are available to all heroes and/or villains in the form of challenges and duos with higher-level enemies and aditional bosses.

title: Wonderverse: Crypt of Penthesilea
summary: Wonderverse: Crypt of Penthesilea is a tier 6 4-player operation in the Wonderverse episode.

sections.title: Overview
items: Wonderverse: Crypt of Penthesilea is a tier 6 4-player operation in the Wonderverse episode.
Combat Rating: 280

sections.title: Story
items: Instead of turning over her share of Source Wall fragments, Queen Diana has sealed herself inside of the crypt of Penthesilea in Themyscira. Travel there and meet with Nubia. Together maybe you can convinced Queen Diana to see reason.

sections.title: Characters
items: Nubia
Bombshell Diana
Queen Diana
Poseidon
The enemy combat rating is 316.

sections.title: Locations
items: Crypt of Penthesilea
Atlantis Bridge

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: After a few mobs, you find Queen Diana who flees deeper into the crypt and magically locking a gate behind her. You must go to three side rooms (Armory, Chamber of Rituals, Chamber of Relics) and unlock them all. For the Armory, there are 3 statues in the center of the room surrounded by weapons and shields that can be interacted with. 2 of the statues each have a weapon and a shield. 1 does not. You must interact with the correct weapon and shield lying around to match the armed statues. In the Chamber of Relics, multiple pedestals can be seen. The middle pedestal is empty, but the other is are adorned with relics that can be picked up. One must be moved to the empty pedestal. Many of the relics displayed here resemble ones that show up on similar pedestals in the main room and the halls leading to the side rooms. Similarly, the Chamber of Rituals has multiple Greek Symbols that can be interacted with. And only a small number of these symbols are repeated on walls outside the room.

Queen Diana reveals she wanted the Source shards' power to destroy Atlantis, despite Nubia's objection. You must defeat her. Avoid attacking her while she uses her reflecting bracers (warned with screen message). Another screen message appears warning players to block when Queen Diana attacks using her lasso. Those who don't block in time are pulled towards her and suffer damage. In addition, Queen Diana can weaken players by denying them access to their abilities. Affected players can undo this by interacting with nearby weapon racks.
Next, chase her through Atlantis - where she is swiftly defeated by Poseidon, the final boss. He has three key mechanics:
Water soldiers: They appear, inert, around the edges of the area. You must interact with them before the timer runs out to avoid them attacking.
Trident Slam and Trident Torrent: With a screen message warning, Poseidon slams down his trident before directing a torrent of water in front of him, dealing heavy continuous damage.
Water pools: Possibly the most troublesome, multiple water pools would constantly appear in the whole area, erupting after a brief delay and dealing massive damage to all targets caught within.

sections.title: Story
items: We've learned from Poseidon that the Sphere of the Gods is crumbling and that the Gods themselves have been collecting Source Wall shards to try and repair it. The Council of Wonder Women know that we need those shards to repair the universe. Enter the God Sphere and reclaim the shards. Expect Resistance.

sections.title: Locations
items: Fractured God Sphere

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: You navigate through a series of hallways resembling previously visited locations, from Kahndaq to New Genesis, Apokolips to Olympus. You fight various add waves. While in the New Genesis area be careful of the Colony Hive Leader. When he does a skull icon above his head he will generate a green field and shield other nearby enemies. Do not damage these as their health will regenerate and it will also reflect damage back at the group at the end of the attack. This can KO a number of players or even cause a wipe if this mechanic isn't adhered.
Shortly after traversing from the Underworld area into the Apokolips area you encounter Grail.

sections.title: First boss: Grail
items: Mechanics:

sections.title: Mind control mechanic:
items: Grail may inflict 1-2 players with Mind Control, rendering them unable to control their characters. This may become tricky in the elite version later in the fight when it targets heals or tanks.
You can free these players with light damage, but be careful not to do heavy damage during this time.
Be especially careful if you are a Celestial Might DPS, as Plague/Corrupted Divine Light glyphs can be deadly if a mind-controlled player walks into them.

(If you are heal and have Super-Speed movement mode, using Speed Drain is a good supercharge ability to use on mind-controlled players, and should do the right amount of damage to free them. Make sure to heal those players once they are freed.)
Try not to free mind-controlled players while they are in line of sight of Grail during her staff slam/throw, or try not to free the mind-controlled players while they are in spinning axes.
While players are under Mind Control, they will have a red shield around them. If they go near players that are not affected by Mind Control, those players will take moderate damage over time.

sections.title: Other mechanics:
items: Blink Attack: Grail may teleport and do a staff slam attack, be sure to stay to the left or right of where she is facing. She will then likely throw her staff ( Hammer Throw), this can be stopped by lunging (Hold Square on PS) her. Being in line of sight of this attack as a non-Tank will do heavy damage or probably KO, especially in the elite version.

Father Box: This will be active throughout the boss encounter, and may spawn red Gravity Well AOE fields. If players are in or near these they will take damage over time and may be crowd controlled and thrown to another area of the room. This may also deal single target damage to an affected player in range ( Apokobeam).

Grail may do a reflect attack - this will be indicated via red text on the screen, a skull icon over Grail's head, and voice over. Do not attack Grail with weapon/powerset abilities during this time as it will reflect damage and knock players away. You may however use an Orbital Strike on Grail while she is doing this for damage out.
Focused Blast: Grail may have a red skull icon before firing a red omega beam around herself. This will do heavy damage to (perhaps KO) players in melee or perhaps midrange of her.

Knockback Attack: Grail may surge up in the air and do a slight knock back. During this time her defence will be higher for a short time, so DPS should refrain from using their bigger damage abilities around this time.

Omega Execute: Grail will prepare an Omega Beam attack, indicated by a Omega symbol timer above her head. Do heavy damage around this time, or she will Omega Beam an affected player with the Omega symbol above their head. In Elite, if the affected player does not have at least one Rank 23 Wonderverse Augment equipped they will be KO'd from this attack. If you pass the damage check, Grail will spawn Omega Orbital Strikes on all players, which should be avoided or those players will take considerable damage.

Grail may summon Parademon enemies to her side. These should be taken out straight away, and be especially vigilant of Parademon Maniacs as they may attack random group members even if the other Parademons are being kept aggro by the Tank or Tanks. The add spawns usually happen when Grail is damaged down to approximately 80%/60%/40%/20% of her maximum health. (up to 4 add spawns)

In Elite, Grail will spawn several Summoned Weapon axes which will spin around and follow two players in the group. These do moderate damage over time (and knockback) if a player is in them ( Spinning Cleave). The two players will have an arrow above their heads. You should be careful where you place axes, as especially later safe zones will become increasingly limited with add spawns. Be careful not to attack Grail during reflect phases in this case. If you are knocked out under an axe it is very difficult to revive that player so try not to if possible. Having high single target damage on Grail should make the fight go faster and this will be less of a risk to the group.

It isn't recommended in this fight to use a Supply Drop in the elite version of the raid, apart from early during Grail's reflect phase and early during Grail's Omega Beam damage check (when the omega icon is above her head). If you use a Supply Drop Grail will lunge and use a spinning move on the player that used a Supply Drop, KO'ing any nearby players.

After defeating Grail, the group proceeds through the Apokolips area, defeating any adds on the way. Towards the end of this area there is a room with a large pit in the middle - do not fall down this or it will KO you. Be vigilant of some of the Parademon mobs as they may shoot bombs that knock players back - this may knock players off down the pit to their deaths. After this room, you proceed through a Heaven section followed by a Hell section, defeating more mobs, before making it to the Olympus inspired area. Be vigilant of Olympian Lions here as they can stun and do heavy damage - make sure the tank aggro's these first. After climbing a staircase you arrive at the last boss: Zeus.

sections.title: First phase:
items: You will fight effigies/statues that in a random order two-by-two start to attack the group. The tank should be vigilant to where each add spawns as there is a shield/dome in the middle of the room which may hinder movement. In the regular version these effigies shouldn't be too threatening. In the elite version:
Effigy of Athena/Effigy of Ares will have a DPS role icon above their heads, and will debuff DPS close by. If you DPS while close to this effigy you will do very low damage output.

Effigy of Zeus/Effigy of Aphrodite will have a Tank role icon above their heads, and will debuff tank/s close by. These should be KO'd ASAP, otherwise they are a great danger to the tank and by extension the group as well.
Effigy of Hades/Effigy of Poseidon will have a Heal role icon above their heads, and will debuff heal/s close by.
Effigy of Hera/Effigy of Hecate will have a Controller role icon above their heads, and will debuff a controller if it is close by.

sections.title: Second phase:
items: Zeus becomes active in the fight after a minute or so of dialogue.

During this time in (Elite) all players should position properly, with the tank/s in the middle of the room with Zeus, and all other players spread out around the edge of the room in between each pillar. DPS should of course be positioned so they can target Zeus and any add spawns. The healers don't have to be able to target lock enemies the entire time; their priority will be healing the group.
Mechanics:

sections.title: Cage mechanic:
items: Some players will get caged ( Source Cage). There will be a small white electrical animation under the feet of players who are going to be affected by this.
Once players are encased in a Source Cage and while they are caged, they will take mild to moderate damage over time.

In the regular version, you should avoid breaking out at too close a time to another player, as when you break out of a cage you will do raid wide AOE damage to other players. With overlapping cage breakouts this can lead to KOs so be careful.

In elite you will have to have a set order/timing of when players should break out. The typical group setup for this boss fight in the elite version will be 1 tank, 2 heals, 1 controller and 4 DPS. In this case, the tank should breakout first as the tank will have the aggro of Zeus and any add spawns that may appear. The heal will be next priority. Then the DPS, then the Controller.

Ideally the DPS should have a damage over time attack in their load out (or Brawling weapon mastery if you are a precision DPS) that can free the tank quickly without risking Zeus aggro'ing the rest of the group and causing unnecessary KOs.

If you have 2 tanks then heal is the main priority to break out first as they will need to heal the group while the other cage breakouts are going on. Do not break out at the same time as another player as the overlapping AOE damage on the group may lead to KOs. Voice chat might be helpful if players are new to this boss fight in the elite version.

If you are caged too close to someone else who is also caged (either another player or Wonder Woman NPC), you will take additional damage over time (displayed as Gravity Well in the combat log). This is more likely in the elite version but not exclusively.

sections.title: Other mechanics:
items: Source Storm: There will be 4 source storms rotating around the map at the start of every cage phase for a time. They won't be active all the time during second phase, but avoid them. In the elite version most of the group should be positioned around the edge of the boss room. Also during the last phase there will be an additional source storm in the middle of the room as well so whoever is in the middle of the room (ie. the tank) should be vigilant of this. In the last phase the source storms will continue to move around the room without stopping until the fight is over.

(Elite only) Catastrophic Source Overload: Often during the cage phase (but not always), one player will start getting bigger, and will do so 3 times. The animation will interrupt your powerset rotation. It is highly recommended that before the 3rd animation that you block (hold R1 on PS to block), as the 3rd animation will do large damage to you. Make sure you aren't near other players while you have this mechanic.

(Elite only) Random players may get an electrical AOE underneath them - usually players closer to Zeus but not always. Move out of the way of this AOE but don't go too close to other players as you may do large damage to them during the time this AOE is active ( Arc Lightning). This often happens in between the cage phase and Zeus' lunge phase.

At approximately 80%/60%/40%/20% of Zeus' health, adds will spawn. KO these as soon as possible while managing other mechanics, and ensure the tank has aggro of all mobs as they may attack nearby players instead.

Sometime after the cage phase has ended, Zeus will prepare a powerful attack (shown by an electric icon and timer above his head). If group members lunge this several times it will stop the attack, however if not Zeus will become invulnerable for a short period and do a powerful raidwide AOE attack ( Omega Source Blast) (indicated by a red skull icon above his head). Players should block this (being cautious of other mechanics ongoing) and heals should have burst heals at the ready especially in the elite version. After this source storms will re-appear again and another cage phase will commence.

It isn't recommended throughout this fight to use an Orbital on Zeus in the elite version, apart from early during the lunge phase when Zeus has the electric icon and timer above his head. This is best reserved for when there are add spawns. If you orbital Zeus otherwise during the fight, he will spawn white lightning orbitals on all players on the group. Avoid these immediately or they will KO.
Ground Pound: Zeus may occasionally do a shockwave, dealing damage to nearby players and knocking them back.

sections.title: Last phase:
items: Once Zeus is at approximately 15% health he will restore to approximately 45% health and knock everyone back ( Ground Pound). Make sure you are positioned in a way that doesn't get you knocked back into a Source Storm if they are active at the time, or you may get KO'd during the cutscene after. After a brief cutscene the Wonder Woman allies will spawn and join the fight at your side.
Phase is similar to second phase except with a few differences:
Source storms continue throughout, and in elite a source storm also appears in the middle of the room.
There is no lunge phase or add spawns

sections.title: Wonder Woman/group members cage mechanic notes/considerations:
items: Cage phases and the 'big' mechanic become more frequent.
Zeus' defence is higher in this phase, however the Wonder Womans will debuff his defence if they aren't caged or knocked out.
Players should ensure the Wonder Woman allies are alive and free them from a cage if they get caged so they can debuff Zeus.

Ensure that you free any Wonder Women from a cage when other players in the group aren't caged themselves, otherwise (more so in elite) it may become tricky with overlapping cage breakout AOE damage and may lead to players being KO'd.

Also note that cage breakout AOE damage can in itself do damage to other cages that players/Wonder Women are trapped in, so this may breakout those players at unplanned moments and lead to further raid wide AOE damage, again more in elite.
Make sure you don't make a habit of overlapping cage breakout damage, and that your heal/s are at their best healing the incoming damage.

When a Wonder Woman ally NPC gets broken out of their cage, on the combat log it will display the damage dealt to the group during cage breakout as Gravity Well. This is likely meant to be displayed as Source Cage.
Once you have defeated Zeus you have finished the boss fight and the raid.

title: Ace Chemicals (Alert)
summary: Ace Chemicals is a classic Tier 1 alert accessible via both On Duty menu and portal in Gotham City.

sections.title: Overview
items: Ace Chemicals is a classic Tier 1 alert accessible via both On Duty menu and portal in Gotham City.
Access to the Alert requires Level 30. Players with Combat Rating (CR) 59 or less will have their stats increased to 60, while players with 89+ CR will have their stats clamped to 88.
It is also available as a 4-player Alert in Legends PvE.

sections.title: Background
items: In many of his varied origin stories, Ace Chemicals is more often than not the location of the Joker's transformation from small-time hood to the twisted and disfigured Clown Prince of Crime after falling into a vat of chemicals.

After being defeated by Joker's and Batman's mentees in his own hideout, T.O. Morrow takes over Joker's Ace Chemicals in order to conduce dangerously unethical chemical experiments. Batman sends a team of new heroes to put an end to Morrow's insanity, while Joker sends a squad of new villains to take Ace back from Morrow.

sections.title: Story
items: The Joker considers Ace Chemicals his own private lair, but his rogue ex-partner, T.O. Morrow, has taken over the place to continue his terrifying experiments with the Joker's new toxin. Put a stop to the plans of tomorrow.

title: Avarice Impurity
summary: Avarice Impurity is a Tier 3 4-player hero Operation in the War of the Light Part II Episode.

sections.title: Overview
items: Avarice Impurity is a Tier 3 4-player hero Operation in the War of the Light Part II Episode.
Hal Jordan traveled to Mogo in response to a distress signal, but there has been no word from him since he left! Get to Mogo and investigate.

references.label: War of the Light Part II

sections.title: Act 1
items: The operation starts at Mogo's Command Center. Orange Lanterns have overrun the Sentient Planet, so you must clear them out. After you clear out all the Orange Lanterns, you'll find Hal Jordan in the east room, where Avaricious Penguin is guarding him. Defeat him, then free Hal Jordan. He tells you that Larfleeze is at the Oa Central Power Battery trying to infect it with the Citrine mist, so you must travel there to stop him.

sections.title: Act 2
items: You arrive at Oa, and you must get to the Central Power Battery to intercept Larfleeze. You fight mobs of Orange Lanterns on the way and the second subboss, Avaricious Lex Luthor. You then proceed to the upper level, and reach Larfleeze. At the start of the fight, he cannot be damaged. To remove his shield, you must enter the Battery and neutralize the Citrine Mists found it there. Glomulus is also inside the battery, and will try to stop you. Larfleeze's shield is brought down after you neutralize enough Citrine mists. After Larfleeze is defeated, he retreats. And Hal Jordan thanks you for helping defend the Central Power Battery.
Combat Rating requirement: 100
