sections.title: Overview
items: The Avatar of Tech is an avatar of Brainiac spearheading the attack on the nexus of technology; the Batcave. Following their defeat of Brother Eye, the players must infiltrate the Batcave: Brainiac Subconstruct and destroy the avatar to end Brainiac's attack.
The avatar is the last boss encountered in the Batcave: Brainiac Subconstruct raid.

sections.title: Involvement
items: Batman has been infected with the OMAC virus and Brainiac is one step closer to digitizing all of Earth. You must assault his lair in the Batcave and stop him.

sections.title: Combat
items: As expected from a raid boss, the Avatar of Tech has a horrendous amount of health and dishes out copious amounts of damage. It does not seem to move. It mainly uses three attacks - a rocket attack that hits ~500 multiple times rapidly, a flamethrower attack that could be avoided by staying at the edge of your own attack range, and a homing missile attack, which hits up to over 1500. It signals its missile attack by having a laser target appearing at the player's feet. However, unlike the missile attack of the Brainiac Interceptors, which also displays a laser target, this cannot be dodged. The target simply follows the player. Therefore, use block, or any other damage prevention measure, and quickly. Players next to targets may dodge to avoid splash damage.

After taking some damage, it spawns an Avatar Crawler. The avatar cannot be damaged while it is active. After defeating it, and then the Avatar itself, the gigantic avatar would break apart, revealing the dreaded Brainiac himself. Brainiac doesn't seem to do as much damage, but he summons Eradicators and again, has another massive health bar.

sections.title: Trivia
items: Avatars of Tech appeared as Brainiac's invasion forces during the Battle of Legends Beta event.

sections.title: Overview
items: " This is Batman. Oracle's told me how you fought through the outer defenses. The Batcave isn't usually open to... visitors, but this is a crisis. Brainiac has reactivated Brother Eye and is using his information to hack into the Batcomputer. Catwoman is trapped further along. Help her to escape while I activate the Batcave's final security protocols, and I'll meet you in the inner sanctum." — Batman

The Batcave proper, the Batcave: Inner Sanctum houses the many rooms and stations Batman uses in his war against crime. Hangars, garages, crime labs and computer mainframes are spread throughout a network of caverns and tunnels directly beneath Wayne Manor that allow the headquarters to both exist as a hidden location and act as a veritable and defensible fortress of technology.

The Armored Robotic Custodian, Zetta Drone, and Brother Eye have all had their health and damage reduced in game update 24. A tier 2 alert version of this raid is also released. If entered via the portal in Watchtower/Hall of Doom, it is considered to be the raid version, affected its loot locks.

items: See Raid T1: Inner Sanctum
Brainiac has co-opted Brother Eye, Batman's sentient satellite, and the OMAC virus to take over the Batcave. With Batman's allies compromised, the world depends on you to face down Brother Eye.

title: BoP: Volcano Mining Facility
summary: BoP: Volcano Mining Facility is a tier 5 alert in the Birds of Prey episode.

sections.title: Overview
items: BoP: Volcano Mining Facility is a tier 5 alert in the Birds of Prey episode.
Combat Rating: 210 or better

sections.title: Story
items: Follow intrepid reporters Lois Lane and Jimmy Olsen as they investigate Luthor's hidden lair. No one's shocked that Luthor built a volcano lair, but he has plenty of surprises in store for uninvited guests!

sections.title: Characters

sections.title: Locations
items: Volcano Mining Facility

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: You start the alert by joining Superman, Jimmy Olsen and Lois Lane in the Volcano Mining Facility. Along with your group you proceed through several corridors, defeating LexCorp enemies along the way. Eventually you encounter a bigger room where robots will appear and attack you.

sections.title: First boss: Waves of Robots
items: Very straightforward boss encounter and should be doable for most groups.
The boss encounter starts with fighting a single Worker Robot add, before several more Worker Robot adds spawn to join the fight. Defeat them.
Note that if you stand near a fallen Robot, they will arc damage to you, dealing mild damage ( Pile of Robot Parts).

On each corner of the room are four consoles, and after the second wave of Worker Robots two of these at random will be able to be interacted with within a certain time. There will be onscreen text when this occurs, stating: "Turn off belts before another robot worker emerges!". If both of these consoles aren't activated in time,

After the console phase, there will be onscreen text stating: "M.E.R.C.Y. has blocked access to the terminals!", and another wave of Worker Robots will spawn. Defeat them. If both consoles were interacted with successfully before, only 2 Worker Robots will spawn, if not then 3 will spawn.

Afterwards there will be onscreen text stating: "Defeat the giant robots!". The Pile of Robot Parts on the ground will be transformed into a Buzzsaw Foreman sub boss. If the consoles before weren't interacted with successfully, a Jackhammer Foreman subboss will also spawn. Their mechanics are very basic, with brawling weapon abilities, and they may charge at group members. Try not to stay too close to them as they can hit quite hard if they hurt you with their attacks for too long. Defeat the giant robots to complete the encounter.

Afterwards, you proceed further into the facility, defeating more LexCorp enemies along the way. Eventually you enter a large room, where Lois Lane and Jimmy Olsen attempt to investigate what is going on at the facility further. While doing so, Jimmy Olsen inadvertently spawns a more advanced robot, and accidentally names it "Amazeballs", before changing the robot's name to Amazo.

sections.title: Second boss: Amazo
items: A very interesting and well designed boss encounter, but not especially difficult. Should be doable for most groups as long as mechanics are followed.
Mechanics:

Shortly into the fight, Amazo will jump and punch the ground ( Coupe de Grace), knocking players back and dealing moderate damage. Around this time there will be onscreen text stating: "Amazo has surrounded himself in a shield of hard light!". Amazo will have increased defence until further notice.
Seismic Emission: During phase transitions Amazo may blink to the middle of the room. Players in range will take damage and be knocked back.

sections.title: Superman/Batman phase:
items: There will be onscreen text stating: "Amazo is combining the powers of Superman and Batman!".

Bat Mine: Amazo will spawn numerous Bat Mines around the room. If a player stands near them a timer will appear, and at the end of the timer the Bat Mine will explode. If this affects players it will deal mild damage and stun the player affected. Note that if multiple Bat Mines detonate and their respective AOEs stack up on the same player the initial mild damage can stack up to become major damage and may cause issues.

sections.title: Superman/Flash phase:
items: There will be onscreen text stating: "Amazo is combining the powers of Superman and the Flash!".

Snownado: Various tornados will spawn and move around the room. If a player is hit directly they will take some damage and may be encased in a large amount of ice. When that player breaks out of the ice they may deal major damage (possibly KO) to nearby players if those players are too close.

sections.title: Superman/Green Lantern phase:
items: There will be onscreen text stating: "Amazo is combining the powers of Superman and Green Lantern!".

Green Light Vortex: Amazo will blink to the middle of the room and have a red skull icon above his head. He will then create several train track constructs with train constructs all moving towards him. This is pretty difficult to avoid, but affected players will take significant damage and be knocked back by incoming train constructs towards the boss.

Pain Trains: Amazo will have a red skull icon while spinning a green train construct around him. Players in nearby range will take significant damage. Amazon may travel to several areas of the room while spinning his trains. Eventually he will throw his train construct away. Players who take any direct impact from the train constructs will take significant damage and may be knocked back.

sections.title: Superman/Wonder Woman phase:
items: There will be onscreen text stating: "Amazo is combining the powers of Superman and Wonder Woman!".

Lasso of Truth: Amazo will have a red skull icon while whipping around a large yellow lasso, before lifting all players far up in the air and then hard stunning all players. Players will need to spam a button (Square on PS) to breakout, and do so quickly. Amazo will then have another red skull icon above his head before doing a 360 degree Heat Vision Sweep laser attack. This will do heavy damage especially if affected players aren't blocking, so make sure you breakout of the lasso as soon as possible and then block the laser.

sections.title: (Optional) Red Sun Projector
items: To the east of the room there will be a teleporter to a shielded area with a terminal. If a player goes and activates the Red Sun Projector via the terminal, shortly after Amazo will be stunned briefly and will be knocked out for a short time. This will also remove his defence buff he gained earlier in the boss encounter.

sections.title: Amazo absorb player's powers phase:
items: There will be onscreen text stating: "Amazo is copying your powers!".

Amazo can absorb any group member's power, including all of the 15 power sets available in DC Universe Online (Fire, Ice, Gadgets, Mental, Nature, Sorcery, Light, Electricity, Earth, Quantum, Celestial, Rage, Munitions, Atomic, Water)

(Note that Amazo can only absorb the powers of the players in the group, and as such only 0-4 of these powers may be observed in a single play through. It is possible to skip through this phase as well.)

sections.title: Turret defence phase:
items: When Amazo is at 35% health (approximately) onwards to the end of the boss encounter, 4 Defense Turret adds will spawn into the fight in each corner of the main platform where you are fighting Amazo. They will fire damage towards the group ( Machine Gun).
There will be onscreen text when this occurs, stating: "M.E.R.C.Y. activated turret defenses!".

After Amazo is defeated, the group will proceed into an elevator and will transition into the next area of the facility. There are more LexCorp robots here but most can be skipped. There will be one corridor where the group will need to navigate through drone attack patterns and defeat a wall formed by Mini Drone adds. Once you have got past this, skip past the adds, carefully proceed past the Arachnobots and find Lex Luthor awaiting you in the final room of the facility.

sections.title: Last boss: Lex Luthor
items: A fairly tricky boss encounter for regular alert standards. Requires decent damage and adherence to mechanics, and preferably a decent healer in the group also.
Mechanics:
LexCorp Toxic Resin: Lex Luthor will have a red skull icon above his head, before exploding various toxic AOEs to players in range. Does moderate damage.
Power Suit Blast: Lex Luthor will charge over to a random player and spin in the air, causing a shockwave. Affected players will take moderate damage and may be knocked back.
LexCorp Surface Strike: Lex Luthor will spawn an orbital strike on a targeted player. Does heavy damage over time and may stun an affected player/s.

Rocket Barrage: Lex Luthor may fire rocket projectiles around the room. These are easy to miss, however if a player is hit directly by them (especially if in succession) this can do moderate to considerable damage.
Rocket Launcher: Lex Luthor will have a red skull icon above his head, before firing rockets at a targeted player. Does moderate to considerable damage.
LexCorp Healing Salve: Lex Luthor will have a red skull icon above his head, before leaving a green gas AOE near his targeted player. Does mild damage and may stun the affected player.
Taser Pull: Lex Luthor will have a red skull icon above his head, before using a taser pull ability on a targeted player. Does mild to moderate damage.

Gravity Well: Lex Luthor will have a red skull icon above his head while looking at a targeted player, before stunning them with a cosmic energy. This energy deals considerable damage over time to the affected player and may hard stun them, and that player may have to spam a button (Square on PS) to break out. it is best practice for players to stay away from a player affected by the Gravity Wall cosmic aura, or they will also take heavy damage over time. There is a chance Lex Luthor may use this ability on more than one player at the same time.

sections.title: Warsuit mechanic:
items: Periodically, Lex Luthor will spawn a Warsuit ( Warsuit Mark I, Warsuit Mark II, Warsuit Mark III, Warsuit Mark IV) to assist him in battle. Players will need to defeat the Warsuit add in order to progress through the boss encounter. Note also that Lex Luthor will have a green shield around him, and will be invulnerable to incoming damage from the group while a Warsuit add is active in the boss encounter.

There will be onscreen text when a Warsuit spawns, stating: "A Warsuit has been activated!". There will be onscreen text regarding the shield, stating: "The linked energy between war suits is protecting Lex Luthor!".

If a player is stood close to a fallen Warsuit, they may take a mild damage over time and possibly arc damage to other nearby players. (This mechanic does not have a name in the combat log and it is implied the Warsuit is attacking the player directly)

sections.title: Explosive trap mechanic:
items: Periodically, M.E.R.C.Y. will spawn several explosive traps around the room, which players can pick up and move/throw to another part of the room.
There will be onscreen text when this occurs, stating: "Avoid the explosive traps dropped from the ceiling!".
LexCorp Security Device: If a player is near an explosive trap when it goes off, they will take major damage.

sections.title: All turret phases:
items: 4 Sentry Turret adds will spawn in the fight. Players should defeat these as soon as possible, especially in subsequent phases.
There will be onscreen text when this occurs, stating "M.E.R.C.Y. activated Kryptonite Turrets!".
There will also be onscreen text stating: "Protect Superman from Kryptonite Turrets!".
Though these turrets will be focusing damage at Superman, if a player is hit by the turret's Concentrated Energy Beam they will take major damage over time while directly affected by the green beam.

sections.title: Second turret phase onwards:
items: When Lex Luthor gets to approximately 50% health, the fallen Sentry Turrets will spawn again with more defence.
There will be onscreen text stating: "The turrets have been repaired and made sturdier!"
There will also be onscreen text stating: "Protect Superman so he can freeze over the ruptured tubes!".
From the second turret phase onwards, each of these phases acts as a damage check and possibly a heal check also. The Sentry Turrets need to be defeated as soon as possible.
There will be onscreen text stating: "Coolant has been released into the room!". Alternatively there may be onscreen text stating: "Thermal energy has been released into the room!".

Environmental Energy Spill: Groupwide AOE that deals consistent moderate damage over time. If the turrets take too long to get defeated the damage over time will increase to become considerable damage over time, on top of other mechanics. This is likely to be one of the more troublesome mechanics of the boss encounter.
When the turret phase is successfully passed, there will be onscreen text stating: "Superman froze over the breach!". The Environmental Energy Spill damage over time will stop.

sections.title: Power core phase:
items: There will be onscreen text stating: "M.E.R.C.Y. healed Lex and increased his defenses!".
Lex Luthor will have a shield for the remainder of the boss encounter that will mitigate incoming damage from the group.

There will then be onscreen text stating: "Gather power cores to create an EMP blast!". The fallen Warsuits from earlier in the fight can now be interacted with in order to gather their power cores. The player will then need to interact with The Huntress to give her the power core. Once all power cores have been obtained there will be a short wait before an EMP blast detonates Lex Luthor's shield, defeating him in the process and finishing the boss encounter.
Once you have beaten Lex Luthor you have completed the alert.

sections.title: Trivia
items: It is revealed that Lex Luthor has been working with the heroes (such as in Earth 3, where he alluded to having a secret plan to villains but never said what it is) to study and copy the powers of the Justice League for Amazo to use.
Lex Luthor has captured The Council of Luthors (except for Future Lex Luthor), encountered in Nexus of Reality, and used them to upgrade his warsuit.

Despite Lex Luthor having a mechanic called Gravity Well in his boss encounter, this Gravity Well has no resemblance in animation or impact to the target compared with the Gravity Well ability from the Quantum powerset.

The Amazo boss encounter marks the first and only time in DC Universe Online that an enemy can absorb one of any powerset in the game from any player in the group. As such there are a lot of abilities Amazo can potentially use depending on the situation, and no two encounters against Amazo will be the same (depending on the powers the group members are).

title: DoR: Desecrated Mausoleum
summary: DoR: Desecrated Mausoleum is a Tier 7 Solo Challenge in the Day of Reckoning chapter. It also features a Casual and an Elite version.

sections.title: Overview
items: Kaznia Crown
DoR: Desecrated Mausoleum is a Tier 7 Solo Challenge in the Day of Reckoning chapter. It also features a Casual and an Elite version.

There are two distinct versions of the instance. DoR: Desecrated Mausoleum is the standard one, playable via the On Duty menu. Reckoning's Hideout is a more story-heavy version players go through during the Day of Reckoning introduction mission series, which can be accessed freely afterwards via a portal on the island in Kaznia City. Story-wise, this instance follows the events in either the alert version or the raid version of Kaznian Necropolis.
DoR: Desecrated Mausoleum shares daily loot locks with Reckoning's Hideout and Kaznian Necropolis Strike.

sections.title: Story
items: You've tracked a powerful source of sin to their lair, a Desecrated Mausoleum. Discover the truth and face the harsh reality of uncontrollable power.

sections.title: Characters
items: Iconic Allies
Esperanza Cavalera
John Constantine
Voivode (cutscene only)
Indigo-1 (appearance only)
Iconic Foes
The Reckoning
Neron (appearance only)
Mobs

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Talk to Esperanza Cavalera to begin. She and John Constantine deduce that Luzia Cavalera is under the sway of demonic forces. Esperanza will follow and aid the player in battle throughout most of the instance.

After fighting through many demons, you reach a circular room with the forward path locked. After killing The Bulwark, a unique demon guarding it, John tells you to find a treasure item that would open the door.

There are a total of 7 treasures in the room, which are all coloured a dark red. The "correct" one is on the left (north) side. It looks like a giant candle in a rectangular box. To complete the feat, player must interact with the other 6 first. Easiest way is to start going clockwise to the right of it and finally interacting with the correct one.

sections.title: Runed door
items: It teleports you (and you alone) to a larger circular chamber underneath, where you need to find 3 runes to open the door. The 3 runes needed to unlock the door are different each run, displayed above the door. Interacting with the wrong rune would cause heavy damage. The runes are real-life Anglo-Saxon runes: ᛈ, ᛟ, ᛗ, ᛉ, ᚦ, ᛝ
There are 6 side chambers, each with a unique rune. In order, clockwise from the big door:
ᛈ: With the skull cross. You need to kill a few demons to open the gate.

ᛟ: With a near wall and a spiral corridor leading down, with many demons to kill on the way. There is a bug in that chamber where if you get KO'ed, it locks permanently preventing you from accessing that rune (does not seem to occur in other chambers).

ᛗ: The rune is easily visible from the entrance. You need to interact with 4 books on pedestals. Demonic Tomes will fly at you. You are given a shield overhead warning for seconds before they connect and deal heavy damage. If blocked, they do no damage (still damages pets)
ᛉ: Rune barely visible from entrance (locked behind a gate). Need to kill 3 Demonic Enforcers.
ᚦ: (Note the game uses the triangular rendering of the rune, while Unicode renders it as semi-circular) Large bell; ring it and defeat demons.

ᛝ: Red monolith. Interact with it. You only need to defeat 1 Greater Demon, but fire pits also appear around the room dealing damage if you touch them. Do not confuse with the ᛟ rune as the game renders them similarly.
Here is a mnemonic system to remember which rune requires which room:
ᛈ: Looks like a sideways blood pool.
ᛟ: Looks like a spiral staircase.
ᛗ: Looks like an open book.
ᛉ: Looks like a stake where bodies are impaled.
ᚦ: Looks like a sideways bell.
ᛝ: Looks like the cracks on the monolith.

Once 3 runes are activated, the door opens and you rejoin John and Esperanza. You find a summoning chamber and John proposes to summon the demon responsible to try and stop them. You need to get 2 bits of demonic essence be defeating two demon subbosses in 2 side chambers. The Smouldering Demon (north) summons demonic minions, but they always prioritise Esperanza, and continues to target her even when she has been KO'ed. They disappear when the Smouldering Demon is defeated. The Exploding Demon (south) has a mechanic where it summons 3 bombs at fixed locations, and you can defuse the bombs by interacting with them, but if you kill it fast enough it may only use bombs once or even never. You may fight it at the north side of the chamber (near entrance) which only has 1 bomb that does not overlap unlike the 2 bombs at the south so you are safe just defusing one.

After defeating each demon subboss, interact with the demonic essence behind them to take them, then interact with the 2 spots next to the spell circle in the middle to deposit them. Talk to John, and Neron appears. John stays behind, holding Neron in a Fire Prison (damages and knocks you back if you touch it), while you and Esperanza must press on; over the course of the instance, Voivode is revealed to have entered beforehand but is being hunted down by The Reckoning.

sections.title: The Reckoning
items: At the final chamber, you find The Reckoning who has captured Voivode, and she proceeds to disintegrate her. You must defeat The Reckoning, who uses Brawling combos. However, she never uses its ranged basic attack or Stomp Smash, making block very effective against her. There is a healing barrel on the far side (east) of the room (including in Elite).

Exobyte Steal: This is the main mechanic of the fight. The Reckoning hard stuns the player with an unblockable red-black beam (same effect as used against Voivode), dealing some damage over time, and removing all player abilities, also preventing them from using weapon attacks. Block remains very useful for The Reckoning's weapon attacks. Players can restore themselves by going to the Blue Lantern symbol on the ground summoned by Esperanza after a few seconds. While the player is disabled, some of The Reckoning's attacks only deal single digit damage, but Illusionary Spirits will continue to deal significant damage (see below).

Oblivion: After saying "Nature, like me, is ravenous!" and the player is given a prompt to block (red icon with shield overhead), The Reckoning channels a bluish-white beam from her chest to the player, which hard stuns them for massive damage over time if not blocked.
Blizzard: After saying "Face the chill of the grave!" and marking a red circle on the floor, The Reckoning summons a Blizzard like the Ice ability, damaging anyone caught within.
Psychic Prison: A psychic field that damages targets on it over time.

Illusionary Spirits: Similar to the Mental ability Mass Hysteria, The Reckoning summons Illusionary Spirits to attack you (although she only summons 3 at a time instead of 5, they persist until killed and she can resummon them, and it does not change her form unlike Mass Hysteria). They are more focused on the player and their Taunt and Ranged Attack can add up.

After defeating The Reckoning, Esperanza unmasks her. Addressing her as Luzia, Esperanza offers her sister help, which arrives in the form of Indigo-1, who inducts her into the Indigo Tribe, forcing her to face her guilt, causing Luzia to break down in tears.

sections.title: Trivia
items: Instead of entering through the door to the final room with The Reckoning, players may also climb or fly through the hole in the wall above, which triggers the transition into the final boss encounter identically. If you go in through the hole but keep very close to the door, you can actually "enter" the boss counter by opening the door from the inside.
The Bulwark is originally named "Demonic Abomination" before being changed in late Feb 2025.

Prior to being fixed so that Esperanza does not attack before the player does, by manoeuvring Esperanza so that she gets close enough to The Reckoning, but without the player getting too close for The Reckoning to attack first (most easily done by flying/running up the chamber and going high above The Reckoning), Esperanza would attack first and The Reckoning will not retaliate as long as the player does not get too close or attack her. This allows The Reckoning to be defeated with no player input, even in Elite, although it takes a long time due to Esperanza's low damage output (~20 minutes in Elite). You must hit The Reckoning yourself at least once before she is KO'ed, or you will not receive loot (although the instance will still progress). If you attack The Reckoning after Esperanza does, The Reckoning would retaliate against her (and sometimes your pet) but she still tends not to target you. Esperanza gets KO'ed fairly easily but The Reckoning will continue targeting her, and Esperanza will self-revive after a while. You may also stand on pillars on the sides of the chamber to hit The Reckoning with ranged attacks, and she would rarely hit you at all. Pets like Robot Sidekick can help whittle down her health even if you cannot reach her. Note however that Illusionary Spirits are more aggressive towards you, can fly and their attacks are ranged.

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: This alert is divided into three stages, Purify, Escort and Felix Faust, counting as the First Subboss, Second Subboss, and Final Boss in the On Duty menu. Due to the unique gameplay, players often go all DPS in the Purify and Escort stages, only switching to more typical Team Roles composition for the Felix Faust boss fight.
Talk to Voivode and she points you to Constantine's portal at the entrance of the Necropolis.

sections.title: Purify
items: This stages involves capture point gameplay. In the alert, only 2 obelisks (north and west) are active. When players go through Constantine's portal, they will be teleported to one of them, with 2 players assigned to one, although they can freely move between them as needed.

Note: Currently, many players would skip this stage with a 5 minute wait (this does work in Elite, and still works in 2026 Campaign). After starting the instance, do not capture obelisks and wait for 5 minutes before capturing both. Undead mobs only spawn if you kill existing ones. This completes the purify stage. Additionally, this counts towards the No Take Backsies feat (can't lose an obelisk if you didn't claim one), which is otherwise one of the harder Normal feats in the instance.

Capture bars are displayed on the interface to the right of the screen. They start out fully red (100% Faust control). By being on the magic circle around the obelisk, players passively capture the point and push the yellow marker to the right, replacing the red with blue. Each player contributes 1 unit of capture speed. Faust will send waves of undead at the obelisks, and they capture for Faust at the same speed. Arrows (> or <) indicate the direction the marker is moving.

Once the marker is past halfway point, it is considered to be under player control. A timer starts to count down from 2 minutes before completion of this stage when both obelisks are under player control. If Faust recaptures an obelisk, the timer disappears and resets, but players will eventually complete the state after they recapture them a few times (control for the full duration is only required for a feat).

Typically, each wave consists of 2-3 undead, but occasionally, and seemingly randomly, a large horde would appear (with warning message), which can capture the obelisk for Faust in seconds. Players from the other obelisk may come over to deal with it. A horde always include one Dead Winter, a large undead with much higher health. Ignore it until all the other undead are killed, as all enemies capture at the same rate.

One way to stop the large horde from capturing is using Mesmerizing Lasso with Lasso of Truth (Artifact), which can continuously drag mobs to the user or they must use repeatedly use Pull abilities, with Dominance higher than enemy Willpower. They can go outside the circle while other players stay inside and kill the mobs.

In Elite, other than the mobs being tougher, Solomon Grundy will spawn shortly after start (with warning message). He cannot capture points, but will walk through the paths seemingly randomly until he spots a player and attacks. He is marked with the skull icon on the minimap similar to the open world boss in Kaznia City, and has very similar attacks, but hits much harder (Stomp Smash alone can deal one-shot damage). It is not required to kill him but he could be a significant nuisance, being much more dangerous than the other mobs. Note that during the Purify and Escort stages, KO'ed players can simply rejoin, even in Elite, so you would eventually be able to pass the stage even with many KO'es.
Once killed however, Grundy does not seem to respawn, which would make the purify and escort stages much more manageable.

sections.title: Escort
items: Once Purify is complete, players move onto the Escort stage. The capture bars continue to be active. An Avenging Spirit spawns from the obelisks. Interact with one and it would start flying towards Faust's shield in the middle of the area. At least one player must remain in close proximity or it will stop working - even a lunge attack can easily take you out of the zone. Due to the narrowness of the path at points, players may also need to pay attention to avoid blocking the way, with themselves or various summons.

Numerous mobs on the way will attempt to kill it. Magents may also trap Spirits or players and you have to mash buttons to get free. You don't have to kill all of them however, just peeling them off the Spirit with crowd control will work for most. Typically, one player escorts the Spirit while one defends the obelisk. Escorting is harder than defending, so the stronger player with Stun or Controller should escort if possible. Typically, as long as you have adequate crowd control, the spirits can reach the shield with ~70% health left even without killing mobs.

Once a Spirit reaches the shield, it disappears and adds 1 to the objective counter. You need to escort 6 Spirits to complete the Escort stage. Another Spirit would shortly afterwards appear at the obelisk if it is controlled by players. The western path is shorter than the northern one, so it is normal to reach the shield faster.

In Elite, Solomon Grundy continues to be a thorn in your side. It is vital to get him away from Avenging Spirits, as he can kill one in ~3 hits. Grundy can be killed while waiting for the purified stage to complete, making this easier. Both players may need to escort the spirit due to the increased difficulty (even without Grundy around). Faust recapturing an obelisk while the Spirit is en route does not negatively affect it (only required for feat).

It is also not required to split the team and escort spirits from both obelisks; players can simply all go to the west obelisk to escort spirits from there (as the path to the shield is shorter than the northern one), especially if struggling with Elite difficulty, where the mobs can kill the spirits much faster.

sections.title: Felix Faust
items: Felix Faust serves as the more traditional final boss of the alert. Voivode joins you in this fight; her health can be depleted but she will continue to fight, without needing to be revived.
Skull Blast
Soul Prison: Traps a player in a white magic cage, dealing moderate damage.
Magic Blast: Faust marks a large conical area in red in front of him before blasting it for massive damage.
Necrotic Aura: Players are marked with a circle of purple arrows (>>>), damaging any friendly targets nearby (including your own pets). In Elite, this can KO in ~3 ticks.
Dark Totem: Faust marks many red circles on the ground before summoning spectral pillars in the middle of every one. Rune circles centered around them deal damage over time to anyone within.

In Elite, Felix Faust is still fairly straightforward, without much in advanced mechanics (the Elite Plus raid version has additional mechanics). His attacks are obviously telegraphed and his damage is not too high, so as long as you avoid the glowing red marked areas and the purple arrows it shouldn't be too hard. As long as the tank is good, non-tanks take low enough damage a healer is not needed, even in Elite.

items: Episode 30: Earth 3 is Tier 4 playable content that contains the Earth 3 Gotham Zone, Earth 3: The Visitor 2 player operation, Earth 3: Injustice System alert, Earth 3: The Panopticon raid and Earth 3: The Escape raid.
Episode 30: Earth 3 was released on November 15th, 2017.

Access to this content is available to all players for free. The open world zone is available to all Level 20+ players — stat buffs will be applied as needed. Instances in Casual difficulty mode (if available) require Level 15+ while Normal difficulty mode or higher requires a Combat Rating of 150+.

sections.title: Story
items: " Hey. It's Superman. The Watchtower's orbital perimeter sensors detected a spacecraft entering Earth's atmosphere. lt crash landed in Smallville and I'm concerned for the people there. Head over there and provide support for Doctor Weaver and S.T.A.R. Labs." — Superman

" LexCorp's alien intervention division has detected a spacecraft of unknown origin. lt crash landed in that "idyllic" little bumpkin patch, Smallville. I want any survivors, along with the wreckage and all the data you can recover. Head to Smallville and ensure my LexCorp team on site has first crack at that craft." — Lex Luthor

sections.title: Earth 3: The Visitor
items: An unknown craft has crash landed in the peaceful town of Smallville, and Lex Luthor has asked you to investigate the situation. Find out what you can about the mysterious pilot of this ship, and what his intentions may be for our world.

sections.title: Earth 3 Gotham
items: After traveling with Alexander Luthor to a mirrored version of our Earth, you find yourself in an alternate Gotham that is absolutely drowning in corruption! Work alongside the members of the Justice League to do what you can to fight back and protect the terrified citizens of this Gotham.

sections.title: Earth 3: Injustice System
items: The Gotham of this alternate Earth has a trail of corruption that leads back to the vile Mayor Gordon, and it’s up to you and Batman to take him down! Be wary though, the Mayor may have a powerful friend ready to make this difficult for you.

sections.title: Earth 3: The Panopticon
items: Lex Luthor has gone missing after traveling alone to the Panopticon, this world’s version of the Watchtower. Travel there with Superman and Wonder Woman to find him, and to finally come face to face with the true threats of this alternate Earth – the Crime Syndicate!

sections.title: Earth 3: The Escape
items: The Crime Syndicate has put their plans in motion to invade our Earth, and you’re the only one who can stop them! Fight alongside Superman, Lex Luthor, and Alexander Luthor in this epic battle against this world’s mightiest beings, with the fate of our own world at stake!

items: With the release of this episode the attuned gear from The Vault in the Psycho style has been upgraded from item level 10-172 to 10-180. The maximum currently is at 280.

DC Universe Online' s rendition of the Crime Syndicate of America and related materials is a mixture of their depictions in the JLA: Earth 2 and Forever Evil comic book storylines, as well as their appearance in the Justice League: Crisis on Two Earths (2010) animated movie.
Earth 3 as seen in the Earth 3 Panopticon is flipped horizontally; Europe and America are on the west and east side of the Atlantic Ocean respectively, opposite to the real world.

The Valentine's Day Collections: Gotham Date Knight reveals Batman watched an Earth 3 movie to learn more about their culture. He describes it as so bad it makes him appreciate prime Earth romantic comedies.

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: The players along with Batman first face the corrupt Mayor Gordon, who hides behind a shield wall of GCPD cops and is not directly fought, instead summoning waves of cops and uses turrets on the walls (which can only hit the middle area and not the front or the back blocked by pillars). After a few waves, Gordon flees with Batman in pursuit, leaving you to defeat his Riot Shield Officers. Then, you will come across the Gotham Court System: The Judge, Juror, and Executioner. Defeat all of them to proceed. Also, you can get captured and thrown into a jail cell. You can either destroy the containment field to get out, or let your teammates free you. It's your choice. After you defeat them, proceed to the elevator and to Gordon's re-election gala.

Enter the gala and Owlman would crash the party. He has a sonic attack that projects a cone in front of him which stuns targets caught within, but can be interrupted. Periodically, he will grapple up to the top of one of the four gargoyles in the four corners. He becomes untargetable and his perch must be destroyed to force him to drop back on the floor.

Upon Owlman's defeat, Batman appears to confront both villains and angrily demand to know what happened to this world's Richard Grayson. Gordon, trying to escape responsibility, blabs that Owlman killed Richard's parents in order to sway him to the Syndicate and made him face the Joker alone. Owlman sets off a bomb that drops the chandelier and flees.

sections.title: Additional Lore
items: Be careful about going back and exploring the earlier parts of the instance as there would often be mobs that didn't need to be defeated to reach the boss room and may attack you.

In the first room where you enter the instance, there is a notebook of a list of "Most Wanted Gotham Criminals", including Alexander Luthor - "Public Enemy #1", The Justice Underground, most of which are "deceased". Quizmaster of the Justice Underground and additionally, "The Joker", is stated to to be at large.
There is also a large wanted poster in the room regarding Quizmaster, stating he is believed to be executed by the Crime Syndicate but without formal record of death, and other information.

In the large chamber where you fight the Judge, Jury, and Executioner, after defeating them you would have to go east to the lift to progress, but go west and the first small room to the north is Earth-3 Renee Montoya's office. You can read an email on her computer from Owlman, telling her that he's leaving artifacts from the Justice Underground with the GCPD that would allow the aforementioned trio to use their abilities and threatens her not to turn against him. At the confrontation against Owlman and Gordon, Batman would refer to reading files from her office but there is nothing you can read other than this email.

The next, larger room to the north is the evidence room, holding the artifacts from six members of the Justice Underground. You can interact with each piece to learn more about their story. The six artifacts are:
Sir Solomon's Tombstone: Ultraman defeated him and took his inert body to Earth 3 Panopticon.
Energy Signature Remnants: What is left of Q-Ranger in Owlman's containment field as he cannot be truly destroyed, and his physical Dilustel body is also held in the Panopticon.
Uppercut in a Box: The Joker used it to assault Montoya.
Sapphire Power Ring: Carol Ferris was killed by the Crime Syndicate and Power Ring trapped it in an energy bubble to prevent it from finding a new user.
H.I.V.E. Courier Container: Queen Bee used it to elude the Crime Syndicate.
Grodd's Weapon Cache: Taken after Grodd was killed by Johnny Quick.

While you're told to leave the Municipal Building after defeating Owlman and the latter escapes, there is a corridor to the west littered with prone bodies of officers that leads to a bonus room. You find Gordon begging for mercy in front of Batman (implying Batman beat down the officers in pursuit of Gordon). Upon entering the room, you receive a message through the communicator.
" Batman! Don't do this. Don't let the bitterness of this Earth poison you." — Wonder Woman

Talk to Batman, and The Flash appears between them and persuades Batman that this Gordon is not worth killing. Batman concedes and tells him to drop Gordon with Detective Snart, to Flash's mild confusion that Snart is a detective on this Earth.

sections.title: Introduction
items: An unknown craft has crash landed in the peaceful town of Smallville, and Lex Luthor has asked you to investigate the situation. Find out what you can about the mysterious pilot of this ship, and what his intentions may be for our world.

sections.title: Heroes

items: " LexCorp's alien intervention division has detected a spacecraft of unknown origin. It crash landed in that "idyllic" little bumpkin patch, Smallville. I want any survivors, along with the wreckage and all the data you can recover. Head to Smallville and ensure my Lexcorp team on site has first crack at that craft." — Lex Luthor

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Warning: This section might contain spoilers!

For heroes, upon arrival and talking to Doctor Weaver, you're told the site has been taken over by LexCorp and you need to stop them. For villains, you must take the site from STAR Labs. You only need to clear 4 of the indicated points, not all of them.

Afterwards, head to the crash site, where you must battle the LexCorp Lieutenant/STAR Labs Lieutenant (upon starting the fight a forcefield surrounds the immediate area preventing you from leaving unless you're KO'ed and flee). He has a powerful Lethal attack during which he is surrounded by a purple shield that negates all damage; then, he either fires 3 barrages from his Arm-Gun in the earlier stages of the fight, or fire 2 powerful shots with Neutron Explosion at later stages (with a long delay between each barrage or shot), both of which can be blocked by one of the boulders in the area (boulders are destroyed after several hits of the first and a single hit of the latter). His shield would be up the entire time, so once it disappears, it is safe to attack him again. Detaunts don't seem to be able be used to make him aim it at pets. There is an orange barrel at the north edge of the forcefield.

Upon his defeat, for heroes, Superman arrives and comments the ship is empty. Lex Luthor appears, and says that someone broke into and occupied his office, bypassing his DNA and retinal scans and asked to talk to both of them, and wagers that it was the pilot. He convinces Superman to visit his office, although the latter insists the hero players in accompanying him. For villains, Lex Luthor would arrive first and Superman afterwards, reminding him to check his messages from the mysterious visitor via Mercy Graves.
Upon arriving at Luthor Tower, Superman notices the lead-lined walls and says he already told the Justice League he's here, but Luthor impatiently insists it is not a trap.

Enter the office, and Superman would be shocked that the intruder looks just like Luthor, but with red hair and in a sleeker golden armor. Superman wants to hear him out, but Luthor attacks him. You must then defeat Alexander Luthor. He has the ability to temporarily replace himself with 5 Alexander Decoys. 9 icy jets from the ceiling in a 3x3 pattern periodically activate, working like Freezing Breath, damaging and encasing you after a couple seconds.
When he is defeated, he reiterates that he is not your enemy. Enter the portal to Earth-3 Gotham for the next segment.

Talk to Alexander Luthor. He says they must split up; the players must fight their way to the Courthouse with him while Superman and Lex Luthor depart for elsewhere. You need to defeat all enemies in the area.

Superman and Lex Luthor reappear, talk to them and a cutscene would show several good cops attempting to arrest the corrupt Mayor Gordon, but they are swiftly taken down by Owlman, who reveals Gordon pays him for protection and his re-election, before departing. Alexander Luthor confronts Gordon, who says he has a gala to plan and leaves AM-3V1L to deal with you. The area becomes locked, preventing you from leaving without a KO when the fight starts.

AM-3V1L fights with Hand Blast and has a special attack, Orbital Strike, that targets both players with a red circle that deals heavy damage after a delay (does not follow you if you move). It should not be confused with the green orbital rocket strikes, which are from Lex Luthor and aid you. AM-3V1L also summons many Security Drones that spins and deals damage around them constantly. There is an orange restoration barrel that does not respawn in the north edge of the area.
When it is destroyed, Superman says the state of Earth 3 is even worse than he thought. Alexander Luthor says they must take down Mayor Gordon.

sections.title: Additional Lore
items: After defeating Alexander Luthor you can choose to exit Luthor's office and enter the portal to Earth-3 Gotham directly, or talk to Alexander Luthor to learn his backstory; his Earth is ruled by tyranny and he is the last surviving hero. Superman summons the Justice League. Batman is concerned about trusting Luthor, but Superman assures he is telling the truth, and that leaving for Earth-3 makes the prime Earth defenceless, but Wonder Woman says Martian Manhunter, Green Lantern and Aquaman can organize the remaining heroes should the need arise. Lex Luthor wants a chance for a different Earth to view him as champion and declares himself in; Batman warns him not to step out of line.

Everyone else enters the portal. Except Superman (for heroes), who does after you talk to him and he tells you to keep an eye on Lex as he's sure Lex is not doing it out of the goodness of his heart. For villains, Lex Luthor is the last person left and will tell you to play nice as he hatches a plan.

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: First Puzzle

During the fight the brainwashed boss will get three visually different kind of empowerments. There are consoles at the wall which cycle through those empowerments indicated by the same visual. Use all three consoles at the exact time they show the same visual as the boss' empowerment to disable it.
Second Puzzle
The full group is needed here. Don't enter the room until all group members arrive.
You'll need block and rolling here, so make sure every group member is familiar with it.

This is a wind tunnel and the trick to advance safely is to activate barriers by rolling into the circles on the ground and then block until the barrier comes up. This is best done by a 2/2 player setup. Two players advance to the next barriers while the other two hold the line. The two players behind should not move forward until both players in front of them have brought up their barriers.
Repeat until you reach the switch at the end of the room to turn off the turbine.
Third Puzzle
This is quite a normal fight with adds and boss, except players occasionally get a marker. The marked player needs to go into the corner with the active light to cleanse the marker.
Fourth Puzzle
Again the whole group is needed, wait until all players arrive before you enter the room.
This is a timed puzzle, but if you know what to do, you will have plenty of time.

Every player should activate one console. This will activate a colored light, which you need to bring to two opposite spots on the ground, which have the same color. Go to the first spot of the same color, then cross the room to go to the second. If all four players have succeeded to do both their spots, the middle construction will activate and the boss fight will start.

During the fight against the two bosses, occasionally one player will be followed by a laser. This player needs to guide the laser - remember, it follows you - towards one of the ground panels, which will then be destroyed. Just stand behind it and block to lure the laser onto it.
The puzzle is solved if all floor panels are destroyed and the two bosses are defeated.
A healer is absolutely necessary if the group is in relevant content range and additionally a tank can help to keep the bosses busy while dealing with the lasers.

sections.title: Story
items: Something is happening at Mogo's central power core, deep in the caverns and Amon Sur is the cause. Whatever Amon Sur is up to can't be good. Put a stop to it!

sections.title: Characters
items: Iconic Allies

sections.title: Map
items: Map Map

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: You join Hal Jordan and Luzia Cavalera in confronting Amon Sur in Mogo's core.
Interactive scenery is key to all three boss fights of the raid.
You first need to defeat Qwardians, disable and destroy their pain generators trapping civilians, same as in the Qwardian Sabotage daily mission on Mogo.

sections.title: Corrupted Golems
items: You need to defeat one Golem, then two at once. They spawn with yellow energy wrapped around their rocky bodies, negating most damage. Mogo will spawn green energy crystal on the ground with green circles on the floor around them. Players must lure the golems near one and interact with the crystal, which deals a significant % of their max health as damage, knocks them back and removes the yellow energy temporarily, allowing them to be damaged normally. Qwardians will also spawn in the second part of the fight.

sections.title: Circuits
items: There are 3 circuits in the massive cavern (in the raid version), each with a line of 5 nodes; typically players divide themselves 2-3-2 for this section. Each note has a large yellow crystal. Players must interact with the first node of each circuit to turn them green. An interface to the side of the screen shows progress. Once a node is converted, the line to the next node gradually turns green - when the next node is reached, it can then also be converted (this must be done in sequence).

Whenever a node is converted to green, a Qwardian Engineer spawns from the next node and runs towards the converted node. They always spawn with a shield that negates an amount of damage before they can be damaged normally. If they are able to reach and complete their interaction with the converted node, it would turn back yellow.
Occasionally a Heavy Engineer would spawn, which is a giant, stronger version. They usually only appear one at a time. They are marked on the minimap with a skull icon like an open world boss.
Once all 15 nodes are converted, all Qwardians in the cavern disappear.

sections.title: Amon Sur
items: The final battle takes place in a large circular cavern dotted by numerous smaller caves. The caves are in pairs, with each pair next to a crystal, and each cave with a piece of machinery; one turns yellow crystals clear, and another turns clear crystals green. Defeat the Qwardians and turn crystal green and Amon Sur would arrive, starting the fight.

The main mechanic in this fight is that Amon Sur would periodically turn multiple crystals yellow. As long as there are at least 1 yellow crystal, he is immune to damage - represented by a yellow shield around him. Conveniently, any active yellow crystals will have a bright beam of light connecting it to him so you can easily find it. Turn all yellow crystals clear to take down his shield.

During the fight, Qwardians would spawn - particularly Qwardian Engineers, which can't turn crystals instantly or anywhere like Amon, but by the machinery like players, and can cause his shield to come back up. If the crystals have been turned green, they have to turn them clear first before turning them yellow.
Once Amon is defeated, the raid is complete.

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: The player, Carol, and Luzia start at a cave before entering a village, where Esperanza should be. Carol warns of Yellow Lanterns ahead, while Luzia accompany you.

Much of the non-boss combat can be skipped. When you enter the instance, there is a crowd of Yellow Lanterns ahead you can simply ignore by passing near the ceiling (this works a lot in this challenge). When you arrive at the entrance of a tunnel, defeat the 3 Shadow Demons, then destroy the boulder to unblock the tunnel.

Investigate the corpse and you'll be attacked by waves of zombies. Although this is not a boss and the zombies have relatively low health, they can add up to a lot of damage in Elite - faster than any of the bosses in this challenge, so be aware. Esperanza joins halfway through, saying they are creations of Luzia's fear, and there must be a powerful Yellow Lantern nearby.

You then need to go north - but before reaching the group of Yellow Lanterns, interact with the dead villager. You are then prompted to go to near the northernmost point. You can pass the Yellow Lanterns again by going near the ceiling. There should be a dead alien in a sitting position next to a tree, but there is no interaction option. You need to KO that one Amon Corps Intimidator that is closest to her - which would unlock the interact; none of the others need to be fought. This one mob does not spawn unless you interact with the dead villager before group of Yellow Lanterns.

sections.title: Carol Ferris
items: Carol is found immediately to the west - overwhelmed by fear, she mistakes you as enemies and attacks. She can use a few stuns like Encase but they can be broken out of and they don't do much damage. She has a lethal attack, Absolute Devotion; after charging in place for a few seconds, she blasts the area for massive damage. It can be blocked, and she can be interrupted with crowd control while charging.
Carol can be defeated without input by hiding on a ceiling and letting Luzia/Esperanza do all the work, but it takes a long time and you need to deal at least some damage to get loot.

sections.title: Shadow Demon
items: After defeating Carol, she realises you are allies. An ominous voice speaks and transports you into a dark cave with many Shadow Demons. Follow Esperanza's blue orb and defeat all of them.

There is a segment where you reunite with the sisters and they form a combined Blue/Indigo circle on the ground which prevents Shadow Demons from entering, but they can still hit with ranged attacks. Although technically you can go to the boss without clearing this, it is easier to defeat all demons here first since they would follow you to the boss fight.
Near the end of the cave is a giant Shadow Demon boss fight. It has the exact same attacks as the Shadow Demon Archon in Stabilizer Fragmentation and is a very straightforward fight.

sections.title: Lyssa Drak
items: When you exit the cave, stay on the ceiling again which prevents Shadow Demon ambushes from spawning. Then, go to the back of an existing Shadow Demon pack - you only need to KO one of them to get Lyssa Drak to appear, although the others in that group is close enough you'd get aggro anyway.

Lyssa Drak can be quite annoying as she summons Snake Constructs that would frequently hard stun you, requiring you to mash buttons to get free sooner. She could also summon Skull Constructs around the area that knocks you back like bumpers in a pinball machine. Upon falling to several health thresholds, she disappears and several Shadow Demons appear; she returns if you defeat all Shadow Demons, or take too long.

You can simply let Luzia and Esperanza defeat her by standing on a ceiling. Snake Constructs can appear on the ceiling and ground you, but they cannot stun or damage you there. You need to hit her once at some point to get loot, but make sure you don't attack Lyssa while up there or she can reset her health to full.

When Lyssa is defeated, the sisters talk - but shockingly, Lyssa fires a final shot, piercing through Esperanza's chest, before teleporting away, dodging Luzia's desperate retaliation. With Esperanza's death, Luzia is transformed into a Gray Lantern while reciting the oath, as it begins to rain and Mogo starts to turn gray as well.
All days are neither dark or bright...
...gray sorrow grips my soul so tight.
When dearest hope seems all but lost...
...my broken heart will pay the cost.

sections.title: Trivia
items: This is likely the first time a Gray Lantern appeared in a DC adaptation, being a recent and relatively unknown addition to the comics. The first and at the time only Gray Lantern is Nathan Broome. Carol's line in the challenge about recognising Luzia's state is a reference to how Nathan Broome was her ex-fiance. sections.title: Story
items: Amon Sur is planning something at Mogo's central power core, deep in the caverns. Whatever it is, it can't be good. Put a stop to it!

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Need to confirm how this text from the raid differs for this copycat/scaled-down alert.
You join Hal Jordan and Luzia Cavalera in confronting Amon Sur in Mogo's core.
Interactive scenery is key to all three boss fights.
You first need to defeat Qwardians, disable and destroy their pain generators trapping civilians, same as in the Qwardian Sabotage daily mission on Mogo.

sections.title: Corrupted Golems
items: You need to defeat one Golem, then two at once. They spawn with yellow energy wrapped around their rocky bodies, negating most damage. Mogo will spawn green energy crystals on the ground with green circles on the floor around them. Players must lure the golems near one and interact with the crystal, which deals a significant % of their max health as damage, knocks them back and removes the yellow energy temporarily, allowing them to be damaged normally. Qwardians will also spawn in the second part of the fight.

sections.title: Circuits
items: There are 3 circuits in the massive cavern (in the raid version - in the alert there are 2 circuits), each with a line of 5 nodes; typically players divide themselves 2-3-2 (2-2 in the alert) for this section. Each note has a large yellow crystal. Players must interact with the first node of each circuit to turn it green. An interface to the side of the screen shows progress. Once a node is converted, the line to the next node gradually turns green - when the next node is reached, it can then also be converted (this must be done in sequence).

Whenever a node is converted to green, a Qwardian Engineer spawns from the next node and runs towards the converted node. They always spawn with a shield that negates an amount of damage before they can be damaged normally. If they are able to reach and complete their interaction with the converted node, it will turn back to yellow.
Occasionally a Heavy Engineer will spawn, which is a giant, stronger version. They usually only appear one at a time. They are marked on the minimap with a skull icon like an open world boss.
Once all 15 nodes are converted, all Qwardians in the cavern disappear.

sections.title: Amon Sur
items: The final battle takes place in a large circular cavern dotted by numerous smaller caves. The caves are in pairs, with each pair next to a crystal, and each cave with a piece of machinery; one turns yellow crystals clear, and another turns clear crystals green. Defeat the Qwardians and turn crystal green and Amon Sur arrives, starting the fight.

The main mechanic in this fight is that Amon Sur will periodically turn multiple crystals yellow. As long as there is at least 1 yellow crystal, he is immune to damage - represented by a yellow shield around him. Conveniently, any active yellow crystal will have a bright beam of light connecting it to him so you can easily find it. Turn all yellow crystals clear to take down his shield.

During the fight, Qwardians spawn - particularly Qwardian Engineers, which can't turn crystals instantly or anywhere like Amon, but by the machinery like players, and can cause his shield to come back up. If the crystals have been turned green, they have to turn them clear first before turning them yellow.
Once Amon is defeated, the raid is complete.

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: When you enter the area, you should see the repulsor on the ground. It generates a red forcefield that repulses red lanterns, bouncing them back and also constantly heals players within. You can hold it to carry the forcefield with you (which also grounds you), but also limiting your attacks to smashing and throwing it (it cannot be destroyed). Its power only lasts for 25 seconds (regardless of how many times it is activated), and once it is out you must drop it to interact with it to recharge it.

Go east into Ferris Aircraft. There are large red batteries to the north, east, and southwest. There are three bombs in the center of the area, one specific for each battery. You must carry/throw the bomb into the batteries to destroy them. Carrying a bomb also grounds you. Don't bother fighting the red lanterns, because they automatically revive after a few seconds. Out of the generic red lantern mobs, only Ferocity (female members) can fly while others cannot. There is also Vice who cannot be targeted, runs around knocking players into the air and spewing pools of plasma on the ground damaging anyone standing on them.

summary: Flashback is a Tier 1 Duo located in the Central City Police Department in the Lightning Strikes episode.

sections.title: Overview
items: Flashback is a Tier 1 Duo located in the Central City Police Department in the Lightning Strikes episode.
It is available when the player reaches Level 30.

sections.title: Background
items: Learning that someone was tempering with his past, the Flash (Barry Allen) sends a pair of heroes to the night of the lightning strike via the Cosmic Treadmill to stop the meddlers from altering the timeline.

sections.title: Story
items: Someone is tampering with the past to prevent Barry Allen from becoming the Flash!

sections.title: Inhabitants
items: Pied Piper
Abra Kadabra
Hypnotized CCPD Deputy
Hypnotized CCPD SWAT
Hypnotized SWAT Captain
Barry Allen

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Go to the north room and speak with the Flash on the Cosmic Treadmill. He tells you that his Rogues are trying to erase his origin. For villains, Professor Zoom fills in the role, saying that his powers will also vanish if Flash never existed. He starts running on the treadmill and tunnelling through the Speed Force, allowing you to go through a portal in time.

To start to go through the Speed Force, both players must be in it near the treadmill (however, once started, one player can complete this segment). Waves of Paradox Reapers will appear and you need to kill all of them or the exit portal won't open. After a short distance into it, a paradox wave appears behind you and begin chasing you. If it catches up to you it would continuously deal massive damage and KO you almost instantly. Do NOT try to Supersonic or equivalent through the Speed Force, because if you reach the other end too fast, the Paradox Reapers will not be able to spawn, and the exit won't open; you will be forced to be KO'ed by the paradox wave and try again slowly.

If one player manages to complete it and enter CCPD and the other player is KO'ed, the other player can then respawn in the CCPD. Do not try to use the portal to go back into the Speed Force - it will simply remove you from the instance entirely.

You find yourself in a shooting range and attacked by hypnotized officers. After defeating them, you find Pied Piper who sets more officers on you. There is also a Sonic Emitter in the middle of the room that would damage you every second and slow you if you are near it. Pursue the Piper - you must fight through a lot more officers and several more emitters. There are a few computers you can interact with, a couple will shut down security cameras and slightly reduce the amount of officers you have to fight, and one will shut down Riot Bots which makes the final boss easier.

Defeat Pied Piper (you may need to interrupt him to stop him from controlling your ally) and continue (there is a possible bug that prevents the door to the last two chambers from opening, leaving players stuck).

Enter the second-to-last room, and you find Abra Kadabra who has trapped Barry Allen in a forcefield then retreat behind a locked door in the final room. To open it, the two players must operate the machinery on the wall in the corridor leading to it simultaneously. There are two orange healing barrels in the boss room - one in the northwest corner (respawns in 90 seconds) and one in the southeast (does not respawn).

Upon his defeat, Abra Kadabra blames the players for foiling his plans and mentions that his unnamed "benefactors" have all the time in the world to try again, before vanishing. Despairing over the amount of cases he has to work through, Barry Allen is suddenly struck by lightning and becomes The Flash!

items: If you try to stand on the Cosmic Treadmill while it is running, it would throw you backwards much like a real-life treadmill going too fast for you.

Flashback is the only Tier 1 On Duty instance that is not directly named after a location. It is simply labelled "Flashback" in the side bar of the On Duty menu. Previously when clicked on, the menu would display "Cosmic Treadmill: Flashback".

title: HBB: Summit of Sorrow
summary: HBB: Summit of Sorrow is a Tier 7 solo Challenge in the Hope Burns Bright chapter. It also features a Story, Casual, and Elite version.

sections.title: Overview
items: Mogo Sprout

Story-wise, this instance is preceded by events in either the Matron's Orphanage alert version or the raid version.
Climb the Summit of Sorrow. Confront Luzia, and end the Gray Lantern menace once and for all.

sections.title: Story
items: Ascend into the heart of Luzia’s despair in this story-focused solo mission. Confront sorrow head-on and prove that hope still burns bright.

sections.title: Characters
items: Iconic Allies
Green Lantern (Guy Gardner)
Brother Warth
Saint Walker
Iconic Foes
Luzia Cavalera
Randolph the Gray
Mobs
Gray Lantern
Sorrow Construct
Melancholic Mass
Construct of the Reckoning
Fragment of Woe

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Throughout most of the challenge, you are grounded and a sorrow meter constantly fills and must be emptied in Blue Lantern fields or you would go gray and constantly lose health. Brother Warth instructs you to activate two large crystals near him. Interact with each of the Blue Lanterns next to them, then defeat the mobs that appear until the crystals are turned blue. One crystal would spawn a large Melancholic Mass with a lot of health. Gray Lanterns can be a hassle; they can drop a Concentrated Sorrow Field that forces you to move out of them, use a continuous Light Blast (interruptible), and Somber Grasp that should be blocked when prompted or a chain would drag you to them.

After finishing those two crystals, Brother Warth tells you to climb without him. You must convert a series of crystals to blue similarly up to the summit, although the mobs are much easier here. Some Blue Lanterns are beyond your help and would turn Gray when interacted with; this is not always the same on each playthrough (getting this 100% correct is required for a feat).

Near the summit, you find Saint Walker; clear the mobs and he turns the crystal blue as well, leaving only Luzia. You do not fight Luzia directly. Instead, you first have to clear mobs while Saint Walker converts three crystals. Every time a crystal is converted, a Construct of the Reckoning spawns and must be killed as well. The sorrow meter fills faster here - becoming completely full about 17 seconds after leaving a Blue Lantern field.

Only weak Sorrow Constructs spawn while Saint Walker is turning the crystal blue. However, on the second and third crystal, while fighting the Construct of the Reckoning, the most dangerous mechanic in Elite appears: Melancholy Miasma, a vertical beam that would chase you for a considerable time, deals constant massive damage on contact and could be hard to see due to being gray on gray. On the third crystal, the Construct of the Reckoning gains Sorrow Surge, marking a red cone on the ground before dealing massive damage in it, and Exobyte Steal which temporarily disables your abilities.

Once the last crystal is cleared, Luzia blasts Saint Walker and Guy Gardner, but Saint Walker turns you into a Blue Lantern. The sorrow meter still fills, but at a slower rate so it only becomes full after about a minute and is generally not much of a concern. All three crystals are gray again and you must reconvert them yourself by moving near them. Similar to RN: Nekron's Lair, being turned into a Blue Lantern gives you a new set of abilities.
Pacifying Strike: (Cooldown: 0.5s) Throws a shield-like projectile in a single-target attack.
Hopewave: (Cooldown: 6s) Shoots a wave of energy in front of you.
Empowering Pulse: (Cooldown: 6s) Heals you and deals damage to nearby enemies.
Surging Barrier: (Cooldown: 25s) Heals you and applies a Shield Power lasting 12 seconds if not broken.
Beacon of Hope: (Cooldown: 31s) Creates a Blue Lantern field that quickly drains the sorrow meter and heals you over time when stood upon (does not move with you).

Luzia can still use Melancholy Miasma, and may summon spikes at your location after a delay that does no damage (possible bug). Other than Sorrow Constructs, Fragments of Woe appear and fly to your location before using Shatter for massive damage before disappearing (ignores Shield Powers). After the first crystal is converted, Gray Lanterns begin to appear (having Surging Barrier active count as blocking their Somber Grasp).

In general while the damage can add up quickly in Elite, just spamming abilities 1-3 mows down enemies fast enough. The challenge is also very forgiving towards progress (even in Elite), and you can generally pick up where you were KO'ed, even during the final fight with crystals half-converted, without needing to restart.

If you are KO'ed during the third Construct of the Reckoning fight and Guy finishes it off, this would cause you to go into cutscene and transition into the final phase without becoming a Blue Lantern, which could make the final phase much harder.
Upon converting all crystals, Luzia sees a vision, revealing to her that Esperanza had a daughter, and passes the Blue Lantern ring to Luzia.

sections.title: Trivia
items: The existence of Esperanza's daughter, Hope, is hinted at in HBB: Matron's Orphanage. There is a child's drawing of Kennik with a girl who looks similar to Hope where Kennik and the other kids are held.
If your style would normally display an emblem, the Blue Lantern emblem is temporarily displayed in its place while transformed.

The plot of this challenge may be intended to parallel Saint Walker's own origin story in comics, where after the loss of his family, he climbed to the summit of a mountain and became the first Blue Lantern. In the adaptation Green Lantern: The Animated Series, that story occurred on Mogo.
In Shadows Over Argo, it is revealed that SPOILER Hope herself, using her Mental abilities, projected the vision to Luzia.

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Warning: This section might contain spoilers!

Talk to John Constantine, who tells you to ask around the bar if anyone has heard of an occult deal. When you find a patron who has (it is a different demon each time), Klarion is revealed to be the culprit and he teleports away, and curses the patrons to attack you, several at a time.

After defeating them, Zatanna tracks Klarion's spell and teleport all of you to the Rock of Eternity. Klarion flees, leaving Teekl to deal with you after enlarging him to giant size. Teekl can pin one of you down as an unbreakable stun - the other player must talk to Zatanna, who transforms them into a giant bird that distracts Teekl. He can also summon several giant red yarn balls that roll around on the ground and trap you if you touch them.

After defeating Teekl and more of Klarion's spectral minions, you arrive at the council, which is empty, but a tomb is broken and something stolen. You must find a book on the left side of the empty thrones to help track Klarion. Shazam appears and accuses you of the crime. John Constantine tries to figure out the book in his magic shield, while Zatanna helps you battle Shazam.

Shazam fights with brawling combos, and periodically, he and Zatanna would shoot lightning at each other in an evenly matched struggle. He becomes invulnerable, and you must pick up a light and dark energy orb that spawn and smash them near him. This can be quite tricky since Shazam can emit a barrage of sparks that knock you back and force you to drop the orbs. If you fail to do it correctly, Shazam will generate a massive blast of lightning that hits the whole room and deals heavy damage (you get a few seconds of warning beforehand, Shield Powers are useful), and you will have to try again. If you do it right, he will be stunned for a few seconds and becomes vulnerable again.
After defeating him, he will agree to help you as long as Constantine returns the book.

title: Johnny Quick
summary: Johnny Quick is the fastest man alive on Earth-3, one half of a mass-murdering duo known as "Johnny and Rhonnie", and a founding member of the Crime Syndicate of America.

sections.title: Overview
items: Johnny Quick is the fastest man alive on Earth-3, one half of a mass-murdering duo known as "Johnny and Rhonnie", and a founding member of the Crime Syndicate of America.
A sadistic thrill-killer with super-speed, Johnny is the Earth-3 version and moral opposite of New Earth's Flash (Barry Allen).

sections.title: Background
items: Jonathan Allen and his lover, Rhonda Pineda, were a pair wild teenagers who only sought to enjoy the most out of life by finding and participating in that they found interesting or exciting. To this end, the pair quickly fell into crime and the rush they got from committing them. While initially starting with petty thefts, the duo quickly escalated their activities to robberies, rapes and sadistic murders as they sought out greater thrills and excitement.

Pursued by officer Leonard Snart and his partner, Mick Rory, of the Central City Police after the duo had skinned detective Mardon, bled out sergeant Scudder and killed rookie officer Walker, the two officers manage to capture Johnny but Rhonda intercepts the convoy and the pair escape into a nearby STAR Labs building.

Trapped on a rooftop by pursuing police, the duo was on the verge of rushing the police in a hail of bullets when a lightning bolt struck the roof, causing both of the criminals to fall through the roof skylight into the laboratory below. While Jonathan fell amongst various tubes of chemicals; giving him super speed, Rhonda falls next to an energy vessel containing the atomic energy of Ray Palmer (Atomico). As the energy vessel was breached the energy leached into Rhonda's body; giving her the ability to alter her atomic size.

Imbued with superpowers, Jonathan dubs himself "Johnny Quick" while Rhonda takes on the costume and mantle of Atomico; dubbing herself "Atomica". Renewing their crime spree, the duo are recruited by Ultraman to join the Crime Syndicate of America.

sections.title: Notes
items: Despite being very similar to the alert or raid, it shares its loot lock with DoR: Desecrated Mausoleum and Reckoning's Hideout instead, preventing you from getting loot from either if you have done Kaznian Necropolis Strike for the day, and vice versa. Since those 2 instances do not have a Second Subboss, you can get loot from Kaznian Necropolis Strike's Second Subboss (which is the "Escort" part of the instance) without affecting the loot locks in those 2 instances. However, if you have received loot from the Final Boss of those 2 instances, it will also loot lock the Second Subboss in Kaznian Necropolis Strike.

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Defeat the envy demons in the corridors and open the gate to the Ritual Field. Jesse will send their demons in waves to stop you.

sections.title: First Boss: Ritual Master
items: Once the 4 waves of demons are defeated, the Ritual Master will appear — he's stronger but doesn't present much challenge. Be sure to interrupt his lethal attack with a melee to avoid taking much damage.

sections.title: Enthralled Citizens
items: Be careful once in the Ritual Field. Don't attack the whole crowd at once, or you might succumb to the numbers.

sections.title: The Prize
items: You'll get asked to attack The Prize twice. The first time, you'll only get to damage it to 60% of its health until you get interrupted by the iconic random boss. The second time, it healed itself, and you'll get to damage it to 30% before getting interrupted by Jesse.

During the final fight against Jesse, The Prize will shoot out black and green energy balls (Spark of Envy). They should be avoided at least at relevant levels since they do significant damage over time.

sections.title: Second Boss: Iconics
items: If you're playing the hero version of the duo, you'll fight one of the following iconic villains:
Doctor Light: has 2 main attacks that are easily avoidable by dodging.
Giganta: when below 50% of health, Giganta will get bigger and stronger.
Gizmo: when below 50% of health, Gizmo will summon Gizmo Blimps to aid him in battle, and it is advisable to take them down before proceeding.
If you're playing the villain version of the duo, you'll fight one of the following iconic heroes:
Cyborg
Starfire
Superboy

sections.title: Final Boss: Jesse
items: Sometime after the battle starts, Jesse will take the form and moves of one of the mentors ( Batman, Superman, Wonder Woman for heroes, and Circe, Lex Luthor, The Joker for villains). His spell will wear out after a while.
