title: Spark of Parallax
summary: Spark of Parallax is a Tier 3 Solo Challenge in the War of the Light Part II Episode.

sections.title: Overview
items: Spark of Parallax is a Tier 3 Solo Challenge in the War of the Light Part II Episode.

The Spark of Parallax must make it to the Central Battery on Qward! Work with Hal Jordan and Sinestro to ensure that the entity of fear is restored, and the Emotional Spectrum is on its way to recovery.
Combat Rating requirement: 100

" So, remember how I said "we" were working on cultivating the Spark. Well, don't freak out on me when you see the other part of "we." I need you to help us on Qward. Yeah, the Sinestro Corps's HQ. I know, trust me." — Hal Jordan

references.label: War of the Light Part II

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Talk to Hal Jordan to begin. He is in an uneasy alliance with Sinestro, who is carrying the Spark of Parallax - the fear entity - in an endeavour to restore it by putting it into the yellow central power battery.

You are intercepted by Red Lanterns - Sinestro flies ahead but his ring fails and he was overwhelmed. They knock him out and steal the Spark for Atrocitus. After dealing with the ones attacking you, enter the area where Hal would contain Bleez, Vice, and Furious Metallo (all three of which trying to catch the elusive Spark inside their containment) while you defeat the rest and revive Sinestro.

Interact with each Green Lantern shield and Hal Jordan would take it down, allowing you to defeat the Red Lantern within. You can do all 3 of them in one go, although one by one would be easier. When all 3 are freed, Hal is also freed up to fight them as well, and while you can't see or attack them, Red Lantern Rampagers start to aerial bombard the area (a large Red Lantern symbol appears on the ground briefly before it is hit, damaging and knocking over you and your allies if caught within). There is a restoration barrel in the north edge of the area.
Upon defeating all of them, Sinestro recollects the sparks and reconstitutes Parallax. He feels something is off, but declines to comment further.

sections.title: Trivia
items: The story of this challenge is followed by the Spark of Ion duo.

title: Stemming the Tide - Hero
summary: Stemming the Tide - Hero is a Tier 5 Solo Challenge for heroes as part of the Deluge episode.

sections.title: Overview
items: Stemming the Tide - Hero is a Tier 5 Solo Challenge for heroes as part of the Deluge episode.
Access to the Challenge requires a Combat Rating of 210.

sections.title: Story
items: Mera has called upon you to help the Flash defend the CCPD against an attack from Starro. If Starro takes over the energy grid at the CCPD then it will grow too fast to control and overrun all of Central City!

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Inside the CCPD, you must help the flash clear Starro out. You do so by freeing controlled police officers and prisoners, and destroying Starro spore hatcheries. You then meet The Flash in the detention wing, Where The Rogues are being detained. Flash defeats Atlanteans, but he is then captured and turned into Controlled Flash, the first boss of the Solo. At certain point of the fight, you have to free one of the Rogues to help you. A starro will latch onto their cells and gain power from them. Destroy them before they do so.
Part 2

Mera appears and recognizes the armor of the Rogue atlanteans. She then tells you to follow her to an Ancient Atlantean temple to confront who's behind the entire invasion. It is revealed to be Ocean Master, Aquaman's brother who seeks to rule atlantis. After an arguement, the fight against Ocean Master begins. After he is defeated, Mera cuffs him and says he will inform Aquaman about Ocean Master's betrayal at Spindrift Station. And that's the end of the challenge.

sections.title: Feats
items: Manual Override: During the CCPD portion of the Story Mission (Normal), in a single run, shut off the power on all cell doors while the Starro spores are feeding off the energy grid (25 Points)

Patience is a Virtue: During the CCPD portion of Story Mission (Normal), in a single run, defeat all four Supercharged Starro in a single instance, after they have completely drained the energy on the cell doors (50 Points), grants title: the Patient
Plug the Pool: During the Atlantean Temple portion of the Story Mission (Normal), in a single run, plug each of the moon pools within 15 seconds each (25 Points)

Sparkle, Sparkle, Little Starro: During the CCPD portion of the Story Mission (Normal), in a single run, destroy each of the smallest Starro spores feeding on the energy grid before it grows in size (10 Points)
Temple Throwdown: During the Atlantean Temple portion of the Story Mission (Normal), in a single run, defeat at least 30 enemies that emerge from the moonpools (25 Points)

sections.title: Trivia
items: The walk-in version of this instance is not attached to any feats.
Chronologically, the first part of the challenge comes before all the other Starro instances, but the second part takes place after Starro: The Threat Below.
After escaping prison, the Trickster and Weather Wizard go controlled by Starro and can be found at Central City Starro Deluge Zone as part of the Fallen Stars mission.

Black Lightning and Power Girl are mentioned in reports in the police station. Black Lightning is one of the iconics available as part of the Fallen Stars mission in the Central City Starro Deluge Zone, while Power Girl is one of the possible bosses in the Starro: Invasion! alert.
A note found with the Starro Specimen - ST-2 on the desk my the metal detector contains the results for the tests performed in the mission Applied Science.
